name: 'Ote'a
zh: 大溪地舞蹈伴奏，以木裂鼓和大鼓交错敲出急促、有层次的节奏。
en: Tahitian dance music driven by rapid, interlocking patterns on wooden slit drums and deep percussion.

name: 16-bit
zh: 沿用十六位游戏机的合成与采样音色，以鲜明旋律和循环编排构曲。
en: Music shaped by the synthesized and sampled sounds of 16-bit game consoles, often featuring vivid melodies and looping arrangements.

name: 2 Tone
zh: 把斯卡的反拍吉他与朋克的速度、冲劲结合起来的英国舞曲摇滚。
en: British ska that combines offbeat guitar rhythms with the speed and punch of punk rock.

name: 2-Step
zh: 跳过部分正拍底鼓，以错落军鼓、切分低音和人声切片推动的车库舞曲。
en: UK garage with skipped kicks, offbeat snares, syncopated bass and vocal snippets that give the rhythm a skipping feel.

name: 3-Step
zh: 每小节以三下底鼓打破浩室的四拍惯性，配上非洲打击乐的南非舞曲。
en: South African house built around three kicks per bar, with layered African percussion and an uneven, rolling pulse.

name: Aak
zh: 用于韩国儒家祭仪的庄重雅乐，以缓慢旋律、管乐和钟磬声展开。
en: Korean Confucian ceremonial music with slow, measured melodies played on winds, bells and stone chimes.

name: Abakuá Music
zh: 古巴阿巴夸社团的仪式音乐，以交错鼓声、摇响器和领唱应答为核心。
en: Cuban Abakuá ceremonial music centered on interlocking drums, rattles and call-and-response singing.

name: Abkhazian Folk Music
zh: 阿布哈兹传统音乐，常由独唱在持续低音或合唱应答之上展开。
en: Abkhazian traditional music often places a solo melody above sustained bass voices or answering choral parts.

name: Aboio
zh: 巴西牧牛人的无伴奏呼唱，以拉长的元音和起伏旋律驱赶、呼唤牛群。
en: Unaccompanied Brazilian cattle calls that stretch open vowels into winding melodies used to guide and summon herds.

name: Aboio cantado
zh: 把牧牛呼唱发展成有歌词的歌，保留悠长旋律与巴西乡野的叙事口吻。
en: Brazilian cattle-calling songs with verses, retaining the long melodic phrases and storytelling voice of rural herding traditions.

name: Abstract Hip Hop
zh: 以抽象意象、跳跃联想或含蓄叙事写词，常搭配非传统节拍的嘻哈。
en: Hip hop with abstract imagery, associative wordplay and oblique storytelling, often set against unconventional beats.

name: Acholi Music
zh: 乌干达北部阿乔利人的歌舞传统，常以领唱应答配合鼓、弦乐和舞步。
en: Acholi song and dance traditions from northern Uganda, often combining call-and-response vocals with drums and string instruments.

name: Acholitronix
zh: 把阿乔利婚礼歌舞与合成器、电子鼓结合，形成快速交错的乌干达电子舞曲。
en: Ugandan electronic dance music combining Acholi wedding songs and traditional instruments with synthesizers and fast, interlocking programmed rhythms.

name: Achomi Music
zh: 伊朗南部阿乔米人的音乐，常以地方语言歌唱和富于摆动的鼓点伴舞。
en: Music of southern Iran's Achomi communities, often pairing local-language singing with swaying percussion for communal dancing.

name: Acid Breaks
zh: 在断裂、切分的碎拍上加入酸液般滑动、扭曲的合成器低音。
en: Breakbeat music that sets squelching, sliding acid basslines against chopped drums and syncopated rhythms.

name: Acid House
zh: 以四拍底鼓托住扭动、尖啸的酸性合成器低音，循环中不断改变音色。
en: House driven by a steady four-on-the-floor kick and squelching acid basslines that shift in tone as they repeat.

name: Acid Jazz
zh: 把爵士器乐、放克律动和灵魂乐唱腔带进舞池，常结合采样与循环节拍。
en: Dance-oriented music combining jazz instrumentation, funk grooves and soul vocals, often with samples and looped beats.

name: Acid Rock
zh: 以厚重失真、延长独奏和即兴段落放大迷幻体验的摇滚。
en: Psychedelic rock with heavy distortion, extended solos and loose improvisational passages that stretch songs beyond conventional forms.

name: Acid Techno
zh: 用坚硬的机械节拍推动反复扭曲的酸性低音，音色尖锐而持续推进。
en: Techno driven by hard mechanical rhythms and repeating acid basslines that twist and sharpen as the track develops.

name: Acid Trance
zh: 在催眠式循环与渐进铺陈中突出酸性合成器的滑音、共振和尖啸。
en: Trance built around resonant acid sequences, with sliding notes and squelching tones woven through hypnotic, gradually developing arrangements.

name: Acidcore
zh: 以强烈失真底鼓和高速节拍，配上持续扭曲的酸性合成器循环。
en: Hardcore dance music combining pounding distorted kicks with fast rhythms and twisting, repetitive acid synthesizer lines.

name: Acousmatic Music
zh: 为扬声器播放创作的电声音乐，把录音加工成脱离可见声源的听觉空间。
en: Electroacoustic music composed for loudspeakers, transforming recorded sounds into listening experiences detached from visible performers or sound sources.

name: Acoustic Blues
zh: 以原声吉他等不插电乐器伴唱，突出蓝调的滑音、弯音和弹唱呼应。
en: Blues played on acoustic instruments, often highlighting guitar slides, bent notes and exchanges between voice and strings.

name: Acoustic Chicago Blues
zh: 芝加哥早期的原声蓝调，常以吉他、钢琴或口琴配合城市化的弹唱节奏。
en: Early Chicago blues played acoustically, often pairing vocals with guitar, piano or harmonica in an urban ensemble setting.

name: Acoustic Rock
zh: 以原声吉他为主要声部的摇滚，保留歌曲的节奏推动和乐队编排。
en: Rock led by acoustic guitars, retaining the rhythmic drive and song arrangements of a rock band.

name: Acoustic Texas Blues
zh: 得克萨斯的原声蓝调，以灵活单音旋律和吉他对人声的应答见长。
en: Acoustic Texas blues often features agile single-note guitar lines answering the singer's phrases.

name: Adhan
zh: 伊斯兰礼拜前的人声宣礼，以无伴奏的延音和旋律转折传达固定经文。
en: The Islamic call to prayer, voiced without accompaniment through sustained notes and melodic turns around a prescribed text.

name: Adhunik geet
zh: 尼泊尔现代抒情歌曲，以清晰旋律和讲究的演唱融合民间与古典音乐元素。
en: Nepali modern songs with lyrical melodies and expressive singing that draw on folk and classical musical traditions.

name: Adult Contemporary
zh: 面向成人听众的流行音乐，常用平稳节奏、柔和编配与易记的抒情旋律。
en: Pop aimed at adult listeners, often featuring smooth arrangements, steady rhythms and accessible, lyrical melodies.

name: Aegean Islands Folk Music
zh: 爱琴海岛屿的希腊民间歌舞，常由小提琴、鲁特琴或风笛带出轻快舞步。
en: Greek island song and dance music, often led by violin, lute or bagpipes with buoyant dance rhythms.

name: Afar Music
zh: 非洲之角阿法尔人的音乐传统，涵盖诗性歌唱、集体应答与伴舞节奏。
en: Music of the Afar people in the Horn of Africa, including poetic singing, group responses and dance accompaniment.

name: Afoxé
zh: 巴西非洲裔游行音乐，以伊热沙节奏、手鼓和摇响器配合领唱应答。
en: Afro-Brazilian procession music combining ijexá rhythms, hand drums and rattles with call-and-response singing.

name: African Folk Music
zh: 非洲各地口传的民间音乐，涵盖劳动歌、舞曲及鼓乐、弦乐等地方传统。
en: Orally transmitted African traditions spanning work songs, dance music and regional styles of drumming and string playing.

name: African Music
zh: 涵盖非洲各地的传统与现代音乐，各地区有自己的歌唱、节奏和器乐语言。
en: Music from across Africa, encompassing traditional and modern forms with distinct regional approaches to singing, rhythm and instrumentation.

name: Afrikaner Folk Music
zh: 南非阿非利卡人的民间音乐，常以手风琴、六角琴和小提琴演奏社交舞曲。
en: Afrikaner folk music often features accordion, concertina and fiddle in lively tunes for social dancing.

name: Afro House
zh: 把非洲打击乐、交错节奏与人声融入四拍浩室律动的舞曲。
en: House that layers African percussion, interlocking rhythms and vocal elements over a steady four-on-the-floor groove.

name: Afro Trap
zh: 把非洲流行舞曲的旋律和节奏，与陷阱说唱的低音、碎踩镲结合。
en: Rap combining African pop melodies and dance rhythms with trap bass and skittering hi-hats.

name: Afro-Cuban Jazz
zh: 把爵士即兴与古巴克拉维节奏结合，常由康加鼓和铜管交错推进。
en: Jazz improvisation set to Cuban clave-based rhythms, often driven by congas and interlocking brass arrangements.

name: Afro-Funk
zh: 以紧凑低音和切分吉他，把放克律动与西非打击乐、歌唱传统结合。
en: Funk combining tight basslines and syncopated guitar with West African percussion and vocal traditions.

name: Afro-Jazz
zh: 让爵士即兴与非洲地方旋律、节奏相遇，常保留鲜明的打击乐层次。
en: Jazz that brings improvisation together with African regional melodies and rhythms, often emphasizing layered percussion.

name: Afro-Rock
zh: 把电吉他摇滚与西非交错节奏、打击乐和领唱应答结合起来。
en: Rock that combines electric guitars with West African interlocking rhythms, percussion and call-and-response vocals.

name: Afrobeat
zh: 以长篇循环、交错鼓点、切分吉他和铜管齐奏，将西非节奏与放克结合。
en: Long, repeating grooves combine West African rhythms with funk, interlocking percussion, clipped guitar and punchy horn sections.

name: Afrobeats
zh: 西非当代流行音乐，以轻巧切分鼓点、顺口旋律和唱说交织的人声为常见特色。
en: Contemporary West African pop often pairs light, syncopated percussion with catchy melodies and vocals that move between singing and rap.

name: Afropiano
zh: 把阿非节拍的流行旋律与阿马皮亚诺的滚动低音、松弛鼓点结合。
en: Afrobeats melodies meet amapiano's rolling log-drum bass and loose, shuffling percussion in a vocal-led dance sound.

name: Afroswing
zh: 英国唱说交织的嘻哈，把阿非节拍、舞厅雷鬼和陷阱节拍揉成轻快律动。
en: British melodic rap that blends Afrobeats, dancehall and trap into a light, swaying groove.

name: Agbadza
zh: 埃维族集体歌舞，以铃声定拍、层层鼓点和领唱应答形成交错节奏。
en: Ewe communal dance music with bell patterns, layered drumming and call-and-response singing woven into interlocking rhythms.

name: Agbekor
zh: 埃维族源自战舞的鼓乐，以密集交错的鼓声、铃声和歌唱配合队形动作。
en: Ewe music rooted in war dances, coordinating dense interlocking drums, bells and singing with group movement.

name: Aggrotech
zh: 以失真人声、尖锐合成器和猛烈四拍节奏构成的黑暗工业舞曲。
en: Dark industrial dance music with heavily distorted vocals, piercing synthesizers and forceful four-on-the-floor beats.

name: Agronejo
zh: 歌唱巴西乡村生活的当代乡村流行，将抒情旋律与放克、电子节拍结合。
en: Brazilian country-pop celebrating rural life, pairing sertanejo melodies with funk and electronic dance beats.

name: Ahwash
zh: 摩洛哥阿马齐格人的集体歌舞，以应答合唱、拍手和手鼓推进整齐舞步。
en: Moroccan Amazigh group performance combining answering choruses, handclaps and frame drums with coordinated dancing.

name: Ainu Music
zh: 阿伊努人的音乐传统，常见轮唱、喉音游戏，以及口簧和五弦琴的伴奏。
en: Ainu musical traditions include round singing, vocal games and the sounds of mouth harps and five-string zithers.

name: Aita
zh: 摩洛哥的乡间诗歌演唱，以高亢、带装饰音的嗓音配合弦乐和打击乐。
en: Moroccan rural song marked by forceful, ornamented singing over string instruments and percussion.

name: Akan Music
zh: 西非阿肯人的音乐传统，以说话鼓、歌唱应答及仪式和舞蹈节奏为重要部分。
en: Akan musical traditions feature talking drums, call-and-response singing and rhythms tied to ceremony and dance.

name: Akishibu-kei
zh: 把涩谷系的复古流行编配与秋叶原动漫、偶像歌曲的甜亮人声结合。
en: Japanese pop combining Shibuya-kei's retro arrangements with the bright vocals and melodies of anime and Akihabara idol music.

name: Al jeel
zh: 埃及青年流行音乐，以电子节奏和简洁歌曲结构搭配阿拉伯旋律与唱腔。
en: Egyptian pop pairing electronic rhythms and concise song structures with Arabic melodies and ornamented vocals.

name: Al-Jadīd
zh: 阿拉伯传统流行歌曲，以延展的装饰性演唱和大型器乐编配连接调式传统与现代歌曲。
en: Traditional Arabic popular song combines expansive, ornamented vocals and large instrumental arrangements with the melodic language of maqam.

name: Albanian Folk Music
zh: 阿尔巴尼亚民间音乐，涵盖北部叙事歌与南部以持续低音托住的多声部合唱。
en: Albanian folk traditions include northern narrative singing and southern polyphony built around a sustained vocal drone.

name: Aleke
zh: 圭亚那地区马龙社群的舞曲，以长鼓合奏和领唱应答形成紧密的节奏循环。
en: Maroon dance music from the Guianas, built on interlocking tall drums and call-and-response singing.

name: Alevi Folk Music
zh: 土耳其阿列维信仰的诗歌演唱，常以长颈鲁特琴伴奏，配合仪式性的旋转舞步。
en: Alevi devotional songs often pair poetic singing with long-necked lute accompaniment and ceremonial turning dances.

name: Algerian Chaabi
zh: 阿尔及尔的城市歌乐，以装饰性独唱、曼多尔琴与手鼓演绎长篇诗句。
en: Algiers urban song featuring ornamented solo vocals, mandole and hand percussion in extended poetic performances.

name: Algorave
zh: 通过现场编写和修改算法生成舞曲，让重复节拍与音色随代码不断变化。
en: Dance music generated through live coding, with repeating beats and timbres changing as performers edit algorithms.

name: Alloukou
zh: 科特迪瓦贝特人的欢庆歌舞，以鼓、敲击声和集体歌唱推进节奏。
en: Celebratory music of Côte d'Ivoire's Bété communities, driven by drums, struck percussion and communal singing.

name: Alpenrock
zh: 把阿尔卑斯民谣、手风琴或约德尔唱法，与电吉他和摇滚节拍结合。
en: Rock combining Alpine folk melodies, accordion or yodeling with electric guitars and a strong backbeat.

name: Alpine Folk Music
zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的民间音乐，常见约德尔唱法、手风琴舞曲与山号长音。
en: Alpine folk traditions include yodeling, accordion-led dances and the sustained calls of long wooden horns.

name: Alsatian Folk Music
zh: 阿尔萨斯地方民谣，融合德法文化中的歌唱传统与波尔卡、华尔兹等社交舞曲。
en: Folk traditions from Alsace blending German and French songs with social dance tunes such as polkas and waltzes.

name: Alt-Country
zh: 保留乡村音乐的叙事、钢棒吉他与土气嗓音，加入独立摇滚或朋克的粗粝感。
en: Country that keeps storytelling, steel guitar and earthy vocals while drawing on indie rock or punk's rougher edges.

name: Alt-Pop
zh: 以流行歌曲的旋律为中心，用不寻常音色、结构或编配偏离主流惯例。
en: Pop built around memorable melodies but distinguished by unusual sounds, structures or arrangements outside mainstream conventions.

name: Altai Music
zh: 阿尔泰地区的传统音乐，常以低沉喉音唱述史诗，配合拨弦琴的反复伴奏。
en: Altai traditional music often uses deep throat-sung epic narration over repeating patterns on plucked string instruments.

name: Alternative Dance
zh: 把另类摇滚的吉他与舞曲鼓机、合成器和循环低音结合，突出可跳舞的律动。
en: Alternative rock combining guitars with dance beats, synthesizers and looping basslines to emphasize movement and groove.

name: Alternative Metal
zh: 以厚重金属吉他为基础，融入另类摇滚的歌曲写法及不拘一格的节奏和唱法。
en: Heavy metal guitars meet alternative rock songwriting, with varied rhythms and vocal styles beyond traditional metal conventions.

name: Alternative R&B
zh: 保留节奏布鲁斯的人声与律动，以留白、朦胧合成器或实验制作扩展声音。
en: R&B that pairs expressive vocals and grooves with sparse arrangements, hazy synthesizers or experimental production.

name: Alternative Rock
zh: 以电吉他和乐队编制为主的摇滚大类，常强调非常规音色与有个性的歌曲表达。
en: A broad guitar-based rock tradition that often favors unconventional textures and distinctive songwriting within a band setting.

name: Alté
zh: 尼日利亚另类流行，把阿非节拍与节奏布鲁斯、独立音乐及实验制作自由融合。
en: Nigerian alternative pop freely blends Afrobeats with R&B, indie influences and experimental production.

name: Amami shimauta
zh: 奄美群岛的方言民歌，以装饰性的高假声和三弦琴伴奏形成鲜明起伏。
en: Amami island songs feature local dialects, highly ornamented falsetto singing and the bright plucking of a three-string lute.

name: Amapiano
zh: 南非浩室舞曲，以松弛碎打击乐、钢琴和滚动的低沉电子木鼓音色见长。
en: South African house with loose, shuffling percussion, piano melodies and deep, rolling log-drum bass.

name: Amazigh Music
zh: 北非阿马齐格人的多种音乐传统，常有集体应答歌唱、框鼓与地方弦乐伴奏。
en: Amazigh musical traditions of North Africa often feature communal responses, frame drums and regional string instruments.

name: Ambasse bey
zh: 喀麦隆的快速民间舞曲，以吉他、刮奏打击乐和活跃节拍带动歌唱。
en: Fast Cameroonian dance music combining guitar, scraped percussion and lively rhythms beneath the vocals.

name: Ambient
zh: 以缓慢铺陈的持续音色与空间感为主，弱化节拍和主旋律的音乐。
en: Music that emphasizes slowly unfolding textures and a sense of space, often softening the role of rhythm and melody.

name: Ambient Americana
zh: 把钢棒吉他、原声拨弦等美式乡村音色，融入缓慢延展的氛围声景。
en: Ambient music that places steel guitar, acoustic strings and other American roots sounds in slowly unfolding soundscapes.

name: Ambient Dub
zh: 用回声、混响和深沉低音，把杜布的混音手法铺成宽阔、缓慢的氛围声景。
en: Ambient soundscapes shaped by dub's deep bass, echo and reverb, with spacious mixes and slowly shifting textures.

name: Ambient House
zh: 以柔和四拍律动承载漂浮合成器和宽阔音场，将浩室舞曲融入氛围音乐。
en: House rhythms softened by floating synthesizers and spacious textures, balancing dance grooves with an ambient atmosphere.

name: Ambient Noise Wall
zh: 以持续、变化极少的柔和噪声堆成声墙，弱化旋律和节奏的存在。
en: A continuous wall of relatively soft noise, with little change and minimal emphasis on melody or rhythm.

name: Ambient Plugg
zh: 把Plugg的轻巧陷阱鼓点，埋入漂浮合成器、混响和朦胧旋律之中。
en: Plugg that surrounds light trap drums with floating synthesizers, heavy reverb and hazy melodic textures.

name: Ambient Pop
zh: 以流行歌曲的旋律和人声为线索，配上持续音垫、混响与缓慢流动的背景。
en: Pop songs whose melodies and vocals sit within sustained pads, reverb and slowly shifting ambient textures.

name: Ambient Techno
zh: 以规律电子节拍和循环音序为骨架，突出宽阔音场与缓慢变化的氛围。
en: Techno built from regular electronic beats and repeating sequences, with spacious textures and slowly evolving atmospheric layers.

name: Ambient Trance
zh: 把恍惚舞曲的循环音序和渐进铺陈放缓、柔化，突出漂浮音垫与空间感。
en: Trance that softens its pulse and gradual builds, emphasizing floating pads, repeating sequences and spacious atmospheric textures.

name: Ambrosian Chant
zh: 米兰礼仪传统中的无伴奏单声部圣咏，以自由流动的旋律演唱拉丁经文。
en: Unaccompanied monophonic chant of the Milanese liturgical tradition, setting Latin sacred texts to freely flowing melodies.

name: American Folk Music
zh: 美国口传民间音乐，涵盖叙事歌、劳动歌与由吉他、班卓琴或小提琴伴奏的舞曲。
en: American folk traditions include ballads, work songs and dance tunes played on guitar, banjo or fiddle.

name: American Gamelan
zh: 用甘美兰乐器与调音观念创作的美国现代音乐，常让敲击音色组成循环结构。
en: American contemporary composition using gamelan instruments and tuning ideas, often arranging resonant percussion into repeating patterns.

name: American Primitivism
zh: 以独奏指弹吉他融合乡村蓝调、民谣和延展结构，强调低音与旋律交错。
en: Solo fingerstyle guitar combining country blues, folk melodies and extended structures, with bass patterns woven around melodic lines.

name: Americana
zh: 汇合乡村、民谣、蓝调与根源摇滚，常以原声乐器和叙事歌曲呈现。
en: American roots music blending country, folk, blues and roots rock, often centered on acoustic instruments and storytelling songs.

name: Amigacore
zh: 以阿米加电脑和音轨软件制作的硬核舞曲，突出粗糙采样、失真底鼓和急促碎拍。
en: Hardcore made with Amiga computers and trackers, featuring gritty samples, distorted kicks and frantic breakbeats.

name: Anarcho-Punk
zh: 强调无政府主义与社会批判的朋克，常以直接喊唱、粗粝吉他和急迫节奏表达。
en: Punk centered on anarchist and social critique, often delivered through direct shouts, rough guitars and urgent rhythms.

name: Anatolian Rock
zh: 把土耳其民间旋律、长颈鲁特琴与电吉他、迷幻摇滚编配结合起来。
en: Turkish rock blending folk melodies and long-necked lute sounds with electric guitars and psychedelic arrangements.

name: Ancient Chinese Music
zh: 依据古代乐器与历史材料呈现中国早期音乐，常见钟磬、管乐和拨弦声。
en: Early Chinese music presented through historical sources and ancient instruments, including bells, stone chimes, winds and plucked strings.

name: Ancient Egyptian Music
zh: 依据图像、乐器与历史材料重建的古埃及音乐，常采用竖琴、里拉琴和管乐。
en: Reconstructions of ancient Egyptian music drawing on historical images and instruments, often using harps, lyres and wind instruments.

name: Ancient Greek Music
zh: 依据古希腊记谱与乐器研究重现的音乐，常以里拉琴、双管和吟唱呈现。
en: Music reconstructed from ancient Greek notation and instrument research, often featuring lyres, double pipes and sung verse.

name: Ancient Levitical Music
zh: 围绕古代犹太圣殿礼仪重建的音乐，常借竖琴、里拉琴和集体歌唱呈现。
en: Reconstructions of ancient Jewish Temple music, often presented through harps, lyres and communal singing.

name: Ancient Music
zh: 依据早期文献、考古乐器与残存记谱，研究和重现古代文明音乐的总称。
en: Music of ancient civilizations explored through historical texts, archaeological instruments and surviving notation, often in reconstructed performances.

name: Ancient Roman Music
zh: 依据考古与历史材料重建的古罗马音乐，常使用里拉琴、管乐和节奏性吟唱。
en: Reconstructions of ancient Roman music using archaeological and historical evidence, often featuring lyres, wind instruments and rhythmic vocal delivery.

name: Andalusian Classical Music
name_zh: 阿拉伯安达卢西亚音乐
zh: 北非的安达卢西亚古典传统，以声乐、弦乐与打击乐串联不同节奏的套曲。
en: North African Andalusian classical music unfolds in suites, combining singing, strings and percussion across changing rhythmic sections.

name: Andalusian Folk Music
zh: 西班牙安达卢西亚的民间歌舞，常以吉他、拍手和富于装饰的演唱相伴。
en: Andalusian folk songs and dances often combine guitar, handclaps and ornamented singing in regional Spanish traditions.

name: Andean New Age
zh: 将安第斯排箫、竖笛等音色放入柔和合成器与舒缓节奏的新世纪音乐。
en: New age music placing Andean panpipes and flutes within soft synthesizer textures and gently flowing rhythms.

name: Anglican Chant
zh: 以和声化的固定旋律诵唱诗篇，随英语经文长短伸缩节奏的圣公会合唱。
en: Anglican choral psalm singing uses harmonized melodic formulas whose rhythms stretch to follow the natural flow of English texts.

name: Animal Sounds
zh: 以动物鸣叫、呼吸及活动声音为主体的实地录音或声音记录。
en: Recordings centered on animal calls, breathing and movement, often captured in natural or field settings.

name: Anti-Folk
zh: 以直白、诙谐或反讽的歌词配合简朴弹唱，带有朋克式随性的民谣。
en: Loosely played folk songs pairing plainspoken, humorous or ironic lyrics with a casual, punk-influenced approach.

name: AOR
zh: 以明亮吉他、键盘和饱满和声打造顺口副歌，制作精致的旋律摇滚。
en: Polished melodic rock with bright guitars, keyboards, full harmonies and big, immediately memorable choruses.

name: Apala
zh: 尼日利亚约鲁巴歌乐，以说话鼓、摇响器和拇指琴托住有节奏的演唱。
en: Yoruba vocal music from Nigeria, supported by talking drums, rattles and the rhythmic pulse of a large thumb piano.

name: Appalachian Folk Music
zh: 美国阿巴拉契亚山区的民间音乐，常以小提琴、班卓琴演奏舞曲并传唱叙事歌。
en: Music from the Appalachian mountains combining fiddle and banjo dance tunes with orally transmitted ballads and other traditional songs.

name: Aquacrunk
zh: 以摇晃碎拍、弹性低音和滑动合成器，呈现带克朗克影响的电子嘻哈。
en: Off-kilter electronic hip hop with lurching drums, elastic bass and sliding synthesizers shaped by crunk influences.

name: Arabesk
zh: 土耳其抒情流行，常以哀婉、装饰繁复的唱腔配上弦乐和中东式旋律。
en: Turkish popular song with plaintive, highly ornamented vocals, sweeping strings and melodies drawing on Middle Eastern traditions.

name: Arabesque Rap
zh: 将土耳其阿拉贝斯克的哀婉唱腔或采样，与说唱和嘻哈节拍结合。
en: Rap combining Turkish arabesk's plaintive singing or sampled melodies with hip-hop beats and spoken verses.

name: Arabic Bellydance Music
zh: 用于阿拉伯肚皮舞的音乐，以清晰的手鼓节奏、旋律装饰和段落变化配合动作。
en: Arabic dance accompaniment with articulate hand-drum rhythms, ornamented melodies and changing sections that follow the dancer's movements.

name: Arabic Classical Music
zh: 以马卡姆调式与节奏循环组织旋律，强调装饰音、细微音高和即兴的阿拉伯古典音乐。
en: Classical Arab music organized through maqam modes and rhythmic cycles, emphasizing ornamentation, subtle pitch inflections, and melodic improvisation.

name: Arabic Folk Music
zh: 阿拉伯各地口传的歌舞传统，常以装饰性独唱、应答合唱和地方器乐呈现。
en: Arabic folk traditions encompass regional songs and dances, often featuring ornamented singing, choral responses and local instruments.

name: Arabic Jazz
zh: 把阿拉伯调式旋律、乌德琴或手鼓，与爵士和声、节奏及即兴结合。
en: Jazz that brings Arabic modal melodies, oud or hand percussion together with jazz harmony, rhythm and improvisation.

name: Arabic Music
zh: 阿拉伯世界的音乐总称，涵盖调式歌乐、地方舞曲、古典传统与现代流行。
en: Music of the Arabic-speaking world, encompassing modal song, regional dances, classical traditions and contemporary popular forms.

name: Arabic Pop
zh: 以阿拉伯语演唱和装饰性旋律，搭配现代流行编曲及电子或传统节奏。
en: Arabic-language pop pairs ornamented melodies and singing with modern arrangements and electronic or traditional rhythms.

name: Aragonese Folk Music
zh: 西班牙阿拉贡的民间歌舞，以高亢演唱、拨弦伴奏和霍塔舞曲为代表。
en: Folk songs and dances from Aragón, featuring projected singing, plucked-string accompaniment, and the lively rhythms of jota.

name: Argentine Music
zh: 阿根廷的音乐总称，从探戈的手风琴音色到民间吉他歌舞和现代流行。
en: Music of Argentina spans tango's bandoneon, regional guitar-based songs and dances, and contemporary popular styles.

name: Armenian Church Music
name_zh: 亚美尼亚教会礼仪音乐
zh: 亚美尼亚基督教礼仪歌乐，以古老圣咏旋律与延展的人声乐句为核心。
en: Armenian Christian liturgical music centers on chant melodies and long, flowing vocal phrases.

name: Armenian Folk Music
zh: 亚美尼亚民间歌舞，常以杜杜克管的柔哑长音或唢呐、鼓声伴奏。
en: Armenian folk songs and dances often feature the soft, reedy duduk or the sharper combination of shawm and drum.

name: Armenian Music
zh: 亚美尼亚的音乐传统，涵盖圣咏、吟游歌乐与带杜杜克管音色的器乐。
en: Armenian musical traditions include sacred chant, bardic song and instrumental music featuring the breathy, reedy duduk.

name: Aromanian Folk Music
zh: 巴尔干阿罗马尼亚人的民间音乐，涵盖方言叙事歌、多声部演唱与地方舞曲。
en: Aromanian folk traditions of the Balkans include vernacular narrative songs, multipart singing and regional dance music.

name: Arrocha
zh: 巴西巴伊亚的贴身舞曲，以键盘、电子鼓和萨克斯衬托抒情演唱。
en: Romantic dance music from Bahia, Brazil, often featuring keyboards, electronic drums and saxophone beneath expressive vocals.

name: Arrocha funk
zh: 把阿罗恰的抒情旋律与巴西放克的切分鼓点、低音和舞池唱句结合。
en: Arrocha melodies meet Brazilian funk's syncopated percussion, heavy bass and dancefloor-ready vocal phrases.

name: Arrocha sertanejo
zh: 在巴西乡村流行的演唱和歌曲中，加入阿罗恰摇摆、紧贴舞步的节奏。
en: Brazilian sertanejo songs and vocals are set to arrocha's swaying, close-dance rhythms.

name: Arrochadeira
zh: 把阿罗恰的顺口唱句与巴伊亚帕戈当的密集打击乐结合，强调快速舞动。
en: Arrocha's catchy vocals combine with Bahian pagodão percussion in a brisk, rhythm-heavy dance style.

name: Ars antiqua
zh: 欧洲中世纪早期复调音乐，常让固定圣咏声部与上方新旋律交织。
en: Early medieval European polyphony often weaves new melodic voices above a sustained or recurring chant foundation.

name: Ars nova
zh: 以更灵活的节奏记谱与独立声部，扩展中世纪复调圣乐和世俗歌曲。
en: Medieval polyphonic music with more flexible rhythmic notation and independent vocal parts in both sacred and secular works.

name: Ars subtilior
zh: 中世纪晚期的精细复调音乐，以复杂切分、声部错位和多层节奏著称。
en: Late medieval polyphony marked by intricate syncopation, displaced accents and complex layers of rhythm between the voices.

name: Art Pop
zh: 以流行旋律为基础，借实验编配、声音设计或概念构思扩展歌曲表达。
en: Pop that extends melodic songwriting through experimental arrangements, sound design or a strong conceptual approach.

name: Art Punk
zh: 保留朋克的直接冲劲，用不寻常节奏、结构和吉他音色展开实验。
en: Punk's direct energy is reshaped through unusual rhythms, unconventional structures and exploratory guitar sounds.

name: Art Rock
zh: 把摇滚与更讲究的结构、实验音色或跨艺术构思结合，编排常有明显变化。
en: Rock shaped by elaborate structures, experimental textures or ideas from other arts, often with shifting and carefully developed arrangements.

name: Art Song
zh: 为独唱与伴奏写作的古典歌曲，让诗词、旋律与器乐声部共同表达情感。
en: Classical songs for solo voice and accompaniment, closely connecting poetry, vocal melody and expressive instrumental writing.

name: Artcore
zh: 把快速电子鼓点与钢琴、弦乐等戏剧性旋律结合，常见于日本音乐游戏文化。
en: Fast electronic music pairing driving drums with dramatic piano and string melodies, closely associated with Japanese rhythm-game culture.

name: Ashkenazi Cantorial Music
zh: 阿什肯纳兹犹太礼仪中的领唱艺术，以自由节奏、装饰音与宽广音域诠释祷文。
en: Ashkenazi Jewish cantorial singing interprets prayer through flexible rhythms, elaborate ornamentation and a wide vocal range.

name: Ashkenazi Music
zh: 阿什肯纳兹犹太音乐传统，涵盖意第绪语歌曲、克莱兹默舞乐与装饰繁复的祷文领唱。
en: Ashkenazi Jewish traditions include Yiddish song, klezmer dance music and richly ornamented cantorial prayer.

name: Asian Music
zh: 亚洲各地区音乐的总称，涵盖不同调式、节奏、器乐编制与歌唱传统。
en: Music from across Asia, encompassing diverse systems of melody, rhythm, instrumentation and vocal tradition.

name: Asian Rock
zh: PluggnB的分支，以密集打击乐、军鼓滚奏和明亮吉他旋律见长。
en: A pluggnB style distinguished by dense percussion, rolling snares and bright, often soaring guitar melodies.

name: ASMR
zh: 突出耳语、轻敲、摩擦等近距离细声的录音，重视声音质感和亲近感。
en: Recordings emphasizing close-up whispers, tapping, brushing and other quiet sounds, with attention to texture and intimacy.

name: Assamese Folk Music
zh: 印度阿萨姆的民间音乐，涵盖比胡歌舞、劳动歌与鼓、笛等地方器乐传统。
en: Assamese folk music includes bihu songs and dances, work songs and regional traditions of drums and flutes.

name: Assiko
zh: 喀麦隆的快速舞曲，以灵巧吉他弹奏和敲击瓶子的节奏伴随歌唱。
en: Fast Cameroonian dance music built around agile guitar playing, singing and percussion tapped on bottles.

name: Assyrian Folk Music
zh: 亚述人的民间歌舞，以阿拉姆语歌唱与清晰反复的节奏伴随集体舞蹈。
en: Assyrian folk songs and dances combine Aramaic-language singing with repeating rhythms suited to communal dancing.

name: Asturian Folk Music
name_zh: 阿斯图里亚斯民间音乐
zh: 西班牙阿斯图里亚斯的民间音乐，常见风笛、手鼓及装饰繁复的高亢独唱。
en: Asturian folk music often features bagpipes, hand percussion and powerful solo singing with elaborate melodic ornamentation.

name: Athabaskan Fiddling
zh: 阿拉斯加与加拿大阿萨巴斯卡人的小提琴舞乐，把外来舞曲旋律改造成地方节奏。
en: Athabaskan fiddle music from Alaska and Canada reshapes introduced dance tunes with local rhythmic phrasing and performance traditions.

name: Atlanta Bass
zh: 亚特兰大的低音说唱舞曲，以厚重电子低音、直白喊唱和强烈鼓机节拍为主。
en: Atlanta dance rap driven by heavy electronic bass, chant-like vocals and forceful drum-machine patterns.

name: Atmospheric Black Metal
zh: 以反复震音吉他、远置嘶吼和长篇铺陈，营造宽阔或幽暗声景的黑金属。
en: Black metal using repeating tremolo guitars, distant screams and long arrangements to create expansive or shadowy atmospheres.

name: Atmospheric Drum and Bass
zh: 在快速碎拍和低音之上铺开空气感音垫、柔和旋律及宽阔混响。
en: Drum and bass layering rapid breakbeats and bass beneath airy pads, gentle melodies and spacious reverb.

name: Atmospheric Sludge Metal
zh: 以缓慢厚重的污泥金属音色，配合长篇渐进、安静段落与爆发式高潮。
en: Heavy, slow sludge metal shaped by extended builds, quiet passages and climactic eruptions of distorted sound.

name: Audio Documentary
zh: 以采访、现场录音和旁白讲述真实人物或事件的声音作品。
en: Audio storytelling about real people or events, assembled from interviews, location recordings and spoken narration.

name: Australian Folk Music
zh: 澳大利亚口传民间音乐，常以叙事歌曲、小提琴和手风琴记录乡野生活。
en: Australian folk traditions often recount rural life through narrative songs, fiddle tunes and accordion-led dance music.

name: Austronesian Music
zh: 南岛语族社群的音乐总称，涵盖海岛歌唱、锣乐、弦乐与多种地方节奏。
en: Music of Austronesian-speaking communities, encompassing island vocal traditions, gong ensembles, strings and many distinct regional rhythms.

name: Autonomic
zh: 以稀疏、常呈半速感的鼓点和细腻合成器，把鼓打贝斯写得克制而开阔。
en: Drum and bass with sparse, often half-time-feeling drums and delicate synthesizers, leaving generous space around the rhythm.

name: Auvergnat Folk Music
zh: 法国奥弗涅的民间歌舞，常以卡布雷特风笛、手风琴和布雷舞曲见长。
en: Auvergnat folk music often features cabrette bagpipes, accordion and the lilting rhythms of bourrée dances.

name: Avant-Folk
zh: 以民谣乐器或歌曲为起点，加入即兴、噪声、另类结构或陌生演奏手法。
en: Folk-based music that explores improvisation, noise, unusual structures or unfamiliar ways of playing acoustic instruments.

name: Avant-Garde Jazz
zh: 从爵士出发探索不协和音、自由结构和非常规演奏，重新安排即兴与合奏关系。
en: Jazz exploring dissonance, open forms and unconventional playing techniques, reshaping the relationship between improvisation and ensemble performance.

name: Avant-Garde Metal
zh: 在金属的失真与重量中加入非常规结构、异质乐器或实验唱法。
en: Metal that expands its distorted, heavy foundation through unconventional structures, unexpected instruments and experimental vocal approaches.

name: Avant-Prog
zh: 把前卫摇滚的复杂结构与不协和音、突变节奏和室内乐式编配结合。
en: Progressive rock with dissonant harmonies, abrupt rhythmic shifts and chamber-like arrangements that challenge conventional song forms.

name: Avanzada
zh: 融合巴拉圭波尔卡与瓜拉尼亚，常加入电子乐器和巴西流行音乐的节奏色彩。
en: Paraguayan music blending polca and guarania, often adding electronic instruments and rhythmic influences from Brazilian popular music.

name: Avar Folk Music
zh: 达吉斯坦阿瓦尔人的民间音乐，常以潘杜尔拨弦琴伴唱情歌与叙事歌。
en: Avar folk music from Dagestan often pairs love songs and narrative singing with the plucked pandur lute.

name: Avtorskaya pesnya
zh: 以歌词和个人叙述为中心的俄语作者歌曲，常由歌者自弹吉他伴唱。
en: Russian-language author songs centered on lyrics and personal storytelling, commonly sung with the performer's own acoustic guitar accompaniment.

name: Axé
zh: 巴西巴伊亚的狂欢节流行舞曲，以强劲打击乐和朗朗上口的合唱推动舞步。
en: Bahian carnival pop driven by powerful percussion, lively dance rhythms and choruses made for communal singing.

name: Ayyalah
zh: 阿曼与阿联酋的集体仪式歌舞，以列队应答合唱配合鼓声与整齐动作。
en: Communal performance from Oman and the UAE combines answering rows of singers with drums and synchronized movement.

name: Azerbaijani Mugham
zh: 阿塞拜疆的调式音乐，以装饰性独唱和器乐即兴，在固定旋律框架中展开。
en: Azerbaijani modal music unfolds through ornamented singing and instrumental improvisation within established melodic frameworks.

name: Azerbaijani Music
zh: 阿塞拜疆的音乐传统，涵盖木卡姆即兴、吟游诗人的弹唱及节奏鲜明的舞曲。
en: Azerbaijani music includes mugham improvisation, bardic singing with plucked strings and rhythmically vivid dance traditions.

name: Azmari
zh: 埃塞俄比亚吟游歌者的音乐，常自拉单弦琴，以即兴诗句赞颂、调侃或评论世事。
en: Ethiopian bardic singing often uses a one-string fiddle to accompany improvised verses of praise, satire and social commentary.

name: Bacardi
zh: 比勒陀利亚的舞曲，以粗粝、密集的打击乐和反复低音突出快速舞步。
en: Pretoria dance music with raw, busy percussion and repeating bass patterns that drive quick, energetic movement.

name: Bachata
zh: 多米尼加的吉他舞曲，以明亮装饰性主音、邦戈鼓和刮奏器衬托情歌。
en: Dominican dance music pairing bright, ornamented lead guitar with bongos, scraped percussion and romantic singing.

name: Bachatón
zh: 把巴恰塔的吉他旋律与情歌唱腔，融入雷鬼顿反复、重低音的舞曲节奏。
en: Bachata guitar melodies and romantic vocals meet reggaetón's repeating dance rhythms and heavy bass.

name: Bagad
zh: 布列塔尼的风笛乐队，以风笛、邦巴德双簧管和鼓队合奏舞曲或进行曲。
en: Breton ensembles of bagpipes, bombarde shawms and drums play powerful, coordinated dance tunes and marches.

name: Baganda Music
zh: 乌干达巴干达人的音乐，常见交错木琴、鼓乐，以及竖琴或里拉琴伴唱。
en: Baganda music from Uganda includes interlocking xylophones, drumming and singing accompanied by harps or lyres.

name: Bagatelle
zh: 篇幅短小的古典器乐小品，常以钢琴围绕一个鲜明旋律或音乐念头展开。
en: Short classical instrumental pieces, often for piano, built around a concise melody or a single musical idea.

name: Baggy
zh: 把独立摇滚、迷幻吉他与放克式贝斯和摇摆舞曲节奏结合的英国声音。
en: British indie rock combining psychedelic guitars with funky basslines and loose, shuffling dance rhythms.

name: Baguala
zh: 阿根廷西北部的高亢民歌，以少量音高和拉长乐句配合手鼓敲击。
en: Northwestern Argentine singing uses a narrow set of pitches and long, projected phrases over a hand-played drum.

name: Baila
zh: 斯里兰卡的轻快社交舞曲，以跳跃节奏、顺口合唱融合葡萄牙与地方音乐传统。
en: Lively Sri Lankan dance songs combine bouncing rhythms and catchy choruses with Portuguese and local musical influences.

name: Bailecito
zh: 玻利维亚及阿根廷北部的民间舞曲，以轻快复合节拍配合吉他或小型弦乐。
en: Folk dance music from Bolivia and northern Argentina, with lilting compound rhythms played on guitars and other small string instruments.

name: Baisha xiyue
zh: 云南纳西族的白沙细乐，以笛管和弦乐交织成舒缓、带歌舞性质的套曲。
en: Naxi ensemble music from Yunnan combines flutes, pipes and strings in measured suites associated with song and dance.

name: Baithak gana
zh: 苏里南印度裔社群的歌曲，以簧风琴、双面鼓和金属击杆伴随演唱。
en: Indo-Surinamese songs accompanied by harmonium, dholak drums and the ringing metallic pulse of a struck iron rod.

name: Baião
zh: 巴西东北部舞曲，以手风琴旋律、低音大鼓和三角铁形成跳动的双拍律动。
en: Northeastern Brazilian dance music with accordion melodies, bass drum and triangle creating a buoyant duple groove.

name: Bakersfield Sound
zh: 以明亮电吉他、钢棒吉他和结实鼓点，呈现直接、有冲劲的加州乡村音乐。
en: California country with bright electric guitars, steel guitar and a firm backbeat, giving the songs a lean, driving sound.

name: Balani Show
zh: 马里的电子街头舞曲，把巴拉丰旋律与快速鼓机、镲声和哨音叠加。
en: Malian electronic street-party music layering balafon melodies with rapid programmed drums, crashing cymbals and whistles.

name: Balearic Beat
zh: 伊维萨舞池的兼容式声音，以松弛律动串联浩室、迪斯科、流行与原声元素。
en: An Ibiza-rooted dance sound that brings house, disco, pop and acoustic elements together through relaxed, flowing grooves.

name: Balearic Trance
zh: 以明亮旋律、宽阔音垫和渐进高潮，营造海岛式开阔感的恍惚舞曲。
en: Trance with bright melodies, spacious pads and gradual builds that evoke an open, sunlit dancefloor atmosphere.

name: Balinese Gamelan
zh: 巴厘岛甘美兰，以金属打击乐快速交错的声部、强烈力度变化和锣声构成。
en: Rapidly interlocking metal percussion, dramatic dynamic shifts, and resonant gong punctuation shape this Balinese ensemble tradition.

name: Balinese Music
zh: 巴厘岛的音乐传统，涵盖金属甘美兰合奏、集体吟唱及配合仪式舞剧的器乐。
en: Balinese musical traditions include metal gamelan ensembles, group chanting and instrumental accompaniment for ritual dance and theatre.

name: Balitaw
zh: 菲律宾维萨亚的对唱传统，以即兴诗句和轻快伴奏，呈现男女间的求爱问答。
en: Visayan courtship songs from the Philippines use improvised verses and lively accompaniment in exchanges between male and female singers.

name: Balkan Brass Band
zh: 巴尔干铜管乐队以小号、低音铜管和大鼓演奏急促、装饰繁多的舞曲。
en: Balkan brass ensembles play fast, highly ornamented dance tunes with trumpets, low brass and pounding drums.

name: Balkan Folk Music
zh: 巴尔干的民间歌舞传统，常见不均分节拍、装饰性旋律及有棱角的合唱音程。
en: Balkan folk traditions often feature uneven meters, ornamented melodies and striking intervals in multipart singing.

name: Balkan Music
zh: 巴尔干地区的音乐总称，涵盖地方民谣、铜管舞曲与融合电子制作的流行音乐。
en: Music of the Balkans encompasses regional folk traditions, brass-band dances and popular styles incorporating electronic production.

name: Balkan Pop-Folk
zh: 把巴尔干民间旋律和装饰唱腔，与合成器、电子节拍和流行歌曲结构结合。
en: Pop combining Balkan folk melodies and ornamented vocals with synthesizers, electronic beats and accessible song structures.

name: Ballad Opera
zh: 以对白串联熟悉歌曲和新填歌词的英语舞台作品，常带讽刺或喜剧色彩。
en: English-language stage works link familiar tunes and newly written lyrics with spoken dialogue, often using satire or comedy.

name: Ballet
zh: 为芭蕾舞动作和剧情创作的音乐，以节奏、乐句和配器支撑舞蹈。
en: Music written for ballet, shaping rhythm, phrasing and orchestration around dance movement and theatrical storytelling.

name: Ballet de cour
zh: 法国宫廷的舞蹈剧场音乐，将歌唱、器乐和分段舞蹈编入华丽舞台演出。
en: French court entertainment combining vocal music, instrumental passages and successive dances in elaborate theatrical performances.

name: Ballroom
zh: 纽约舞厅文化的浩室舞曲，以猛烈重拍、人声口令和切碎音效配合沃金舞。
en: House rooted in ballroom culture, with hard accents, vocal commands and chopped effects designed for voguing.

name: Balochi Music
zh: 俾路支人的音乐传统，常以苏鲁德擦弦琴、班卓式键弦琴和打击乐伴随歌唱。
en: Balochi musical traditions often accompany singing with the bowed suroz, keyed benju zither and percussion.

name: Baltic Folk Music
zh: 波罗的海地区的民间音乐，涵盖多声部歌唱、齐特琴弹奏和节奏鲜明的舞曲。
en: Baltic folk traditions include multipart singing, plucked zithers and regional dance tunes with clearly marked rhythms.

name: Baltimore Club
zh: 以急促碎拍、反复人声短句和重低音，将浩室与嘻哈采样压成直接的舞曲。
en: Baltimore dance music fuses house and hip-hop samples through brisk breakbeats, repeated vocal snippets and heavy bass.

name: Balto-Finnic Folk Music
zh: 波罗的芬兰语族的民间音乐，常见反复吟唱的诗歌、拨弦琴与地方舞曲。
en: Balto-Finnic folk traditions include repetitive sung poetry, plucked zithers and regionally distinct dance music.

name: Bamar Folk Music
zh: 缅族的民间歌舞，常以鼓、锣和双簧管的鲜明音色伴随演唱与戏剧表演。
en: Bamar folk songs and dances often use drums, gongs and bright double-reed instruments alongside singing and theatrical performance.

name: Bamar Music
zh: 缅族的音乐传统，从弯琴伴唱到围鼓、锣和管乐组成的热闹合奏。
en: Bamar musical traditions range from arched-harp-accompanied song to lively ensembles of tuned drums, gongs and wind instruments.

name: Bambuco
zh: 哥伦比亚安第斯地区的歌舞，以吉他、蒂普莱琴和交错的双三拍律动见长。
en: Colombian Andean songs and dances often feature guitar and tiple with a rhythmic interplay between duple and triple groupings.

name: Banda de pífano
zh: 巴西东北部的民间乐队，以竹笛重叠旋律，配上军鼓、大鼓与镲声。
en: Northeastern Brazilian folk ensembles layer bamboo-fife melodies over snare drums, bass drums and cymbals.

name: Banda Music
zh: 中非班达人的音乐，尤以不同音高的号管交替发声、织成复调合奏见长。
en: Music of Central Africa's Banda communities, especially horn ensembles whose alternating notes interlock into elaborate polyphonic patterns.

name: Banda sinaloense
zh: 墨西哥锡那罗亚的管乐舞曲，以明亮小号、单簧管、低音铜管和打击乐合奏。
en: Sinaloan Mexican band music combines bright trumpets, clarinets, low brass and percussion in lively, full-bodied dance arrangements.

name: Bandari
zh: 伊朗南部港口的舞曲，以摇摆复合节拍、密集打击乐和富于装饰的旋律见长。
en: Southern Iranian coastal dance music with swinging compound rhythms, busy percussion and ornamented melodies.

name: Bandas de viento de México
name_zh: Bandas de viento de México音乐
zh: 墨西哥的地方管乐乐队传统，以铜管、木管和鼓演奏舞曲、进行曲与歌曲。
en: Mexican regional wind-band traditions use brass, woodwinds and drums for dances, marches and song arrangements.

name: Bandinha
zh: 巴西南部的地方舞曲乐队，以铜管、手风琴和鼓演奏受德语区传统影响的曲目。
en: Southern Brazilian dance bands use brass, accordion and drums in repertoire shaped by German-speaking immigrant traditions.

name: Banga
zh: 突尼斯南部的苏菲仪式音乐，以反复歌唱、鼓声和金属打击声推动集体舞动。
en: Southern Tunisian Sufi ritual music uses repeating chants, drums and metallic percussion to sustain communal movement.

name: Bantengan
zh: 东爪哇牛形面具舞的伴奏音乐，以反复鼓点、锣声与加速段落配合表演。
en: Music for East Javanese bull-mask performances, using repeating drum patterns, gongs and accelerating sections to accompany the action.

name: Baqashot
zh: 塞法迪与东方犹太社群的祈愿歌，以集体演唱的宗教诗歌串联调式旋律。
en: Jewish petition songs from Sephardic and Mizrahi traditions, arranging sacred poetry in communal, modally organized singing.

name: Barber Beats
zh: 把爵士、休闲电子或慢拍采样放慢并循环，形成光滑、朦胧的器乐节拍。
en: Sample-based downtempo music that slows and loops jazz or lounge material into smooth, hazy instrumental grooves.

name: Barbershop
zh: 四个声部无伴奏紧密和声演唱，以旋律、低音和内声部共同形成明亮共鸣。
en: Unaccompanied four-part singing uses close harmonies and carefully balanced voices to create a bright, ringing blend.

name: Bard Rock
zh: 把俄语作者歌曲的叙事与诗意歌词，扩展到电吉他、贝斯和鼓的摇滚编制。
en: Russian bard-song storytelling and poetic lyrics expanded into rock arrangements with electric guitar, bass and drums.

name: Bardcore
zh: 用鲁特琴、笛子等仿古音色重新演绎流行歌曲，营造中世纪酒馆般的听感。
en: Familiar pop songs reworked with lute-like strings, flutes and other early-music sounds to suggest a medieval tavern setting.

name: Baroque Music
zh: 以通奏低音、装饰旋律和声部对比为常见特征的欧洲巴洛克古典音乐。
en: European Baroque music often features continuo bass, ornamented melodies and contrasts between instrumental or vocal parts.

name: Baroque Pop
zh: 在流行歌曲中加入羽管键琴、弦乐和古典式编配，使旋律更精细、层次更分明。
en: Pop songs enriched with harpsichord, strings and classically influenced arrangements that give the melodies a finely detailed setting.

name: Baroque Suite
zh: 由不同速度和节拍的舞曲组成的巴洛克组曲，通常围绕共同调性展开。
en: Baroque suites link dances with contrasting tempos and meters, usually organized around a shared key.

name: Bashkir Folk Music
zh: 巴什基尔的民间音乐，常以悠长独唱、库拉伊笛和口簧呈现草原旋律。
en: Bashkir folk traditions often feature long vocal melodies, the breathy kurai flute and the buzzing sound of mouth harps.

name: Bashment Soca
zh: 巴巴多斯的索卡舞曲，把舞厅雷鬼的唱说、厚重低音与强劲节拍结合。
en: Barbadian soca combining dancehall-style vocal delivery and heavy bass with forceful, dance-driven rhythms.

name: Basque Folk Music
zh: 巴斯克民间音乐，常见短笛配鼓、手风琴舞曲及即兴诗歌对唱。
en: Basque folk traditions include pipe-and-drum music, accordion-led dances and improvised sung poetry.

name: Bass House
zh: 以厚重、扭曲的低音音色和明确的四拍底鼓，突出顿挫起伏的浩室舞曲。
en: House built around thick, distorted bass sounds and a firm four-on-the-floor kick, with sharply accented rhythmic drops.

name: Bassline
zh: 以弹跳、滑动的重低音和四拍底鼓为重心，常加入切片人声的英国舞曲。
en: British dance music centered on bouncing, sliding basslines and four-on-the-floor drums, often with chopped vocal samples.

name: Batak Music
zh: 苏门答腊巴塔克人的音乐传统，涵盖鼓锣合奏、双簧管旋律与多声部歌唱。
en: Batak musical traditions of Sumatra include drum-and-gong ensembles, double-reed melodies and multipart singing.

name: Batida
zh: 里斯本非洲裔舞池的电子音乐，以安哥拉节奏、碎切采样和紧凑打击乐构成。
en: Lisbon's Afro-diasporic club music reshapes Angolan rhythms through chopped samples and tightly interlocking electronic percussion.

name: Batidão romântico
zh: 把巴西布雷加放克的节拍与基宗巴的摇摆感结合，突出柔和、浪漫的人声旋律。
en: Brazilian dance music blends brega-funk beats with kizomba's sway, emphasizing soft, romantic vocal melodies.

name: Batonebi Song
zh: 格鲁吉亚传统的病榻祈愿歌，以轻柔、相互交织的声部安抚病人与仪式中的神灵。
en: Gentle Georgian healing songs use interwoven voices in bedside rituals intended to soothe patients and appease spiritual beings.

name: Battle Rap
zh: 以押韵、机智反击和直接针对对手的歌词展开竞技的说唱。
en: Competitive rap built around rhymed challenges, sharp rebuttals and lyrics directly aimed at an opponent.

name: Battle Record
zh: 供唱盘手刮碟与对战使用的素材唱片，收录短人声、鼓点和便于循环的音效。
en: Records made for turntablist battles, collecting short vocal phrases, drum sounds and loop-friendly effects for scratching.

name: Batucada
zh: 以大鼓、军鼓、摇响器等组成的桑巴打击乐合奏，声部密集交错。
en: Samba percussion ensembles weave bass drums, snares, shakers and other instruments into dense, interlocking rhythmic patterns.

name: Batuque
zh: 佛得角的应答歌舞，以拍手和敲击布垫等反复节奏托住领唱。
en: Cape Verdean call-and-response music supports a lead singer with handclaps and repeating percussion, often struck on bundled cloth.

name: Baul gaan
zh: 孟加拉鲍尔行者的灵性歌曲，常以单弦琴与手鼓伴唱，表达内在修行。
en: Bengali Baul spiritual songs explore inner devotion, often accompanied by a one-string instrument and hand percussion.

name: Bayawan
zh: 维吾尔刀郎木卡姆，以高亢歌唱、弦乐和手鼓串联逐渐推进的歌舞段落。
en: Uyghur Dolan muqam combines forceful singing, string instruments and frame drums in connected, progressively unfolding song-and-dance sections.

name: Beach Music
zh: 美国卡罗来纳沿海的舞池音乐，常以平顺节奏布鲁斯、灵魂乐和摇摆节拍伴舞。
en: Carolina coastal dance music draws on smooth R&B and soul, with swinging rhythms suited to shag dancing.

name: Beat
zh: 以电吉他乐队、鲜明反拍和朗朗上口的合唱，演奏简洁直接的早期英国流行摇滚。
en: Early British guitar-band pop with a strong backbeat, catchy vocal harmonies and concise, direct song structures.

name: Beat bolha
zh: 以水泡般的合成音或采样构成反复节奏，搭配低音和唱句的巴西放克。
en: Brazilian funk using bubbling, watery sounds as repeating rhythmic hooks alongside bass and vocal phrases.

name: Beat bruxaria
zh: 把巴西放克鼓点推向刺耳失真，以尖啸循环、粗糙采样和重低音制造压迫感。
en: Brazilian funk with abrasive distortion, shrill repeating sounds, rough samples and heavy bass pushing the percussion to extremes.

name: Beat fino
zh: 巴西圣埃斯皮里图州的放克，以尖细金属音色、快速节拍和重低音形成对比。
en: Funk from Espírito Santo contrasts thin, metallic high tones with quick percussion and heavy low-end beats.

name: Beat Poetry
zh: 垮掉派的诗歌朗诵，重视口语节奏、即兴感和自由联想，有时配合爵士伴奏。
en: Beat-generation poetry performed with conversational rhythms, spontaneous delivery and free association, sometimes accompanied by jazz.

name: Beat Rock
zh: 日本的节拍摇滚，以紧凑吉他切奏、强烈鼓点和流行旋律结合新浪潮影响。
en: Japanese rock combining tight rhythmic guitar, a strong backbeat and catchy melodies with new-wave influences.

name: Beatboxing
zh: 用嘴、舌头和呼吸模仿鼓、贝斯及音效，把人声变成节奏乐器。
en: Vocal performance using the mouth, tongue and breath to imitate drums, basslines and other rhythmic sounds.

name: Beatdown Hardcore
zh: 以缓慢沉重的分解段、低沉吉他和集体喊唱，强调身体冲击的硬核朋克。
en: Hardcore punk emphasizing slow, crushing breakdowns, low guitar riffs and shouted group vocals.

name: Bebop
zh: 以快速旋律、复杂和声与灵活即兴为核心，鼓和低音不断回应独奏的爵士。
en: Jazz built on fast melodies, intricate harmonies and agile improvisation, with drums and bass actively responding to soloists.

name: Bedoui wahrani
zh: 阿尔及利亚奥兰地区的乡野诗歌演唱，以高亢嗓音、芦笛和框鼓相伴。
en: Rural poetic singing from Algeria's Oran region, featuring projected vocals with reed flutes and frame drums.

name: Bedouin Music
zh: 阿拉伯贝都因人的音乐传统，涵盖叙事吟唱、诗歌应答与手鼓或单弦琴伴奏。
en: Bedouin musical traditions include narrative chanting, poetic exchanges and singing accompanied by frame drums or one-string fiddles.

name: Bedroom Pop
zh: 常在居家环境制作的独立流行，以亲近的人声、简朴编配或柔焦音色呈现歌曲。
en: Intimate indie pop often made at home, with close vocals, modest arrangements and softly blurred production textures.

name: Beja Music
zh: 红海沿岸贝贾人的音乐，常以反复拨弦旋律、切分节奏和地方歌唱传统为基础。
en: Beja music from the Red Sea region often centers on repeating plucked melodies, syncopated rhythms and local vocal traditions.

name: Belarusian Folk Music
zh: 白俄罗斯的民间歌曲与舞曲，涵盖季节仪式歌、多声部合唱和地方器乐。
en: Belarusian folk music includes seasonal ritual songs, multipart singing and regional instrumental dance traditions.

name: Bele
zh: 马提尼克的传统歌舞，以鼓、木棍敲击和领唱应答配合富于摆动的舞步。
en: Martinican dance music combines drumming, struck sticks and call-and-response singing with strongly swaying rhythms.

name: Belgian Techno
zh: 以沉重底鼓、刺耳合成器短句和警笛般音色，推动早期比利时锐舞舞池。
en: Belgian rave techno driven by heavy kicks, abrasive synthesizer stabs and blaring, siren-like tones.

name: Belwo
zh: 索马里的短篇歌诗，以简短情感诗句、清楚旋律和鼓伴奏表达爱恋与思念。
en: Short Somali sung poems express love and longing through concise verses, clear melodies and drum accompaniment.

name: Bend-skin
zh: 喀麦隆的街头舞曲，以快速、重拍鲜明的打击乐和呼喊应答带动身体动作。
en: Cameroonian dance music driven by fast, strongly accented percussion and shouted vocal exchanges.

name: Benga
zh: 肯尼亚的吉他舞曲，以明亮高音主奏、活跃低音和紧密交错的循环节奏见长。
en: Kenyan guitar dance music with bright high-register leads, active basslines and tightly interlocking rhythmic patterns.

name: Bengali Folk Music
zh: 孟加拉地区的民间音乐，涵盖河上歌、劳作歌和由拨弦乐器、鼓伴奏的灵性歌曲。
en: Bengali folk traditions include river songs, work songs and spiritual singing accompanied by plucked strings and drums.

name: Beni
zh: 东非的铜管歌舞，把军乐队的号声与鼓点改造成地方舞步和集体表演。
en: East African brass-band dance music adapts military-style horns and drums to local movement and communal performance.

name: Benna
zh: 安提瓜与巴布达的民间歌唱，以应答副歌和即兴歌词评论日常、传播消息。
en: Antiguan and Barbudan folk songs use call-and-response refrains and improvised verses to share news and comment on everyday life.

name: Bentonia School
zh: 密西西比本托尼亚的蓝调，以小调感调弦、幽暗吉他和高而悠长的唱腔见长。
en: Bentonia blues from Mississippi features minor-sounding guitar tunings, shadowy fingerpicking and high, sustained vocal phrases.

name: Beompae
zh: 韩国佛教仪式梵呗，以缓慢延音、装饰性旋律和僧侣诵唱呈现经文。
en: Korean Buddhist ritual chant sets sacred texts in slow, sustained and ornamented vocal phrases.

name: Berlin School
zh: 以模拟合成器的循环音序为骨架，让音垫、旋律和音色在长篇段落中逐渐变化。
en: Electronic music built around repeating synthesizer sequences, with pads, melodies and timbres gradually developing over long passages.

name: Bhajan
zh: 印度教的虔敬歌曲，常以易于跟唱的旋律、应答人声和简单器乐歌颂神祇。
en: Hindu devotional songs often use accessible melodies, responding voices and simple accompaniment to praise deities.

name: Bhangra
zh: 旁遮普的欢庆舞曲，以双面大鼓的弹跳节奏、响亮唱腔和短促旋律带动群舞。
en: Punjabi celebratory dance music driven by bouncing dhol rhythms, projected vocals and short, energetic melodic phrases.

name: Bhojpuri Folk Music
zh: 博杰普里语地区的民间歌唱，涵盖婚礼、季节与离乡主题，常以双面鼓伴奏。
en: Bhojpuri folk songs address weddings, seasons and separation, often supported by dholak drums and communal singing.

name: Big Band
zh: 由萨克斯、铜管和节奏组组成的爵士大乐队，在分部合奏与个人独奏间切换。
en: Large jazz ensembles organize saxophones, brass and a rhythm section into coordinated sectional passages and featured solos.

name: Big Beat
zh: 以厚重碎拍、放克采样、摇滚吉他或合成器短句构成的高能电子舞曲。
en: Electronic dance music built from heavy breakbeats, funk samples and bold guitar or synthesizer hooks.

name: Big Music
zh: 以宽阔混响、响亮吉他和昂扬合唱，营造宏大、开阔听感的流行摇滚。
en: Anthemic pop rock with expansive reverb, ringing guitars and soaring choruses designed for a large, open sound.

name: Big Room House
zh: 为大型舞池设计的浩室，以简短合成器钩子、巨大铺垫和重拍落点为核心。
en: Festival-oriented house built around short synthesizer hooks, large buildups and powerful, sharply defined drops.

name: Big Room Trance
zh: 把恍惚舞曲的旋律铺陈与大型舞池的重型底鼓、简洁落点结合。
en: Trance combining melodic buildups with heavy festival-sized kicks and simple, forceful drops.

name: Biguine
zh: 法属加勒比的克里奥尔舞曲，以切分节奏、单簧管旋律和铜管应答形成摇摆感。
en: French Caribbean Creole dance music with syncopated rhythms, clarinet melodies and answering brass lines.

name: Bikutsi
zh: 喀麦隆的快速舞曲，以六拍律动、敲击般的吉他音色和密集节奏见长。
en: Fast Cameroonian dance music with a six-beat pulse, percussive guitar sounds and tightly packed rhythmic patterns.

name: Binaural Beats
zh: 两耳分别播放略有差异的纯音，使听者感到一个缓慢起伏的虚拟拍频。
en: Slightly different tones presented to each ear create the perception of a slower, pulsing beat.

name: Biraha
zh: 博杰普里语的高亢叙事歌，常以伸展长音和鼓乐伴奏表达离别或讲述故事。
en: Bhojpuri narrative singing uses strongly projected, extended notes and drum accompaniment to express separation or tell stories.

name: Bird Sounds
zh: 以鸟鸣、叫声及鸟群活动为主体的自然录音，突出不同声部的呼应。
en: Nature recordings centered on birdsong, calls and flock activity, revealing exchanges between different birds and surrounding habitats.

name: Birmingham Sound
zh: 伯明翰的工业泰克诺，以粗糙循环、金属打击声和坚硬节拍持续施压。
en: Industrial techno associated with Birmingham, built on rough loops, metallic percussion and relentless, hard-edged rhythms.

name: Bit Music
zh: 以早期电脑、游戏机芯片及其模拟音色制作的电子音乐，突出离散而清晰的声部。
en: Electronic music using early computer and game-chip sounds or their emulations, often with clearly separated, sharply defined voices.

name: Bitpop
zh: 将复古游戏芯片的哔声、方波旋律与流行歌曲的副歌和人声结合。
en: Pop songwriting combines catchy choruses and vocals with the bleeps and square-wave melodies of vintage game hardware.

name: Black 'n' Roll
zh: 把黑金属的尖叫与粗粝失真，放入摇滚乐更直接、带摆动感的重复乐句。
en: Black metal's harsh vocals and raw distortion meet rock-and-roll riffs with a more direct, swinging groove.

name: Black Ambient
zh: 吸收黑金属阴冷审美的黑暗氛围音乐，以无人声或稀疏人声、持续音与噪声铺陈。
en: Dark ambient shaped by black metal's bleak atmosphere, using drones, noise and sparse or absent vocals.

name: Black Gospel
zh: 非裔美国人的福音音乐，以强烈领唱、应答合唱和灵活的节奏表达宗教信仰。
en: African American gospel expresses faith through powerful lead singing, responding choirs and rhythmically flexible accompaniment.

name: Black Metal
zh: 以尖厉嘶吼、震音吉他和密集鼓点塑造冷冽、粗粝声墙的金属。
en: Metal marked by shrieked vocals, tremolo-picked guitars and rapid drumming that create a raw, cold wall of sound.

name: Black MIDI
zh: 将极大量音符写入电脑演奏的音乐，密集到记谱或钢琴卷帘几乎连成黑块。
en: Computer-played music packs enormous numbers of notes into dense patterns that nearly black out the visual score.

name: Black Noise
zh: 把黑金属的嘶吼、失真吉他与噪声制作融合，常让旋律淹没在粗糙声层中。
en: Black metal fused with noise, often burying screams and guitar melodies beneath abrasive, distorted layers.

name: Blackened Crust
zh: 将壳核朋克的粗粝冲刺与黑金属的震音吉他、尖厉嘶吼结合。
en: Crust punk's rough rhythmic attack combines with black metal tremolo guitars and harsh, shrieking vocals.

name: Blackgaze
zh: 让黑金属的高速鼓点与嘶吼，融入自赏摇滚的混响吉他和朦胧音墙。
en: Black metal's rapid drums and screams merge with shoegaze's reverberant guitars and hazy walls of sound.

name: Bleep Techno
zh: 英国早期泰克诺，以简洁电子哔声、厚重次低音和宽松切分节拍见长。
en: Early British techno known for simple electronic bleeps, deep sub-bass and spacious, syncopated drum patterns.

name: Blue-Eyed Soul
zh: 多指白人歌手演绎的灵魂流行，采用福音式唱腔和节奏布鲁斯的律动。
en: Soul-influenced pop performed by white artists, drawing on gospel-style singing and rhythm-and-blues grooves.

name: Bluegrass
zh: 以班卓琴、小提琴、曼陀铃和吉他的快速轮奏，配合紧密高声部和声。
en: Acoustic country music with fast banjo, fiddle, mandolin and guitar solos alongside close, high-register vocal harmonies.

name: Bluegrass Gospel
zh: 用蓝草的原声弦乐、快速轮奏和紧密和声，演唱基督教赞美与救赎主题。
en: Christian gospel songs performed with bluegrass strings, brisk instrumental breaks and close vocal harmonies.

name: Blues
zh: 以蓝调音、富于弯转的唱腔和乐器应答表达情绪，常采用反复和声框架。
en: Expressive singing and instrumental responses use blue notes, bent pitches and recurring harmonic patterns to shape the music.

name: Blues Rock
zh: 以蓝调音阶、重复吉他乐句和独奏为基础，加入摇滚的失真与鼓组力度。
en: Rock built on blues scales, repeating guitar riffs and solos, with amplified distortion and a stronger drum attack.

name: Bocet
zh: 罗马尼亚的丧葬哀歌，以近乎哭诉的独唱、自由节奏和反复呼唤表达悲痛。
en: Romanian funeral lament uses speech-like solo singing, free rhythm and repeated cries to express grief.

name: Boduberu
zh: 马尔代夫集体歌舞，以大鼓、领唱应答和逐渐加快的节奏推动舞蹈。
en: Maldivian communal music combines large drums, call-and-response singing and gradually accelerating rhythms for dance.

name: Bogino duu
zh: 蒙古短调民歌，句式紧凑、节拍较规整，以简明旋律演唱日常生活与情感。
en: Mongolian short songs use compact phrases and regular rhythms to sing about everyday life and personal feelings.

name: Bohjpuri Pop
zh: 以博杰普里语演唱的印度流行音乐，常结合地方旋律、强劲电子鼓点与舞曲编配。
en: Bhojpuri-language Indian pop often combines regional melodies with forceful electronic beats and dance-oriented arrangements.

name: Bolero
zh: 拉丁美洲的抒情歌舞，以从容双拍节奏、细腻旋律和情感浓厚的演唱为主。
en: Latin American romantic song with a relaxed duple pulse, lyrical melodies and emotionally expressive singing.

name: Bolero español
zh: 西班牙的三拍舞曲，以清楚的节奏重音、响板和吉他或管弦乐伴舞。
en: Spanish dance music in triple meter, with pronounced accents, castanets and guitar or orchestral accompaniment.

name: Bolero son
zh: 把波莱罗的抒情旋律与古巴颂的切分节奏结合，常由柔缓歌唱转入活跃合奏。
en: Bolero's romantic melodies combine with Cuban son's syncopation, often moving from gentle singing into livelier ensemble passages.

name: Bolero Việt Nam
zh: 越南的波莱罗歌曲，以平稳摇摆节奏和带乡土转音的唱腔诉说爱情与离愁。
en: Vietnamese bolero pairs a steady, swaying rhythm with ornamented, folk-inflected vocals about love and separation.

name: Bolero-Beat
zh: 把拉丁波莱罗的抒情唱腔，放进电吉他、风琴和鼓组成的流行摇滚编配。
en: Romantic bolero singing set within pop-rock arrangements of electric guitar, organ and drums.

name: Bolivian Huayño
zh: 玻利维亚的安第斯歌舞，以明快双拍节奏、拨弦乐器和管乐旋律带动群舞。
en: Bolivian Andean song and dance uses brisk duple rhythms, plucked strings and wind melodies to accompany communal movement.

name: Bomba
zh: 波多黎各非洲裔歌舞，以鼓手追随舞者动作、领唱应答和交错鼓点为核心。
en: Afro-Puerto Rican music centers on call-and-response singing and interlocking drums, with a lead drummer answering the dancer's movements.

name: Bongo Flava
zh: 坦桑尼亚的斯瓦希里语流行与嘻哈，将旋律演唱、说唱和东非舞曲节奏结合。
en: Tanzanian Swahili-language pop and hip hop combines melodic singing, rap and East African dance rhythms.

name: Boogaloo
zh: 把古巴节奏与灵魂乐、节奏布鲁斯结合，以钢琴短句、铜管和应答人声带动舞步。
en: Latin dance music combining Cuban rhythms with soul and R&B through piano riffs, brass and call-and-response vocals.

name: Boogie
zh: 迪斯科之后的放克舞曲，以合成器低音、鼓机和光滑人声维持弹跳律动。
en: Post-disco dance music with synthesizer bass, drum machines and smooth vocals riding a springy funk groove.

name: Boogie Rock
zh: 以反复、摇摆的蓝调吉他乐句与稳健鼓点，推动持续不歇的摇滚律动。
en: Blues-based rock driven by repeating, swinging guitar riffs and a steady backbeat that keeps the groove moving.

name: Boogie Woogie
zh: 以左手反复低音和右手切分旋律构成的钢琴蓝调，节奏轻快而持续滚动。
en: Piano blues pairs repeating left-hand bass patterns with syncopated right-hand phrases for a rolling, propulsive rhythm.

name: Boom Bap
zh: 以采样鼓的重底鼓、脆军鼓和短循环，为节奏鲜明的说唱搭建骨架。
en: Hip hop built on hard sampled kicks, crisp snares and short musical loops beneath rhythmically focused rapping.

name: Bop
zh: 芝加哥的轻快舞蹈说唱，以明亮旋律、明显自动修音和弹跳鼓点见长。
en: Upbeat Chicago dance rap with bright melodies, heavily tuned sing-rapping and buoyant drum patterns.

name: Bosnian Folk Music
zh: 波斯尼亚的民间音乐，涵盖叙事歌、长篇装饰性独唱与集体舞曲。
en: Bosnian folk traditions encompass narrative songs, extended ornamented solo singing and music for communal dances.

name: Bossa nova
zh: 以轻声近唱、切分吉他和爵士式和声，把桑巴节奏处理得细腻而松弛。
en: Soft, intimate singing and syncopated guitar bring a relaxed samba pulse together with jazz-influenced harmonies.

name: Bounce
zh: 新奥尔良的舞曲说唱，以反复鼓样、短促口令和领唱应答制造弹跳节奏。
en: New Orleans dance rap uses repeating drum samples, short vocal commands and call-and-response chants to create a bouncing rhythm.

name: Bounce Beat
zh: 华盛顿戈戈音乐的重鼓分支，以强烈旋转鼓重音和持续反复的节奏推动现场。
en: A drum-heavy form of Washington go-go, driven by emphatic rototom accents and insistent repeating grooves.

name: Bouncy Techno
zh: 以快速硬核底鼓、轻快合成器旋律和弹跳反拍低音形成直接的锐舞舞曲。
en: Fast rave music with hard kicks, cheerful synthesizer hooks and bouncing offbeat basslines.

name: Bouyon
zh: 多米尼克的电子舞曲，将地方鼓乐、索卡与卡登斯影响融入快速键盘和鼓机节奏。
en: Electronic dance music from Dominica blends local drumming, soca and cadence influences with fast keyboard and drum-machine patterns.

name: Boy Band
zh: 由男性组合演唱的流行音乐，常强调轮流领唱、整齐和声和易记副歌。
en: Pop performed by male vocal groups, often emphasizing shared lead parts, polished harmonies and memorable choruses.

name: Boyfriend Country
zh: 以体贴、承诺和恋爱日常为主题的乡村流行，常用柔和嗓音和光滑编配。
en: Romantic country-pop centered on devotion and everyday relationships, often delivered through gentle vocals and polished arrangements.

name: Bozlak
zh: 安纳托利亚的自由节奏长调，以高音起唱、强烈转音和向下回落的乐句表达哀思。
en: Anatolian free-rhythm song uses high openings, intense vocal ornamentation and descending phrases to convey lamentation.

name: Brazilian Bass
zh: 巴西的浩室舞曲，以低沉、厚实的合成器低音和简洁四拍鼓点形成反差。
en: Brazilian house emphasizes deep, weighty synthesizer bass against simple four-on-the-floor drum patterns.

name: Brazilian Classical Music
zh: 巴西的古典艺术音乐，以西方作曲形式为基础，常吸收地方歌谣与舞曲节奏。
en: Brazilian classical music works within Western compositional forms, often drawing on local songs and dance rhythms.

name: Brazilian Folk Music
zh: 巴西各地口传的歌舞音乐，涵盖吉他叙事、应答歌唱及多种非洲裔打击乐传统。
en: Brazilian folk traditions span guitar-led storytelling, call-and-response songs and diverse Afro-Brazilian percussion practices.

name: Brazilian Music
zh: 巴西音乐的总称，涵盖原住民、非洲裔与欧洲移民传统，以及现代流行和电子舞曲。
en: Music of Brazil encompasses Indigenous, African and European-derived traditions alongside contemporary pop and electronic dance styles.

name: Brazilian Phonk
zh: 把漂移冯克的粗粝低音与巴西放克的人声、鼓点结合，突出反复重拍与失真。
en: Drift phonk's gritty bass combines with Brazilian funk vocals and percussion in distorted, heavily accented repeating patterns.

name: Break-In
zh: 把流行歌曲片段剪入虚构采访或新闻问答，以录音拼贴制造笑点。
en: Comedy recordings splice popular-song excerpts into mock interviews or news reports, using sampled answers for humorous effect.

name: Breakbeat
zh: 以切碎或重新编排的鼓组片段为核心，用切分节奏取代连续四拍底鼓。
en: Electronic dance music built from chopped or rearranged drum breaks, emphasizing syncopated patterns rather than a constant four-on-the-floor pulse.

name: Breakbeat Hardcore
zh: 把加速碎拍、沉重低音、钢琴短句和采样人声叠成高能锐舞音乐。
en: Rave music layering sped-up breakbeats, heavy bass, piano stabs and sampled vocals into densely energetic arrangements.

name: Breakbeat Kota
zh: 由印尼丰科特发展而来，放缓速度，以繁忙碎拍、合成器和采样编成舞曲。
en: Indonesian dance music developed from funkot at a slower pace, retaining busy breakbeats, synthesizers and layered samples.

name: Breakcore
zh: 对高速鼓样进行密集切割、错位和突变，常混入失真与噪声的极端电子音乐。
en: Extreme electronic music rapidly cuts, displaces and interrupts drum breaks, often adding distortion and abrasive noise.

name: Breakstep
zh: 把英国车库的切分低音与更密集、厚重的碎拍结合，节奏更趋破碎紧迫。
en: UK garage fused with heavier, busier breakbeats, giving its syncopated bass and drums a more fragmented drive.

name: Brega
zh: 巴西大众抒情音乐，以直白情歌、浓重情绪和顺口旋律为常见特征。
en: Brazilian popular song often marked by direct romantic lyrics, emphatic emotion and immediately memorable melodies.

name: Brega calypso
zh: 巴西北部的流行舞曲，以快速、明亮的电吉他和强劲节奏改造布雷加情歌。
en: Northern Brazilian dance-pop reworks brega songs with fast, bright electric guitars and driving rhythmic arrangements.

name: Brega funk
zh: 巴西伯南布哥的舞曲，以切分电子打击乐、低音和唱说交替的人声融合布雷加与放克。
en: Pernambucan dance music blends brega and Brazilian funk through syncopated electronic percussion, bass and alternating sung and spoken vocals.

name: Bregadeira
zh: 阿罗恰衍生的巴西舞曲，以全电子鼓点和更强的放克重音适配大型音响。
en: Arrocha-derived Brazilian dance music uses fully electronic drums and stronger funk accents for powerful street sound systems.

name: Breton Celtic Folk Music
zh: 布列塔尼的凯尔特歌舞传统，常以应答唱法、风笛与邦巴德管陪伴链式舞蹈。
en: Breton Celtic traditions combine answering vocals, bagpipes and bombarde shawms with music for linked group dances.

name: Breton Folk Music
zh: 布列塔尼的地方民间音乐，涵盖叙事歌、轮流接唱和由管乐或手风琴伴奏的舞曲。
en: Breton folk music encompasses narrative songs, alternating vocal lines and dance tunes played on winds or accordion.

name: Briddim
zh: 把瑞迪姆的反复切分低音与兄弟步的猛烈音色设计结合，突出沉重落点。
en: Riddim's repeating, syncopated bass patterns meet brostep's aggressive sound design and heavy, sharply defined drops.

name: Brill Building
zh: 以精巧主副歌、顺口旋律和饱满和声见长，出自纽约职业词曲写作传统的流行音乐。
en: New York songwriting-school pop with carefully shaped verses and choruses, memorable melodies and full vocal harmonies.

name: Britcore
zh: 英国硬核嘻哈，以快速说唱、密集碎拍、刮碟和强硬表达形成紧绷节奏。
en: British hardcore hip hop combines fast rapping, dense breakbeats, scratching and forceful vocal delivery.

name: Britfunk
zh: 英国的放克舞曲，将弹性贝斯、切分吉他和铜管或合成器融入爵士与灵魂乐影响。
en: British funk blends springy bass, syncopated guitars and horns or synthesizers with jazz and soul influences.

name: British Blues
zh: 英国乐手发展的电声蓝调，以扩音吉他、口琴和乐队合奏强化蓝调乐句。
en: British electric blues emphasizes amplified guitar, harmonica and band interplay in interpretations of blues songs and riffs.

name: British Brass Band
zh: 以短号、柔音铜管、低音铜管和打击乐组成的英国铜管乐队，突出整齐和声。
en: British brass ensembles blend cornets, mellow brass, low brass and percussion in tightly balanced, harmonized arrangements.

name: British Dance Band
zh: 英国早期社交舞厅乐队，以柔和人声、铜管、簧管和轻摇摆节奏演奏流行歌曲。
en: British dance orchestras play popular songs with smooth vocals, brass, reeds and gently swinging rhythms.

name: British Folk Rock
zh: 把英国传统叙事歌、舞曲和调式旋律，放入电吉他、贝斯与鼓的摇滚编制。
en: British traditional ballads, dance tunes and modal melodies arranged for electric guitars, bass and rock drums.

name: British Music
zh: 英国各地音乐的总称，涵盖地方民谣、古典创作、流行摇滚和多种电子舞曲。
en: Music from across Britain encompasses regional folk traditions, classical composition, pop, rock and numerous electronic dance styles.

name: British Rhythm & Blues
zh: 英国的节奏布鲁斯摇滚，以粗粝吉他、口琴和强烈反拍演绎美式蓝调与节奏布鲁斯。
en: British rock interpretations of American blues and R&B feature gritty guitars, harmonica and a strong backbeat.

name: Britpop
zh: 以明亮吉他、鲜明英式口音和日常叙事，写出副歌突出的英国另类流行摇滚。
en: British alternative pop rock with bright guitars, distinctive local accents, everyday stories and prominent, singable choruses.

name: Bro-Country
zh: 围绕聚会、汽车与乡野生活的当代乡村流行，常加入摇滚吉他和嘻哈式节拍。
en: Contemporary country-pop about parties, vehicles and rural life, often featuring rock guitars and hip-hop-influenced beats.

name: Broadband Noise
zh: 同时覆盖较宽频率范围的噪声，常呈持续沙沙声，而没有清楚的旋律音高。
en: Noise spread across a broad range of frequencies, usually heard as a continuous hiss without a clear melodic pitch.

name: Broken Beat
zh: 以错落的切分鼓点、爵士和声及放克低音，形成摇晃弹性的电子舞曲。
en: Electronic dance music with off-kilter, syncopated drums, jazz harmonies and funk bass that create a loose, elastic groove.

name: Broken Transmission
zh: 以电视、广播和广告片段的短循环，配上失真、掉音和模糊音质模拟断续信号。
en: Vaporwave built from short broadcast and advertising loops, using distortion, dropouts and blurred fidelity to suggest interrupted transmissions.

name: Brostep
zh: 以咆哮般的中频低音、强烈半速鼓点和突出的重拍落点构成的杜布步。
en: Dubstep featuring growling midrange bass, forceful half-time drums and sharply emphasized, high-impact drops.

name: Brukdown
zh: 伯利兹克里奥尔人的歌舞，以手风琴、吉他和打击乐结合叙事与轻快摇摆节奏。
en: Belizean Creole music combines storytelling with accordion, guitar and percussion in lively, swaying dance rhythms.

name: Brutal Death Metal
zh: 以极低喉吼、密集爆裂鼓点和沉重吉他乐句，把死亡金属推向更强的肉体冲击。
en: Death metal emphasizing deep guttural vocals, dense blast beats and crushing riffs for an intensely physical rhythmic attack.

name: Brutal Prog
zh: 把前卫摇滚的复杂节拍与噪声摇滚、硬核式力度结合，编排密集且常突然转折。
en: Progressive rock combines complex meters with noise-rock and hardcore intensity, using dense arrangements and abrupt shifts.

name: Bubblegum
zh: 以简单节拍、甜亮旋律和容易跟唱的重复副歌，为年轻听众打造的流行歌曲。
en: Youth-oriented pop with simple beats, bright melodies and repetitive choruses designed for instant singalong appeal.

name: Bubblegum Bass
zh: 用夸张高音人声、塑料感合成器和弹性低音，将流行舞曲做得甜腻而人工化。
en: Electronic pop exaggerates pitched-up vocals, glossy synthetic textures and elastic bass into a deliberately sugary, artificial sound.

name: Bubblegum Dance
zh: 轻快欧陆舞曲，以俏皮唱腔、明亮合成器和反复副歌形成卡通般的听感。
en: Playful Eurodance with bright synthesizers, animated vocals and repeating choruses that give it a cartoon-like feel.

name: Bubbling
zh: 荷兰加勒比社群的舞曲，把舞厅雷鬼加速、切碎，形成尖亮人声和跳跃鼓点。
en: Dutch-Caribbean dance music speeds up and chops dancehall, producing high-pitched vocals and restless, skipping rhythms.

name: Bubbling House
zh: 把巴布林的加速加勒比节奏与四拍浩室结合，常以短促采样和切分打击乐推动。
en: House combines bubbling's sped-up Caribbean rhythms with a four-on-the-floor pulse, short samples and syncopated percussion.

name: Buchiage Trance
zh: 日本派对舞曲，以快速四拍、明亮合成器和夸张旋律，把举手舞曲的兴奋感放大。
en: Japanese party dance music intensifies hands-up energy through fast four-on-the-floor beats, bright synthesizers and exaggerated melodic hooks.

name: Buddhist Music
zh: 佛教实践中的音乐与诵唱，涵盖经文唱诵、钟鼓声及不同地区的仪式器乐。
en: Music and chanting used in Buddhist practice, including sung texts, bells, drums and regional ceremonial instrumental traditions.

name: Budget Rock
zh: 强调廉价器材、粗糙录音和简短猛冲歌曲的车库朋克，声音直接而不修饰。
en: Garage punk favoring cheap equipment, rough recording and short, hard-driving songs with a deliberately unpolished sound.

name: Budots
zh: 菲律宾街头电子舞曲，以反复四拍、尖亮警笛和短人声采样配合摇摆舞步。
en: Filipino street dance music uses repeating four-on-the-floor beats, piercing sirens and short vocal samples for swaying movements.

name: Buganda Royal Court Music
zh: 布干达宫廷的器乐与声乐，以交错木琴、鼓乐及竖琴伴唱形成精密合奏。
en: Buganda court music features intricate interlocking xylophones, drumming and songs accompanied by the arched harp.

name: Bugle Call
zh: 以军号有限的自然音吹奏短句，用鲜明节奏传达集合、起床或纪念等信号。
en: Short bugle phrases use natural harmonics and distinctive rhythms to signal assembly, reveille, remembrance and other ceremonial actions.

name: Bulawayo Jazz
zh: 津巴布韦布拉瓦约的早期爵士，以地方旋律、管乐合奏和轻快舞蹈节奏为核心。
en: Early jazz from Bulawayo, Zimbabwe, builds on local melodies, wind ensembles and buoyant dance rhythms.

name: Bulería
zh: 弗拉门戈中快速的十二拍曲式，以错落重音、拍手和吉他应答推动歌舞。
en: A fast flamenco form in twelve beats, propelled by shifting accents, handclaps and guitar responses to singing and dance.

name: Bulgarian Folk Music
zh: 保加利亚民间音乐，以不均分舞曲节拍、明亮直声演唱和紧密多声部合唱见长。
en: Folk traditions from Bulgaria, marked by uneven dance meters, bright open-throated singing, and tightly woven vocal harmonies.

name: Bullerengue
zh: 哥伦比亚加勒比沿岸的非洲裔歌舞，以女领唱、应答合唱、拍手和鼓声为核心。
en: Afro-Colombian Caribbean music centers on female lead vocals, answering choruses, handclaps and drums.

name: Burger-Highlife
zh: 在德国发展的加纳高生活音乐，以电子鼓、合成器和放克低音替代部分传统乐队声部。
en: Ghanaian highlife developed in Germany, featuring electronic drums, synthesizers and funk bass alongside its flowing song melodies.

name: Burmese Classical Music
zh: 缅甸古典歌乐，以曲折装饰的旋律，配合弯琴或围鼓、锣等乐器。
en: Winding, ornamented melodies performed on arched harp or ensembles of tuned drums and gongs in Myanmar's classical tradition.

name: Burning Spirits
zh: 日本硬核朋克，以高速鼓点、嘶吼和富于旋律的金属式吉他独奏形成热烈冲劲。
en: Japanese hardcore punk combines fast drums and raw shouts with melodic, metal-influenced guitar leads.

name: Burrakatha
zh: 泰卢固语的民间说书表演，以主讲者弹唱、搭档应答和打击乐串联故事。
en: Telugu folk storytelling combines a lead singer-narrator, answering performers, plucked-string accompaniment and percussion.

name: Burushaski Folk Music
zh: 巴基斯坦北部布鲁夏斯基语社群的民间歌舞，常以鼓与唢呐类管乐伴奏。
en: Folk songs and dances of northern Pakistan's Burushaski-speaking communities, often accompanied by drums and shawm-like wind instruments.

name: Buryat Music
zh: 布里亚特人的音乐传统，涵盖绵长独唱、史诗吟唱与反复应答的集体圆舞歌。
en: Buryat traditions include sustained solo songs, epic recitation and repetitive communal singing for circle dances.

name: Byzantine Chant
zh: 东正教传统中的单旋律圣咏，以装饰性旋律及持续低音承托礼仪经文。
en: Orthodox liturgical chant uses ornamented melodic lines, often supported by a sustained drone beneath the sacred text.

name: Byzantine Music
zh: 拜占庭的音乐传统，以调式化圣咏为重要核心，重视经文、旋律装饰和口传规则。
en: Byzantine musical traditions center strongly on modal chant, shaping sacred texts through melodic ornamentation and orally transmitted conventions.

name: Bérite Club
zh: 法国俱乐部音乐，把非洲移民舞曲节奏与格莱姆、库杜罗和碎切采样结合。
en: French club music combines African diasporic dance rhythms with grime, kuduro and sharply chopped samples.

name: C-Pop
zh: 以华语歌曲为中心的流行音乐总称，涵盖国语、粤语及其他汉语歌唱传统。
en: An umbrella for Chinese-language pop, encompassing Mandarin, Cantonese and other Chinese-language song traditions.

name: C86
zh: 英国独立流行，以清亮拨弦吉他、朴素人声和轻快短歌呈现自行制作的质感。
en: British indie pop with jangling guitars, unpolished vocals and brisk, compact songs shaped by a do-it-yourself aesthetic.

name: Ca trù
zh: 越南歌筹表演，以女声细腻吟唱、三弦长颈琴和木制拍板交织诗句。
en: Vietnamese ca trù pairs finely ornamented female singing with a long-necked three-string lute and sharply struck wooden clappers.

name: Cabaret
zh: 为小型剧场和夜总会演唱的歌曲，重视戏剧化表演、歌词机锋与亲近观众的表达。
en: Intimate theatrical songs emphasize expressive delivery, witty lyrics and direct engagement with an audience in small venues.

name: Cabo-Zouk
zh: 佛得角的柔缓祖克，以平滑电子节奏、圆润低音和克里奥尔语情歌营造贴身舞感。
en: Cape Verdean zouk combines smooth electronic rhythms, rounded bass and Creole romantic vocals for close partner dancing.

name: Cachaca
zh: 巴拉圭的坎比亚舞曲，以反复节奏、简明和声和顺口情歌结合哥伦比亚与墨西哥影响。
en: Paraguayan cumbia uses repeating rhythms, simple harmonies and catchy romantic songs shaped by Colombian and Mexican influences.

name: Cadence Lypso
zh: 多米尼克的克里奥尔舞曲，将海地卡登斯与卡利普索歌唱、铜管及电声节奏结合。
en: Creole dance music from Dominica blends Haitian cadence with calypso singing, brass and electric-band grooves.

name: Cadence rampa
zh: 海地的卡登斯舞曲，以持续舞蹈节拍、切分铜管和平稳推进的乐队合奏见长。
en: Haitian dance music with a continuous pulse, syncopated brass and steadily flowing band arrangements.

name: Cajun Music
zh: 路易斯安那卡津人的法语歌舞，以手风琴、小提琴和双步舞或华尔兹节奏为主。
en: Louisiana Cajun music combines French-language singing, accordion and fiddle in two-step dances and waltzes.

name: Cakewalk
zh: 以进行曲底盘和错落切分旋律配合夸张舞步，是早期拉格泰姆相关的舞曲。
en: An early ragtime-related dance style combines a march-like pulse with syncopated melodies for exaggerated, strutting steps.

name: Calipso venezolano
zh: 委内瑞拉埃尔卡亚俄的卡利普索，以密集鼓乐、应答人声和狂欢节游行节奏见长。
en: Calypso from El Callao, Venezuela, emphasizes layered drumming, responding vocals and rhythms for carnival processions.

name: Calypso
zh: 特立尼达的叙事舞曲，以机智歌词、切分节奏和反复副歌评论社会与日常生活。
en: Trinidadian song uses witty lyrics, syncopated dance rhythms and recurring choruses to comment on society and everyday life.

name: Cambodian Pop
zh: 柬埔寨流行音乐，以高棉语唱腔和装饰旋律，结合电吉他、键盘或现代电子节奏。
en: Khmer-language pop combining ornamented vocals with electric guitars, keyboards, or contemporary electronic rhythms.

name: Campursari
zh: 爪哇的混合流行，以甘美兰音色、地方唱腔与键盘、鼓组融合传统和现代歌曲。
en: Javanese popular music blends gamelan sounds and regional singing with keyboards, drums and modern song arrangements.

name: Campus Folk
zh: 台湾校园民歌，以清楚自然的演唱、原声吉他和简洁旋律记录青春、乡土与日常。
en: Taiwanese campus folk songs use clear, natural singing and acoustic guitar to reflect on youth, place and everyday life.

name: Canadian Folk Music
zh: 加拿大各地的民间音乐，涵盖英法语叙事歌、小提琴舞曲与不同社群的口传传统。
en: Canadian folk music includes English- and French-language ballads, fiddle dances and oral traditions from diverse communities.

name: Canadian Maritime Folk
zh: 加拿大大西洋沿岸的民间音乐，以海洋叙事歌、凯尔特小提琴和轻快舞曲为常见特色。
en: Atlantic Canadian folk music often features maritime ballads, Celtic fiddle playing and lively regional dance tunes.

name: Canarian Folk Music
zh: 加那利群岛的民间歌舞，常以蒂姆普莱小吉他、弦乐合奏和合唱演奏地方舞曲。
en: Canarian folk songs and dances often feature the small timple guitar, string ensembles and group singing.

name: Canción melódica
zh: 西班牙语抒情流行，以突出的歌唱旋律、情感化演绎和弦乐等饱满编配见长。
en: Spanish-language romantic pop emphasizes vocal melody, expressive delivery and full arrangements, often featuring strings.

name: Candombe
zh: 乌拉圭非洲裔的鼓乐传统，以三种大小的鼓相互呼应，组成滚动切分节奏。
en: Afro-Uruguayan drumming interlocks three differently sized drums in rolling, syncopated rhythmic conversations.

name: Candombe beat
zh: 把坎东贝鼓乐的交错节奏，融入电吉他、贝斯和鼓的摇滚歌曲。
en: Rock songs incorporate candombe's interlocking drum rhythms into arrangements of electric guitar, bass and drum kit.

name: Candomblé Music
zh: 巴西坎东布雷仪式音乐，以分层手鼓、铃声和应答歌唱召请、颂赞神灵。
en: Brazilian Candomblé ritual music uses layered hand drums, bells and call-and-response songs to invoke and honor deities.

name: Cantata
zh: 由多段声乐与器乐构成的古典作品，常以独唱、合唱及伴奏展开宗教或世俗文本。
en: A multi-section classical work sets sacred or secular texts for solo voices, choir and instrumental accompaniment.

name: Cante alentejano
zh: 葡萄牙阿连特茹的无伴奏合唱，以领唱、较高声部和集体应答形成缓慢和声。
en: Unaccompanied Alentejo singing combines a lead voice, a higher answering part and a chorus in slow-moving harmonies.

name: Canterbury Scene
zh: 把爵士和声、灵巧即兴与前卫摇滚结构结合，常有风琴音色和诙谐人声。
en: Progressive rock combining jazz harmonies, agile improvisation and winding structures, often colored by organ sounds and wry vocals.

name: Canto a lo poeta
zh: 智利的诗歌弹唱，以十行诗、吉他或多弦大吉他串联即兴与叙事。
en: Chilean sung poetry uses ten-line verses and guitar or guitarrón accompaniment for storytelling and improvisational exchanges.

name: Canto beneventano
zh: 意大利贝内文托古老礼仪中的单声部圣咏，以无伴奏人声延展拉丁经文。
en: Monophonic chant from the old Beneventan liturgy in southern Italy, extending Latin sacred texts through unaccompanied vocal lines.

name: Canto cardenche
zh: 墨西哥北部的无伴奏民歌，以数个男声拉长乐句，交织出粗粝而哀婉的和声。
en: Northern Mexican a cappella songs weave sustained male vocal lines into raw, plaintive harmonies.

name: Canto degli Alpini
zh: 意大利阿尔卑斯山地部队相关的歌曲，以男性合唱与整齐和声讲述山野、战争和乡愁。
en: Italian Alpine troop songs use male choral harmonies to tell of mountain life, war and longing for home.

name: Canto mozárabe
zh: 伊比利亚古老基督教礼仪的单声部圣咏，以自由伸缩的旋律演唱拉丁经文。
en: Old Iberian Christian chant sets Latin sacred texts in unaccompanied melodic lines with freely flowing rhythm.

name: Cantonese Opera
zh: 以粤语程式化唱腔、念白和锣鼓点，配合弦乐讲述舞台故事。
en: Stylized Cantonese singing, spoken dialogue, strings, and punctuating percussion carry the stories of this theatrical tradition.

name: Cantopop
zh: 以粤语演唱的流行音乐，常以清楚主旋律、抒情唱法和精致编配突出歌词。
en: Cantonese-language pop often emphasizes clear melodies, expressive singing and polished arrangements that bring the lyrics forward.

name: Cantoria
zh: 巴西东北部的即兴对歌，两位歌者以吉他伴奏，在固定诗格中押韵较量。
en: Northeastern Brazilian improvised song contests pair guitar accompaniment with two singers trading rhymed verses in established poetic forms.

name: Cantu a chiterra
zh: 撒丁岛的吉他伴唱传统，以舒展、装饰繁复的独唱在反复伴奏中变化。
en: Sardinian guitar-accompanied singing features expansive, highly ornamented solo lines varied over repeating accompaniment patterns.

name: Cantu a tenore
zh: 撒丁岛四声部男声合唱，以独唱旋律配合粗哑喉音和持续和声。
en: Sardinian four-part male singing combines a lead melody with guttural lower voices and sustained harmonic support.

name: Canzona
zh: 文艺复兴至早期巴洛克的器乐曲式，以清楚分段和声部模仿发展短小主题。
en: Renaissance and early Baroque instrumental music develops concise themes through clear sections and imitation between parts.

name: Canzone d'autore
zh: 以意大利语诗性歌词和个人表达为核心的作者歌曲，编配围绕叙事与演唱展开。
en: Italian songwriter music centers on poetic lyrics and personal expression, with arrangements shaped around storytelling and vocal delivery.

name: Canzone napoletana
zh: 那不勒斯方言歌曲，以宽广抒情旋律和富于戏剧感的演唱，常配拨弦乐器。
en: Neapolitan-language songs feature broad, lyrical melodies and theatrical singing, often supported by plucked strings.

name: Canzone neomelodica
zh: 当代那不勒斯流行情歌，以方言装饰唱腔配上电子键盘、鼓机和明快旋律。
en: Modern Neapolitan romantic pop combines ornamented dialect vocals with electronic keyboards, drum machines and accessible melodies.

name: Cape Breton Fiddling
zh: 加拿大布雷顿角的小提琴传统，以清楚弓法、装饰音和踏步般节奏演奏苏格兰舞曲。
en: Fiddle music from Cape Breton, using crisp bowing, ornamentation, and strongly articulated rhythms to play Scottish-derived dance tunes.

name: Cape Breton Folk Music
zh: 加拿大布雷顿角的凯尔特民间音乐，涵盖盖尔语歌唱、小提琴舞曲和钢琴伴奏。
en: Cape Breton folk traditions include Gaelic singing, fiddle dance tunes and rhythmically active piano accompaniment.

name: Cape Jazz
zh: 开普敦的爵士，以地方狂欢节和民间旋律、摇摆节奏与管乐即兴相结合。
en: Cape Town jazz blends local carnival and folk melodies with swinging rhythms and expressive horn improvisation.

name: Cape Verdean Music
zh: 佛得角的音乐传统，从缓慢抒情的拨弦歌曲，到打击乐和应答歌唱主导的舞曲。
en: Cape Verdean music ranges from slow, lyrical string-accompanied songs to percussion-driven dances and call-and-response singing.

name: Capoeira Music
zh: 巴西卡波耶拉的歌舞伴奏，以贝林包弓琴、手鼓和应答人声指引动作与节奏。
en: Capoeira accompaniment uses berimbau musical bows, hand percussion and call-and-response songs to guide movement and rhythm.

name: Caporal
zh: 玻利维亚卡波拉尔舞的伴奏，以强烈鼓点、明亮铜管和反复旋律配合踏步。
en: Music for Bolivian caporales dancing uses forceful drums, bright brass and repeated melodies to accompany emphatic stepping.

name: Capriccio
zh: 自由活泼的古典器乐曲，常以突然转折、快速跑动和炫技段落展示演奏变化。
en: A freely shaped classical instrumental piece, often featuring sudden turns, quick runs and virtuosic contrasts.

name: Car Audio Bass
zh: 为汽车低音音响突出低频效果的电子音乐，以深沉合成低音和简洁鼓机节拍为主。
en: Electronic music emphasizing deep synthesized bass and simple drum-machine patterns to showcase powerful car sound systems.

name: Caribbean Folk Music
zh: 加勒比各地的口传歌舞，常以领唱应答、打击乐和地方弦乐伴随庆典与日常。
en: Caribbean folk traditions use call-and-response singing, percussion and regional string instruments for celebrations and everyday communal life.

name: Caribbean Music
zh: 加勒比地区音乐的总称，涵盖非洲、欧洲、原住民及亚洲移民传统交汇的歌舞。
en: Caribbean music encompasses song and dance traditions shaped by African, European, Indigenous and Asian diasporic influences.

name: Carimbó
zh: 巴西帕拉州的圆圈舞音乐，以深沉手鼓、摇响器和领唱应答形成摆动节奏。
en: Circle-dance music from Pará, Brazil, combines deep hand drums, rattles and call-and-response singing in a swaying rhythm.

name: Carnatic Classical Music
zh: 南印度古典音乐，以装饰繁密的拉格旋律、节奏循环和声乐式即兴为核心。
en: South Indian classical music centers on ornamented raga melodies, rhythmic cycles and improvisation shaped by vocal phrasing.

name: Carnaval cruceño
zh: 玻利维亚圣克鲁斯的狂欢节音乐，以双三拍交错的律动和明亮合奏伴随游行。
en: Carnival music from Santa Cruz, Bolivia, combines interplaying duple and triple rhythms with bright ensemble playing.

name: Carnavalito
zh: 安第斯的轻快集体舞曲，以鲜明双拍节奏和笛管、弦乐的反复旋律带动舞步。
en: Lively Andean communal dance music uses a clear duple pulse and repeating melodies on winds and strings.

name: Carranga
zh: 哥伦比亚乡村的弦乐歌舞，以吉他、蒂普莱琴和刮奏器伴唱日常与幽默故事。
en: Colombian rural songs combine guitar, tiple and scraped percussion with everyday stories and humorous lyrics.

name: Cartoon Music
zh: 借爵士合奏、突然变速和夸张音效呼应卡通动作的音乐，段落转折迅速。
en: Jazz-influenced cartoon music follows animated action with abrupt tempo changes, exaggerated instrumental effects and rapid shifts between sections.

name: Catalan Folk Music
zh: 加泰罗尼亚民间音乐，涵盖叙事歌、器乐舞曲，以及木管铜管合奏的萨尔达纳。
en: Catalan folk traditions include narrative songs, instrumental dances and sardana music played by mixed wind ensembles.

name: Caucasian Folk Music
zh: 高加索地区的民间音乐，涵盖多声部歌唱、吟游弹唱和鼓管合奏的舞曲。
en: Caucasian folk traditions encompass multipart singing, bardic songs with strings and dance music led by drums and winds.

name: Caucasian Music
zh: 高加索地区音乐的总称，涵盖多种族群的复调合唱、调式器乐及现代流行。
en: Music of the Caucasus encompasses many communities' polyphonic singing, modal instrumental traditions and contemporary popular forms.

name: Celtic Chant
zh: 早期凯尔特教会的拉丁文单声部圣咏传统，如今主要通过少量史料研究与重现。
en: Latin monophonic chant of early Celtic churches, now studied and reconstructed from limited surviving historical evidence.

name: Celtic Electronica
zh: 把凯尔特笛子、小提琴或民谣旋律，与电子鼓点、合成器和采样结合。
en: Electronic music combining Celtic flutes, fiddles or folk melodies with programmed drums, synthesizers and samples.

name: Celtic Folk Music
zh: 凯尔特地区的民间歌舞，以小提琴、风笛、笛子和拨弦乐器演奏装饰性旋律。
en: Folk traditions of Celtic regions feature ornamented melodies on fiddles, bagpipes, flutes and plucked strings alongside singing.

name: Celtic Metal
zh: 在重型吉他和金属鼓点中加入凯尔特民间旋律、笛子、风笛或小提琴。
en: Metal combines heavy guitars and forceful drums with Celtic folk melodies, flutes, bagpipes or fiddles.

name: Celtic New Age
zh: 用凯尔特竖琴、笛子与歌谣旋律，配上柔和音垫和舒缓编配的新世纪音乐。
en: New age music places Celtic harp, flutes and folk melodies within soft pads and gently flowing arrangements.

name: Celtic Punk
zh: 以朋克的快速鼓点和粗粝合唱，配合凯尔特小提琴、风笛与民间舞曲旋律。
en: Punk's fast drums and rough singalong vocals meet Celtic fiddles, bagpipes and traditional dance melodies.

name: Celtic Rock
zh: 把凯尔特民间旋律、笛子或小提琴，放进电吉他、贝斯和鼓的摇滚编制。
