en: Nordic folk traditions span fiddle dances, narrative songs, and regional chanting, often emphasizing dance accents and ringing resonance.

name: Nordic Folk Rock
zh: 把北欧民间旋律、提琴或传统唱法带入电吉他乐队，以摇滚节奏支撑舞曲和歌谣。
en: Nordic folk melodies, fiddles, and traditional singing meet electric bands, with rock rhythms supporting songs and dances.

name: Nordic Music
zh: 北欧地区的音乐总称，从提琴与民歌传统到古典创作、流行乐和电声实验。
en: Music from the Nordic region ranges from fiddle and folk traditions to classical composition, pop, and electronic experimentation.

name: Nordic Old Time Dance Music
zh: 北欧社交舞音乐，以手风琴和提琴演奏华尔兹、波尔卡等节奏明确的旧式舞曲。
en: Nordic social dance ensembles use accordion and fiddle for clearly paced waltzes, polkas, and other traditional couple dances.

name: Nortec
zh: 墨西哥北部电子音乐，将手风琴、铜管和地方鼓点采样拆入技术舞曲节奏。
en: Northern Mexican electronic music cuts sampled accordions, brass, and regional percussion into techno-based rhythms.

name: Norteño
zh: 墨西哥北部乐队音乐，以手风琴和巴霍塞克斯托吉他演奏波尔卡节奏与叙事歌曲。
en: Northern Mexican bands pair accordion and bajo sexto guitar in polka-driven dance tunes and narrative songs.

name: North African Music
zh: 北非音乐传统涵盖装饰性歌唱、乌德琴和鼓乐，连接阿拉伯、阿马齐格与撒哈拉声音。
en: North African traditions connect Arabic, Amazigh, and Saharan sounds through ornamented singing, oud playing, and percussion.

name: North Asian Music
zh: 北亚各族的音乐，涵盖仪式吟唱、口簧、鼓与拉弦乐器等西伯利亚传统。
en: Northern Asian music encompasses Siberian traditions of ritual chanting, jaw harps, drums, and bowed string instruments.

name: Northeastern African Music
zh: 非洲东北部的音乐，涵盖尼罗河与非洲之角的调式歌唱、里拉琴和鼓乐传统。
en: Northeastern African music spans Nile Valley and Horn traditions of modal singing, lyres, and percussion.

name: Northeastern Brazilian Music
zh: 巴西东北部的音乐，以手风琴舞曲、大鼓游行、叙事歌谣和非洲裔节奏见长。
en: Northeastern Brazilian traditions encompass accordion dances, drum-led processions, narrative songs, and Afro-Brazilian rhythms.

name: Northern American Music
zh: 美国与加拿大的音乐总称，涵盖原住民歌唱、民间弦乐以及布鲁斯、爵士与流行传统。
en: Music from the United States and Canada spans Indigenous singing, folk strings, blues, jazz, and popular traditions.

name: Northern Brazilian Music
zh: 巴西亚马孙地区的音乐，连接原住民、非洲裔鼓乐与带电吉他和键盘的地方舞曲。
en: Brazil's Amazonian music connects Indigenous traditions and Afro-Brazilian drumming with regional electric-guitar and keyboard dance styles.

name: Northumbrian Folk Music
zh: 英格兰诺森伯兰民间音乐，以轻柔小风笛、灵巧提琴和地方叙事歌谣见长。
en: Northumberland folk music features softly voiced smallpipes, nimble fiddle tunes, and regional narrative songs.

name: Norwegian Folk Music
zh: 挪威民间音乐，以哈当厄尔提琴的共鸣弦、自由歌唱和不均匀舞曲节奏见长。
en: Norwegian folk traditions feature Hardanger fiddle resonance, freely shaped singing, and unevenly accented dance rhythms.

name: Nouveau zydeco
zh: 现代扎迪科把手风琴与搓板节奏接上放克、灵魂乐和更重的电声低音。
en: Modern zydeco combines accordion and washboard rhythms with funk, soul, and heavier amplified bass.

name: Nouvelle chanson française
zh: 当代法国香颂延续歌词叙事，用亲密人声结合流行、摇滚或电子编配。
en: Contemporary French chanson keeps storytelling central, pairing intimate voices with pop, rock, or electronic arrangements.

name: Nova cançó
zh: 加泰罗尼亚语创作歌曲，以简朴吉他、诗意歌词和清晰旋律表达文化认同与社会关切。
en: Catalan-language songwriting uses spare guitar, poetic lyrics, and clear melodies to express cultural identity and social concerns.

name: Novelty
zh: 以奇趣题材、滑稽人声或意想不到的音效吸引注意的歌曲，常围绕一个鲜明笑点。
en: Songs built around unusual subjects, comic voices, or surprising sound effects, often centering on one memorable gimmick.

name: Novelty Piano
zh: 技巧炫目的拉格泰姆钢琴曲，以快速跑动、复杂切分和跳跃手法呈现轻巧戏谑感。
en: Virtuosic ragtime piano uses fast runs, intricate syncopation, and leaping figures for a playful, sparkling effect.

name: NRG
zh: 高速硬派舞曲，以厚实四拍底鼓、锐利合成器和持续上升的反复乐句推动舞池。
en: Fast hard dance uses weighty four-on-the-floor kicks, sharp synthesizers, and insistent rising phrases to drive the floor.

name: Nu Jazz
zh: 将爵士和声、器乐即兴或采样放进电子节奏，结合原声演奏与精细制作。
en: Jazz harmonies, instrumental improvisation, and samples meet electronic rhythms, blending acoustic playing with detailed studio production.

name: Nu Metal
zh: 以低调弦吉他、切分重拍和说唱式唱腔融合金属，常加入唱盘与电子纹理。
en: Downtuned guitars, syncopated heavy grooves, and rap-like vocals reshape metal, often adding turntables and electronic textures.

name: Nu Skool Breaks
zh: 以现代电子低音和精细制作重塑碎拍，鼓点跳跃，合成器与采样充满切分感。
en: Modern electronic bass and detailed production reshape breakbeats, with syncopated drums, synths, and tightly cut samples.

name: Nu Style Gabber
zh: 以沉重失真底鼓和鲜明旋律组织加巴舞曲，常通过铺陈与落差形成大型舞池段落。
en: Heavy distorted kicks and prominent melodies shape gabber tracks around buildups and big, clearly defined drops.

name: Nu-Disco
zh: 以现代电子制作重现迪斯科的弹跳贝斯、弦乐光泽和四拍节奏，兼顾复古与清晰音质。
en: Modern electronic production renews disco's springy bass, string sheen, and four-on-the-floor rhythms with crisp studio detail.

name: Nuban
zh: 海湾地区的非洲裔仪式歌舞，以坦布拉里拉琴、鼓乐和集体应答形成循环。
en: Afro-Gulf ceremonial music centers on tanbura bowl lyres, drums, and communal call-and-response patterns.

name: Nubian Music
zh: 尼罗河努比亚人的音乐，以本族语言歌唱、框鼓与里拉琴旋律伴随节庆和舞蹈。
en: Nile Valley Nubian traditions combine local-language singing, frame drums, and lyre melodies for celebrations and dancing.

name: Nuer Music
zh: 南苏丹努尔人的音乐，以赞颂人物与牛群的歌声、集体应答和舞蹈节奏见长。
en: South Sudanese Nuer music includes songs praising people and cattle, communal vocal responses, and rhythms for dancing.

name: Nueva canción
zh: 以民间旋律和诗歌式歌词表达社会关切的西语新歌传统，常由木吉他伴唱。
en: Spanish-language new-song traditions use folk melodies, poetic lyrics, and acoustic accompaniment to express social concerns.

name: Nueva canción chilena
zh: 智利社会歌曲，以吉他、恰朗戈与安第斯管乐衬托诗意唱词和集体合唱。
en: Chilean socially engaged songs pair poetic lyrics and group singing with guitars, charango, and Andean winds.

name: Nueva canción española
zh: 西班牙新歌传统，以吉他伴唱和文学化歌词回应社会生活、自由诉求与地方认同。
en: Spanish new-song traditions pair guitar accompaniment and literary lyrics with social reflection, calls for freedom, and regional identity.

name: Nueva canción latinoamericana
zh: 拉丁美洲新歌运动，以地方民间乐器、诗意歌词和合唱表达社会经验与政治关切。
en: Latin American new-song traditions combine regional folk instruments, poetic lyrics, and collective singing with social and political concerns.

name: Nueva cumbia chilena
zh: 智利新式昆比亚，以强劲打击乐、铜管和摇滚或斯卡元素，强化街头合唱与舞池律动。
en: Contemporary Chilean cumbia adds forceful percussion, brass, and rock or ska influences to streetwise choruses and dance grooves.

name: Nueva trova
zh: 古巴创作歌曲，以木吉他和细致歌词连接个人情感、社会思考与特罗瓦传统。
en: Cuban songwriting connects personal feeling and social reflection with trova traditions through acoustic guitar and carefully shaped lyrics.

name: Nuevo Cancionero
zh: 阿根廷新歌运动，将地方民歌、诗歌和现代编配结合，歌唱日常劳动与社会现实。
en: Argentina's new-song movement combines regional folk, poetry, and modern arrangements in songs about work and social life.

name: Nursery Rhymes
zh: 为儿童传唱的短小歌谣，以押韵词句、简单旋律和反复节奏方便记忆与游戏。
en: Short children's songs use rhyming words, simple melodies, and repeated rhythms for memorization and play.

name: Nustyle
zh: 硬派舞曲中以旋律为重的声音，变调失真底鼓与明亮合成器主题紧密呼应。
en: Melody-focused hardstyle pairs pitched, distorted kicks with bright synthesizer themes that closely follow the bass movement.

name: Nyahbinghi
zh: 拉斯塔法里宗教鼓乐，以低鼓稳拍、重复中鼓和即兴高鼓伴随集体吟唱。
en: Rastafarian ceremonial music layers steady bass drums, repeating middle parts, and improvised high drums beneath communal chanting.

name: Nòva cançon
zh: 奥克语创作歌曲，以吉他和地方民间旋律歌唱语言认同、生活经验与社会诉求。
en: Occitan-language songwriting uses guitar and regional folk melodies to express linguistic identity, lived experience, and social concerns.

name: O'odham Music
zh: 奥德姆人的音乐涵盖仪式歌唱与乡间舞曲，后者常以提琴、手风琴和萨克斯合奏。
en: O'odham music spans ceremonial singing and social dances, with dance bands often featuring fiddle, accordion, and saxophone.

name: Ob-Ugric Folk Music
zh: 西西伯利亚汉特与曼西人的民间音乐，以叙事歌、个人歌和拨弦乐器传承生活记忆。
en: Western Siberian Khanty and Mansi traditions preserve memory through narrative songs, personal songs, and plucked-string instruments.

name: Oberek
zh: 快速旋转的波兰三拍舞曲，提琴奏出短促反复乐句，重音与舞者脚步紧密相随。
en: A fast Polish spinning dance in triple time, with short repeating fiddle phrases and accents matching dancers' steps.

name: Occitan Folk Music
zh: 法国南部奥克地区的民歌舞曲，以本地语言、风笛、手摇琴和集体歌唱见长。
en: Southern French Occitan traditions feature local-language songs, bagpipes, hurdy-gurdy, and communal dance music.

name: Occult Rock
zh: 围绕神秘学与仪式意象的硬摇滚，以厚重布鲁斯吉他、风琴和阴暗旋律营造氛围。
en: Occult-themed hard rock uses heavy blues-based guitars, organ, and dark melodies to suggest ritual and mystery.

name: Oceanian Music
zh: 大洋洲的音乐总称，涵盖原住民吟唱、鼓乐、岛屿合唱和吉他弦乐队传统。
en: Oceanian music encompasses Indigenous chanting, percussion traditions, island choral singing, and guitar-based string-band styles.

name: Odia Folk Music
zh: 印度奥迪沙的民间音乐，以奥里亚语故事歌唱、鼓乐和地方仪式歌舞见长。
en: Odisha's folk traditions feature Odia-language storytelling songs, drumming, and music for local rituals and dancing.

name: Odissi Classical Music
zh: 奥迪沙古典音乐以本地拉格与节奏体系组织歌唱，装饰旋律由马尔达尔鼓细致呼应。
en: Odisha's classical music shapes ornamented singing through regional ragas and rhythmic cycles, answered by mardala drumming.

name: Ogene Music
zh: 尼日利亚伊博人的锣乐，以金属钟锣交错节奏托起歌声，常伴随集体舞蹈。
en: Nigerian Igbo gong music supports singing with interlocking metallic bell rhythms, often accompanying communal dancing.

name: Oi!
zh: 以粗犷喊唱、整齐重拍和易合唱副歌呈现街头朋克，吉他乐句直接有力。
en: Street punk pairs rough shouting, pounding beats, and singalong choruses with direct, forceful guitar riffs.

name: Okinawan Music
zh: 冲绳音乐以三线琴、地方语言歌唱和装饰音见长，旋律在明亮与哀婉间流转。
en: Music from Okinawa featuring sanshin lutes, local-language singing, and ornamented melodies that move between brightness and wistfulness.

name: Old Roman Chant
zh: 古罗马礼仪中的单声部圣咏，以拉丁语经文和曲折装饰旋律展开无伴奏歌唱。
en: An early Roman liturgical chant tradition sets Latin texts to winding, ornamented melodies sung without accompaniment.

name: Old-Time
zh: 美国阿巴拉契亚弦乐传统，以提琴和班卓琴反复交织舞曲旋律，节奏紧贴脚步。
en: Appalachian string music interlocks fiddle and banjo in repeating dance tunes with rhythms closely tied to footwork.

name: Omutibo
zh: 肯尼亚西部指弹吉他音乐，让低音、旋律与节奏同时跃动，常配合歌声和敲瓶声。
en: Western Kenyan fingerstyle guitar interweaves bass, melody, and rhythm, often accompanied by singing and tapped bottles.

name: Onda nueva
zh: 委内瑞拉音乐将霍罗波的三拍节奏融入爵士和波萨诺瓦，编配轻巧、和声细腻。
en: Venezuelan music blends joropo's triple rhythms with jazz and bossa nova, using light arrangements and detailed harmonies.

name: Ondō
zh: 日本民间集体舞歌，以领唱与应答、明确鼓点和反复旋律带动环形舞蹈。
en: Japanese communal dance songs use lead-and-response singing, clear drum pulses, and repeated melodies for circle dancing.

name: Onkyo
zh: 以微弱电子声、环境杂音和长段静默进行即兴，让音色与房间声响共同构成作品。
en: Improvisation uses faint electronics, incidental noise, and long silences, allowing timbre and room sounds to shape the music.

name: Opera
zh: 以歌唱推进戏剧的舞台音乐，独唱、重唱与合唱在管弦伴奏中刻画人物和情节。
en: Sung drama uses solos, ensembles, and choruses with orchestral accompaniment to develop characters and advance the story.

name: Opera buffa
zh: 意大利喜歌剧以机敏对白式唱腔、喜剧情节和热闹重唱，描绘日常人物的误会与冲突。
en: Italian comic opera portrays everyday misunderstandings through nimble conversational singing, humorous plots, and lively vocal ensembles.

name: Opera semiseria
zh: 将严肃危机与喜剧角色并置的意大利歌剧，抒情独唱和轻快段落共同通向圆满结局。
en: Italian opera combines serious danger and comic characters, balancing lyrical solos and lighter scenes before a happy resolution.

name: Opera seria
zh: 意大利正歌剧以历史或神话人物为中心，用宣叙调推进剧情、华丽咏叹调展示情感。
en: Italian serious opera uses recitative for historical or mythological drama and elaborate arias to explore characters' emotions.

name: Operatic Pop
zh: 用歌剧式声乐技巧演绎流行旋律，以高扬唱腔、宏大弦乐和清楚副歌形成跨界声音。
en: Operatic vocal technique meets pop melodies, with soaring voices, sweeping strings, and clearly defined choruses.

name: Operetta
zh: 轻歌剧以歌唱、对白和舞蹈串起轻巧剧情，旋律易记，常带华尔兹式节奏。
en: Light theatrical stories combine singing, spoken dialogue, and dancing, with memorable tunes and frequent waltz rhythms.

name: OPM
zh: 菲律宾本土流行歌曲，涵盖抒情歌、民谣与乐队创作，重视熟悉旋律和情感表达。
en: Homegrown Filipino popular songs span ballads, folk-influenced writing, and band music, emphasizing memorable melodies and emotional delivery.

name: Opéra-ballet
zh: 法国巴洛克舞台作品，将歌唱与芭蕾编成多个独立段落，以管弦舞曲连接场景。
en: French Baroque theatre combines sung episodes and ballet in separate sections, linked by orchestral dance music.

name: Opéra-comique
zh: 法国歌剧形式，以口语对白连接歌曲和合奏，情节既可轻松，也可严肃悲剧。
en: A French operatic form links songs and ensembles through spoken dialogue, accommodating both light and tragic stories.

name: Oratorio
zh: 通常不作舞台扮演的大型叙事声乐，以独唱、合唱和管弦乐演绎宗教或世俗故事。
en: Large narrative vocal works use soloists, choir, and orchestra to tell sacred or secular stories, usually without staging.

name: Orchestral Music
zh: 以弦乐、木管、铜管与打击乐组成的大型合奏，通过配器和声部对比展开音乐。
en: Large ensembles of strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion develop music through orchestration and contrasts between instrumental groups.

name: Orchestral Song
zh: 由管弦乐伴奏的艺术歌曲，让独唱旋律与多层乐器音色共同诠释诗歌。
en: An art song with orchestral accompaniment lets a solo voice and layered instrumental colors interpret poetry together.

name: Organic House
zh: 浩室节奏配合手鼓、原声乐器和柔和环境纹理，以温暖低音与缓慢铺陈保持流动。
en: House rhythms meet hand percussion, acoustic instruments, and soft ambient textures, unfolding over warm, flowing bass.

name: Ori deck
zh: 塔希提电子舞曲，以缓慢切分鼓点、夸张滑音和波利尼西亚吟唱采样塑造摆动感。
en: Tahitian dance music combines slow syncopated drums, exaggerated pitch slides, and Polynesian vocal samples in a swaying electronic groove.

name: Oriental Ballad
zh: 韩国抒情歌融入东亚传统乐器与旋律色彩，以宽广弦乐和情绪鲜明的唱腔展开。
en: Korean ballads incorporate East Asian instrumental colors and melodic turns, supported by sweeping strings and expressive singing.

name: Oriental Jewish Music
zh: 西亚及北非犹太社群的音乐，以地方调式、装饰吟唱和礼仪诗歌延续社区传统。
en: West Asian and North African Jewish traditions preserve communal repertories through regional modes, ornamented chanting, and liturgical poetry.

name: Orkes gambus
zh: 印度尼西亚甘布斯乐队，以阿拉伯式鲁特琴、弦乐和手鼓伴随马来或阿拉伯语歌唱。
en: Indonesian gambus ensembles pair Arab-derived lutes, strings, and hand drums with Malay or Arabic singing.

name: Oromo Music
zh: 埃塞俄比亚奥罗莫人的音乐，以奥罗莫语歌声、反复应答和舞蹈节奏表达乡土生活。
en: Ethiopian Oromo music expresses local life through Oromo-language singing, repeated vocal responses, and dance-centered rhythms.

name: Orthodox Pop
zh: 正统犹太流行歌曲，以宗教文本、男声合唱和现代键盘或舞曲编配适应庆典与日常。
en: Orthodox Jewish pop combines religious texts and male choral singing with modern keyboards or dance arrangements.

name: Ossetian Folk Music
zh: 高加索奥塞梯人的民间音乐，以史诗歌唱、男声合唱和手风琴舞曲传承地方故事。
en: Caucasian Ossetian traditions preserve local stories through epic singing, male choruses, and accordion-led dance music.

name: Ottoman Military Music
zh: 奥斯曼军乐以穿透力强的祖尔纳管、响亮大鼓和铜镲奏出庄严行进节奏。
en: Ottoman military ensembles project piercing zurna reeds, booming drums, and cymbals in imposing processional rhythms.

name: Outlaw Country
zh: 以粗粝歌声、摇滚式节奏和简朴乐队编配演绎乡村歌曲，强调个人叙事与自主表达。
en: Rough-edged vocals, rock-inflected rhythms, and unfussy band arrangements carry country songs centered on personal stories and independence.

name: Outrun
zh: 带驾驶感的合成器舞曲，以滚动贝斯、明亮琶音和强劲鼓机重现复古动作片气氛。
en: Driving synth music uses rolling bass, bright arpeggios, and forceful drum machines to evoke retro action-film energy.

name: Outsider House
zh: 以粗糙录音、失真鼓机和不规整采样改写浩室，让舞曲带着实验与手工拼接感。
en: Rough recording, distorted drum machines, and irregular samples give house music an experimental, handmade character.

name: Overture
zh: 为歌剧、戏剧或音乐会开启篇章的器乐曲，以主题提示和力度变化建立期待。
en: An instrumental opening to opera, theatre, or concerts builds anticipation through thematic introductions and dynamic contrasts.

name: P-Funk
zh: 以厚重贝斯、层叠人声、铜管和合成器铺陈放克，长段循环常带迷幻色彩。
en: Thick bass, layered voices, horns, and synthesizers stretch funk into long grooves with psychedelic colors.

name: P-Pop
zh: 菲律宾当代流行音乐，以鲜明副歌、层叠人声和电子舞曲编排结合本地语言与唱法。
en: Contemporary Filipino pop combines strong choruses, layered vocals, and electronic dance production with local languages and vocal styles.

name: Pachanga
zh: 古巴舞曲以轻快切分节奏、长笛和小提琴带动跳步，旋律明亮而富于弹性。
en: Cuban dance music pairs buoyant syncopation with flute and violins, creating bright melodies for bouncing steps.

name: Pacific Reggae
zh: 太平洋岛屿雷鬼，以反拍吉他、温暖贝斯和当地语言的和声歌唱营造轻松律动。
en: Pacific island reggae combines offbeat guitars, warm bass, and local-language vocal harmonies in an easygoing groove.

name: Pagan Black Metal
zh: 围绕异教神话和自然信仰的黑金属，将尖啸、颤音吉他与民间旋律或吟唱结合。
en: Black metal explores pagan mythology and nature-centered beliefs through shrieks, tremolo guitars, folk melodies, and chants.

name: Paghjella
zh: 科西嘉男子无伴奏三声部歌唱，以低音支撑主旋律，高声部自由装饰和回响。
en: Corsican male a cappella singing layers three parts, with bass support, a central melody, and ornamented high responses.

name: Pagode
zh: 亲密合奏式桑巴，以卡瓦基纽琴、手鼓和弹性低音托起领唱与众人合唱。
en: Intimate samba ensembles pair cavaquinho, hand percussion, and springy bass with lead vocals and shared choruses.

name: Pagode romântico
zh: 以柔和主唱、甜美和声和抒情编配呈现桑巴情歌，保留轻巧的帕戈德打击节奏。
en: Romantic samba songs pair smooth lead vocals, sweet harmonies, and lyrical arrangements with light pagode percussion.

name: Pagodão
zh: 巴伊亚舞曲，以猛烈打击乐、短促口号和反复贝斯强调身体动作与群体应答。
en: Bahian dance music emphasizes physical movement through forceful percussion, short chants, repeated bass lines, and communal responses.

name: Paisley Underground
zh: 洛杉矶迷幻吉他流行，以清脆琶音、复古风琴和层叠和声重塑六十年代声音。
en: Los Angeles psychedelic pop revisits sixties sounds through chiming guitars, vintage organs, and layered vocal harmonies.

name: Pakacaping Music
zh: 南苏拉威西的鲁特琴歌唱，以卡查平琴反复拨弦，伴随歌者叙事或对唱。
en: South Sulawesi lute songs use repeating kacaping patterns to accompany storytelling or exchanges between singers.

name: Pala
zh: 奥迪沙叙事表演，以领唱、应答和鼓镲交织歌曲与解说，演绎宗教及文学故事。
en: Odisha's narrative performance interweaves singing and explanation through a lead voice, chorus, drums, and cymbals.

name: Palingsound
zh: 荷兰福伦丹流行音乐，以紧密多声部和声、顺滑旋律和精整乐队编配见长。
en: Volendam pop favors close multipart harmonies, smooth melodies, and neatly coordinated band arrangements with a sentimental edge.

name: Palm Wine Music
zh: 西非棕榈酒馆歌唱，以轻巧指弹吉他、手击节奏和随意对唱形成亲密气氛。
en: West African palm-wine music creates an intimate setting with lightly fingerpicked guitars, hand percussion, and conversational singing.

name: Palo de mayo
zh: 尼加拉瓜加勒比海岸的五月节歌舞，以明快打击乐、反复副歌和弹跳节奏带动集体舞蹈。
en: Nicaragua's Caribbean May celebrations feature lively percussion, repeated choruses, and springy rhythms for communal dancing.

name: Pamiri Music
zh: 帕米尔地区的音乐，以鲁巴布琴、手鼓和本地语言的宗教或抒情歌唱见长。
en: Pamir traditions feature rubab lutes, hand drums, and local-language devotional or lyrical singing.

name: Pandilla
zh: 秘鲁亚马孙狂欢节舞曲，以笛、鼓和反复旋律伴随人群绕树结队跳舞。
en: Peruvian Amazonian carnival music uses flutes, drums, and repeating melodies for communal dancing around a decorated palm post.

name: Pansori
zh: 韩国盘索里由一名歌者与鼓手合作，以沙哑而有力的唱腔、说白和呼喝讲述长篇故事。
en: A Korean singer and drummer tell extended stories through powerful, grainy vocals, spoken passages, and encouraging calls.

name: Papuan Folk Music
zh: 新几内亚原住民的民间音乐，以鼓、竹管乐器与集体歌唱陪伴仪式、舞蹈和日常生活。
en: New Guinea's Indigenous folk traditions combine drums, bamboo instruments, and group singing in rituals, dances, and everyday life.

name: Paramaribop
zh: 将苏里南卡塞科和卡维纳节奏带入爵士，以比博普和声和灵活即兴连接本地舞曲。
en: Surinamese kaseko and kawina rhythms meet bebop harmonies and agile jazz improvisation in a locally rooted fusion.

name: Parang
zh: 特立尼达圣诞歌唱，以西班牙语歌词、夸特罗琴、吉他和沙槌形成热闹串门合奏。
en: Trinidadian Christmas songs combine Spanish lyrics, cuatro, guitars, and maracas in lively house-to-house ensemble performances.

name: Parlour Music
zh: 为家庭客厅演唱或演奏的音乐，以易于上手的钢琴伴奏和鲜明抒情旋律为主。
en: Music for domestic parlors favors approachable piano accompaniments and clearly shaped lyrical melodies for home performance.

name: Partido alto
zh: 桑巴中的即兴应答形式，独唱者轮流编唱短句，众人以固定副歌和手鼓节奏回应。
en: Samba singers improvise short verses in turn, answered by a fixed chorus over interlocking hand percussion.

name: Partyschlager
zh: 为聚会合唱而写的德语通俗舞曲，以强拍电子伴奏、简单口号和反复副歌带动气氛。
en: German party pop combines pounding electronic accompaniment, simple chants, and repetitive choruses designed for collective singing.

name: Pashto Folk Music
zh: 普什图民间歌曲，以拉巴卜琴、手鼓和装饰唱腔演绎爱情诗、故事与舞曲。
en: Pashtun folk songs use rubab lutes, hand drums, and ornamented singing for love poetry, storytelling, and dancing.

name: Pasillo
zh: 安第斯地区的三拍歌舞，常以吉他和细腻歌声展开流畅旋律，带着华尔兹式摇摆。
en: Andean triple-time songs and dances often feature guitars and expressive singing with a flowing, waltz-like lilt.

name: Pasodoble
zh: 西班牙双步舞曲，以鲜明二拍、进行曲式重音和响亮管乐呈现昂扬步伐。
en: Spanish dance music uses a firm duple pulse, march-like accents, and ringing winds for bold, purposeful steps.

name: Passion
zh: 围绕耶稣受难叙事的声乐作品，以叙述独唱、合唱和器乐呈现不同人物与场景。
en: Vocal settings of Christ's Passion use solo narration, chorus, and instruments to portray different characters and scenes.

name: Payada
zh: 南美即兴唱诗，以吉他伴随歌者押韵问答，在反复曲调中比拼叙事与机智。
en: South American improvised verse uses guitar-backed rhyming exchanges, with singers testing storytelling and wit over recurring melodies.

name: Peak Time Techno
zh: 面向舞池高潮的技术舞曲，以强劲底鼓、厚低音和明显铺陈推动大型落差段落。
en: Techno built for dancefloor peaks uses forceful kicks, thick bass, and pronounced buildups leading into powerful drops.

name: Peking Opera
zh: 中国京剧以京胡、锣鼓和程式化唱念，借板式变化刻画人物、动作与戏剧情绪。
en: Chinese Peking opera uses jinghu, gongs, drums, and stylized singing and speech to portray characters and dramatic action.

name: Pennsylvania Dutch Folk Music
zh: 宾夕法尼亚德裔民间音乐，以方言歌谣、提琴或手风琴舞曲保存移民社区传统。
en: Pennsylvania German folk traditions preserve community memory through dialect songs and fiddle or accordion dance tunes.

name: Pep Band
zh: 体育场助威乐队，以响亮铜管、鼓组和熟悉旋律的短段演奏回应赛场气氛。
en: Sports pep bands use loud brass, drums, and short arrangements of familiar tunes to energize the crowd.

name: Persian Classical Music
zh: 波斯古典音乐以达斯特加赫调式与拉迪夫曲库展开，歌声和弦乐细致装饰、即兴呼应。
en: Persian classical musicians develop dastgah modes and radif repertory through finely ornamented singing, strings, and responsive improvisation.

name: Persian Folk Music
zh: 波斯民间歌曲以地方语言、拨弦或管乐和鼓点传唱爱情、劳动与节庆生活。
en: Persian folk songs carry love, work, and festive themes through regional languages, strings, winds, and percussion.

name: Persian Music
zh: 波斯音乐涵盖调式古典曲目、地方歌唱与现代流行创作，常重视诗词和细密装饰音。
en: Persian music spans modal classical repertory, regional singing, and contemporary pop, often emphasizing poetry and detailed ornamentation.

name: Persian Pop
zh: 波斯语流行歌曲，将装饰性唱腔与西式和声、电子节拍或弦乐抒情编配结合。
en: Persian-language pop combines ornamented singing with Western harmonies, electronic rhythms, or lyrical string arrangements.

name: Peruvian Music
zh: 秘鲁音乐横跨安第斯管弦、沿海吉他鼓乐和亚马孙舞曲，反映不同地区的歌舞传统。
en: Peruvian music spans Andean winds and strings, coastal guitar-and-drum traditions, and Amazonian dance styles.

name: Philippine Music
zh: 菲律宾音乐涵盖锣乐、竹制乐器、弦乐合奏与现代歌曲，汇集群岛各地的歌舞传统。
en: Philippine music encompasses gong ensembles, bamboo instruments, plucked strings, and modern songs across the archipelago.

name: Philippine Rondalla
zh: 菲律宾拨弦乐队，以班杜里亚琴、劳德琴和吉他齐奏旋律，音色清脆、颗粒分明。
en: Philippine plucked-string ensembles combine bandurria, laud, and guitar in bright, crisply articulated melodic arrangements.

name: Philly Club
zh: 费城俱乐部舞曲，以快速碎拍、三连底鼓和切碎人声推动舞步，常穿插警笛音效。
en: Philadelphia club music drives dancing with fast breaks, triplet kicks, chopped vocals, and occasional siren effects.

name: Philly Club Rap
zh: 把说唱铺在费城俱乐部的快速三连底鼓与人声切片上，押韵和舞步节奏紧密相扣。
en: Rapping locks into Philadelphia club beats, riding fast triplet kicks and chopped vocal samples with dance-focused phrasing.

name: Philly Drill
zh: 费城街头说唱，以底特律式跳跃鼓点、阴暗循环和直接强硬的唱词呈现街区生活。
en: Philadelphia drill pairs Detroit-influenced bouncing drums and dark loops with blunt, forceful street narratives.

name: Philly Soul
zh: 费城灵魂乐以流动弦乐、精致铜管和柔滑人声铺陈旋律，节奏温暖而适合舞动。
en: Philadelphia soul layers flowing strings, polished horns, and smooth vocals over warm, danceable rhythms.

name: Phleng phuea chiwit
zh: 泰国社会民谣摇滚，以吉他、朴实唱腔和当地旋律讲述劳动、乡村与社会处境。
en: Thai socially engaged folk-rock uses guitars, plainspoken singing, and local melodies to tell of work, rural life, and inequality.

name: Phonk
zh: 以孟菲斯说唱采样、朦胧爵士循环和沉重鼓机，拼出粗糙而摇摆的嘻哈声音。
en: Memphis rap samples, hazy jazz loops, and heavy drum machines form a grainy, swinging hip-hop sound.

name: Phonk House
zh: 将漂移冯克的失真牛铃旋律和粗糙人声，放进连续四拍底鼓与浩室低音节奏。
en: Distorted drift-phonk cowbell melodies and gritty vocals ride four-on-the-floor kicks and house-style bass grooves.

name: Piano Blues
zh: 以钢琴承担布鲁斯的伴奏与即兴，左手低音节奏衬托右手蓝调旋律。
en: Piano carries blues accompaniment and improvisation, with left-hand bass patterns supporting expressive right-hand melodic lines.

name: Piano Rock
zh: 以钢琴取代吉他成为摇滚中心，用和弦重击、流动琶音和乐队鼓点支撑歌唱。
en: Piano leads a rock band through struck chords and flowing arpeggios, with drums supporting the vocal melody.

name: Picopop
zh: 日本电子流行以闪烁芯片音、俏皮合成器和轻快人声，营造糖果般的跳跃旋律。
en: Japanese electronic pop combines sparkling chip sounds, playful synths, and light vocals in brightly bouncing melodies.

name: Piedmont Blues
zh: 美国皮德蒙特布鲁斯以交替低音指弹吉他，编织拉格泰姆般跳跃旋律并伴随歌唱。
en: Piedmont blues interweaves alternating-thumb bass and ragtime-like guitar melodies beneath relaxed, conversational singing.

name: Pigfuck
zh: 粗粝地下噪声摇滚，以刺耳吉他、强硬重复节奏和挑衅唱腔呈现怪诞或讽刺气质。
en: Rough underground noise rock uses abrasive guitars, forceful repetitive rhythms, and confrontational vocals for grotesque or satirical effect.

name: Pilón
zh: 古巴舞曲以钢琴与电吉他同时奏出交错循环，打击乐维持模仿舂捣动作的重音。
en: Cuban dance music interlocks piano and electric-guitar patterns over percussion accents associated with pounding movements.

name: Pimba
zh: 葡萄牙聚会流行歌，以手风琴、简单舞曲节奏和双关笑料唱词鼓励众人跟唱。
en: Portuguese party pop combines accordion, simple dance rhythms, and double-entendre lyrics that invite the crowd to sing along.

name: Pimp Rap
zh: 以皮条客形象、奢华生活和街头话术为中心的说唱，常配松弛放克低音与灵魂采样。
en: Rap built around pimp personas, luxury, and streetwise talk often rides relaxed funk bass and soul samples.

name: Pinoy Folk Rock
zh: 菲律宾民谣摇滚，以原声吉他、当地语言歌词和乐队节奏讲述个人与社会生活。
en: Filipino folk-rock combines acoustic guitars, local-language lyrics, and band rhythms in personal and socially grounded songs.

name: Pinpeat
zh: 高棉宫廷与仪式合奏，以排琴、锣圈、双簧管和鼓交织明亮旋律，伴随舞剧展开。
en: Khmer ceremonial ensembles interlock xylophones, gong circles, double reeds, and drums, often accompanying dance drama.

name: Piosenka aktorska
zh: 波兰演员歌曲以角色化演唱和细致咬字诠释歌词，伴奏随戏剧语气与情绪变化。
en: Polish actors' songs interpret lyrics through characterful delivery and precise diction, with accompaniment following dramatic tone and mood.

name: Pipe Band
zh: 苏格兰风笛鼓乐队，以持续低音、齐奏高音旋律和密集军鼓花奏形成行进声音。
en: Scottish pipe bands combine sustained drones, unison high melodies, and intricate snare patterns in a strong marching sound.

name: Piphat
zh: 泰国传统合奏，以双簧管、排琴、锣圈和鼓层层交织旋律，服务于舞剧与仪式。
en: Thai ensembles layer double reeds, xylophones, gong circles, and drums into interlocking melodies for theatre and ceremony.

name: Pirekua
zh: 墨西哥普雷佩查人的抒情歌，以舒缓独唱或和声讲述爱情、历史和社区生活。
en: Mexican P'urhépecha songs use gentle solo or harmonized singing to convey love, history, and community life.

name: Piseiro
zh: 巴西简约福罗舞曲，以电子键盘、紧密合成鼓点和容易跟唱的男声旋律见长。
en: A stripped-back Brazilian forró style pairs electronic keyboards, tight programmed drums, and readily singable male vocal melodies.

name: Piyyut
zh: 为犹太礼拜及宗教场合谱唱的诗歌，旋律随社群传统变化，重视经文与装饰吟唱。
en: Jewish liturgical poetry is sung in community-specific melodies, emphasizing sacred words and ornamented vocal delivery.

name: Pizzica
zh: 意大利萨伦托的塔兰泰拉舞曲，以急促铃鼓、反复旋律和歌声推动旋转跳步。
en: Salento's tarantella tradition drives turning dance steps with rapid tambourines, repeating melodies, and sung lines.

name: Plainsong
zh: 无伴奏的单声部基督教圣咏，旋律依经文语气流动，通常不强调规则重拍。
en: Unaccompanied Christian chant follows a single melodic line shaped by the text, usually without a regular accented beat.

name: Plena
zh: 波多黎各叙事歌舞，以不同尺寸框鼓交错节奏，领唱和副歌轮番讲述新闻与日常。
en: Puerto Rican narrative songs alternate lead verses and choruses over interlocking frame drums of different sizes.

name: Plugg
zh: 轻盈陷阱说唱，以游戏般合成器、空旷和弦和松散鼓点衬托低声、随意的人声。
en: Airy trap pairs game-like synths, spacious chords, and loose drums with quiet, casual vocal delivery.

name: PluggnB
zh: 将柔滑节奏布鲁斯和弦与旋律唱腔放进Plugg节拍，键盘轻盈，低音富于弹性。
en: Smooth R&B chords and melodic vocals meet plugg beats, with airy keyboards and elastic bass.

name: Plunderphonics
zh: 以现成录音为主体，通过切片、变速与重组改写熟悉音乐，采样本身成为作品。
en: Existing recordings are sliced, altered in speed, and recombined, making recognizable sampled material the substance of the composition.

name: Poetry
zh: 以朗读呈现的诗歌，用声音的重音、停顿和语速展现文字的节奏与意象。
en: Spoken poetry uses vocal emphasis, pauses, and pacing to reveal the rhythm and imagery of the words.

name: Poezja śpiewana
zh: 波兰诗歌谱唱，以清晰吐字与简朴钢琴或吉他伴奏，让文字的节奏和意境居于中心。
en: Polish sung poetry foregrounds verbal rhythm and imagery through clear diction and spare piano or guitar accompaniment.

name: Polifonia occitana
zh: 奥克地区的多声部民间歌唱，以主旋律、低声部和高声部自由交织，常无乐器伴奏。
en: Occitan multipart singing freely weaves a central melody with lower and higher voices, often without instrumental accompaniment.

name: Polish Folk Music
zh: 波兰民间音乐，以提琴、手风琴和歌唱演绎旋转舞曲，重音与三拍节奏常富于变化。
en: Polish folk ensembles use fiddles, accordion, and singing for turning dances with lively shifts of accent and triple rhythm.

name: Polish Goral Music
zh: 波兰塔特拉山区的高地音乐，以高亢歌声、急促提琴和低弦节奏伴随舞蹈。
en: Polish Tatra highland music pairs piercing voices, brisk fiddles, and low-string accompaniment with vigorous dancing.

name: Polish Music
zh: 波兰音乐涵盖玛祖卡等民间舞曲、诗歌谱唱和古典创作，也包括多样城市流行传统。
en: Polish music spans folk dances such as mazurkas, sung poetry, classical composition, and varied urban popular traditions.

name: Political Hip Hop
zh: 把政治议题、权力关系和社会批评写进说唱，以押韵叙事和节奏强调立场。
en: Rap uses rhymed narratives and rhythmic emphasis to address political issues, power relations, and social criticism.

name: Polka
zh: 轻快二拍民间舞曲，以强弱分明的伴奏和跳跃旋律配合双人转圈步伐。
en: A lively duple-time dance pairs clearly alternating accents with bouncing melodies for partnered turning steps.

name: Polka paraguaya
zh: 巴拉圭弦乐舞曲，以竖琴或吉他交织二拍与三拍，旋律流畅而节奏错落。
en: Paraguayan dance music interweaves duple and triple rhythms on harp or guitar beneath flowing melodies.

name: Polka peruana
zh: 秘鲁沿海波尔卡，以吉他、卡洪鼓和歌唱改写轻快二拍，带出克里奥尔式切分。
en: Peruvian coastal polka adds Creole syncopation to a brisk duple beat through guitars, cajón, and singing.

name: Polonaise
zh: 庄重的波兰三拍行列舞曲，以鲜明节奏型和有分量的第一拍展现缓步前行感。
en: A stately Polish processional dance uses a distinctive triple-time rhythm and weighty first beats for measured movement.

name: Polska
zh: 北欧三拍双人舞曲，提琴旋律随不均匀拍长摆动，重音紧贴旋转与落脚。
en: Nordic partnered dances in triple time use uneven beat lengths and fiddle accents closely tied to turning steps.

name: Polynesian Music
zh: 波利尼西亚音乐涵盖吟唱、鼓舞、多声部合唱与尤克里里歌谣，重视集体参与和口传。
en: Polynesian traditions encompass chants, drum dances, multipart choirs, and ukulele songs, emphasizing communal participation and oral transmission.

name: Polyphonic Chant
zh: 多条人声旋律同时吟唱，声部通过持续低音、模仿或和声交织形成层次。
en: Multiple vocal lines are chanted together, creating layers through drones, imitation, or interwoven harmonies.

name: Pon-chak disco
zh: 把韩国特洛特歌曲串成连续舞曲，以电子双拍、明亮键盘和反复人声推动舞步。
en: Korean trot becomes continuous dance music through insistent electronic duple beats, bright keyboards, and repeated vocal phrases.

name: Ponto de umbanda
zh: 巴西翁班达仪式歌曲，以领唱、集体应答和鼓声呼唤神灵并引导礼仪进程。
en: Brazilian Umbanda ritual songs use a lead singer, communal responses, and drums to invoke spirits and guide ceremonies.

name: Pop
zh: 以容易记住的旋律、清楚副歌和紧凑歌曲结构为中心，编配随时代与制作风格变化。
en: Memorable melodies, clear choruses, and compact song structures take center stage, with arrangements adapting to changing production styles.

name: Pop Batak
zh: 苏门答腊巴塔克流行歌曲，以当地语言和紧密人声和声结合吉他、键盘与现代节奏。
en: Batak pop combines local-language singing and close vocal harmonies with guitars, keyboards, and modern rhythms.

name: Pop Ghazal
zh: 将加扎勒诗歌的爱情与思念放进流行歌曲，以装饰唱腔配合现代和声及乐队伴奏。
en: Ghazal poetry about love and longing meets pop songwriting, with ornamented vocals, modern harmony, and band accompaniment.

name: Pop Kreatif
zh: 印尼流行音乐融合爵士和声、放克低音与软摇滚编配，旋律细腻，键盘音色明亮。
en: Indonesian pop combines jazz harmonies, funk bass, and soft-rock arrangements with detailed melodies and bright keyboards.

name: Pop Minang
zh: 米南加保语流行歌曲，将地方笛音和装饰唱腔融入电子键盘与现代舞曲节奏。
en: Minangkabau-language pop blends regional flute colors and ornamented singing with electronic keyboards and modern dance rhythms.

name: Pop Punk
zh: 用紧凑朋克吉他和快速鼓点承托朗朗上口的旋律、副歌与合唱段落。
en: Tight punk guitars and fast drums support catchy melodies, clear choruses, and energetic singalong passages.

name: Pop Rap
zh: 把说唱段落与易记的歌唱副歌结合，节奏明快，制作突出旋律与流行歌曲结构。
en: Rap verses meet memorable sung choruses, with accessible rhythms and production emphasizing melody and familiar pop structure.

name: Pop Raï
zh: 以现代键盘、电子节拍和流行副歌改写阿尔及利亚拉伊，保留富于装饰的歌声。
en: Modern keyboards, electronic beats, and pop choruses reshape Algerian raï while retaining its ornamented vocal delivery.

name: Pop Reggae
zh: 将雷鬼反拍和温暖低音放入紧凑流行歌曲，以清楚副歌和柔滑人声突出旋律。
en: Reggae offbeats and warm bass meet compact pop structures, with clear choruses and smooth vocals emphasizing melody.

name: Pop Rock
zh: 以摇滚吉他、贝斯和鼓演绎紧凑流行歌曲，突出易记旋律与鲜明副歌。
en: Guitars, bass, and drums give compact pop songs a rock foundation, emphasizing memorable melodies and strong choruses.

name: Pop Soul
zh: 将富于情绪的灵魂唱腔编进流行歌曲，配合清楚副歌、和声及整洁乐队伴奏。
en: Expressive soul vocals meet accessible pop structures, clear choruses, harmonies, and polished band arrangements.

name: Pop Sunda
zh: 巽他语流行歌曲，将当地五声音调、笛音与装饰唱腔融入键盘和现代乐队编配。
en: Sundanese pop blends regional pentatonic melodies, flute colors, and ornamented singing with keyboards and modern band arrangements.

name: Pop Yeh-Yeh
zh: 马来语吉他流行，以英式节拍摇滚的明快鼓点、清亮吉他和短小旋律伴随歌唱。
en: Malay-language guitar pop pairs British beat-style drums, bright guitars, and concise melodic hooks with local singing.

name: Pops Orchestra
zh: 以交响乐队演奏流行歌曲、电影主题和轻音乐，让熟悉旋律拥有宽阔管弦音色。
en: Symphony orchestras perform popular songs, film themes, and light music, giving familiar melodies broad orchestral colors.

name: Porn Groove
zh: 以哇音吉他、弹跳贝斯和放克鼓点营造复古情色配乐感，常配柔滑键盘与喘息采样。
en: Wah-wah guitars, springy bass, and funk drums evoke vintage adult-film scores, often adding smooth keyboards and breathy samples.

name: Pornogrind
zh: 以色情或荒诞内容为题的碾核，突出降调兽吼、失真低音和反复沉重节奏。
en: Grindcore with sexual or absurd themes emphasizes pitch-shifted guttural vocals, distorted low end, and repetitive heavy rhythms.

name: Porro
zh: 哥伦比亚加勒比地区的舞曲，以铜管、单簧管和鼓乐奏出明亮而摇摆的二拍节奏。
en: Colombian Caribbean dance music combines brass, clarinets, and drums in bright, swaying duple-time rhythms.

name: Portuguese Folk Music
zh: 葡萄牙民间歌舞，以地方弦乐、手风琴和应答歌声伴随节庆与乡村生活。
en: Portuguese folk songs and dances, with regional string instruments, accordions and answering voices accompanying festivals and rural life.

name: Portuguese Music
zh: 葡萄牙的音乐传统与创作，涵盖法朵的哀婉歌声、民间舞曲和现代流行音乐。
en: Music from Portugal, encompassing the plaintive singing of fado, regional folk dances and contemporary popular styles.

name: Positive Punk
zh: 早期哥特朋克，以突出的贝斯、部落式鼓点和戏剧化人声营造阴暗气氛。
en: An early gothic punk style, combining prominent basslines and tribal drumming with theatrical vocals and a dark atmosphere.

name: Post-Bop
zh: 将硬波普的演奏力度与调式、自由即兴结合，和声与节奏更灵活开放的爵士。
en: Jazz that combines hard bop's drive with modal harmony and freer improvisation, opening up its harmonic and rhythmic language.

name: Post-Britpop
zh: 承接英伦流行的另类摇滚，以流畅旋律、清晰吉他和宽阔副歌形成亲切的听感。
en: British alternative rock following Britpop, with smooth melodies, clear guitar lines and expansive, accessible choruses.

name: Post-Dubstep
zh: 从回响贝斯延伸的电子音乐，以错落鼓点、剪切人声和低频探索更细腻的空间。
en: Electronic music branching from dubstep, exploring intricate rhythmic patterns, cut-up vocals and spacious low frequencies.

name: Post-Grunge
zh: 保留垃圾摇滚的粗粝吉他与沙哑唱腔，配上更整齐的结构和突出副歌。
en: Rock that pairs grunge's gritty guitars and raspy singing with more polished arrangements and prominent choruses.

name: Post-Hardcore
zh: 从硬核朋克延伸，以不规则节奏、突变的轻重段落和嘶喊探索更复杂的编曲。
en: Rock expanding hardcore punk through irregular rhythms, abrupt dynamic shifts and screamed vocals in more exploratory arrangements.

name: Post-Industrial
zh: 从工业音乐延伸的实验声音，运用机械节奏、噪声处理与拼贴形成不同质地。
en: Music extending industrial experimentation through mechanical rhythms, processed noise and sound collage in varied forms.

name: Post-Metal
zh: 让厚重金属吉他反复铺展，以缓慢累积、氛围段落和强烈起伏构成长篇乐曲。
en: Metal built around repeating heavy guitar figures, atmospheric passages and gradual builds that unfold across extended compositions.

name: Post-Minimalism
zh: 以重复音型为起点，加入更自由的和声、旋律与配器变化的当代古典音乐。
en: Contemporary classical music that expands repeating patterns with freer harmonic movement, melodic development and changes in instrumentation.

name: Post-Punk
zh: 延伸朋克的实验摇滚，以突出的贝斯、棱角分明的吉他和多变鼓点重塑歌曲。
en: Experimental rock extending punk through prominent basslines, angular guitars and inventive rhythms that reshape conventional song forms.

name: Post-Punk Revival
zh: 重拾后朋克的利落吉他和弹跳贝斯，以紧凑鼓点与鲜明副歌推动独立摇滚。
en: Indie rock reviving post-punk's sharp guitars and springy basslines, driven by tight drums and memorable choruses.

name: Post-Rock
zh: 用摇滚乐器铺展音色与空间，常以反复音型、渐强和器乐长段落组织乐曲。
en: Music using rock instruments to explore texture and space through repeating figures, gradual crescendos and extended instrumental passages.

name: Power Electronics
zh: 以刺耳反馈、持续电子噪声与失真嘶喊构成压迫感强烈的工业噪音。
en: Industrial noise built from piercing feedback, sustained electronic distortion and harshly processed or shouted vocals.

name: Power Metal
zh: 以快速双踩、明亮吉他旋律和高亢清唱塑造昂扬、史诗感强烈的金属。
en: Metal with rapid double-kick drums, bright melodic guitars and soaring clean vocals that give songs an epic sweep.

name: Power Noise
zh: 把失真噪声压进反复机械节拍，以粗糙音色与强劲脉冲形成工业舞曲。
en: Industrial electronic music locking distorted noise into repeating mechanical beats, with abrasive textures and forceful rhythmic pulses.

name: Power Pop
zh: 用响亮吉他、明快和声与紧凑编曲，把流行旋律的钩子推到歌曲前景。
en: Guitar pop that foregrounds catchy melodic hooks, bright vocal harmonies and punchy, tightly arranged songs.

name: Power Soca
zh: 速度较快、鼓点更猛烈的索卡，以强劲低音和呼喊式副歌带动狂欢节舞步。
en: Fast, forceful soca with pounding drums, heavy bass and shouted hooks designed to drive carnival dancing.

name: Powerstomp
zh: 英国硬核舞曲的强硬分支，以重踢鼓、跳动低音和明亮合成器旋律制造冲劲。
en: A harder strain of UK hardcore, combining stomping kicks and bouncing bass with bright, energetic synthesizer melodies.

name: Powerviolence
zh: 把极快硬核与沉重慢段骤然切换，以短促歌曲、嘶吼和爆裂鼓点制造冲击。
en: Hardcore that abruptly switches between frantic blasts and crushing slow sections, with short songs and harsh shouted vocals.

name: Powwow Music
zh: 北美原住民聚会舞蹈音乐，以围鼓齐唱、强烈重拍和高亢歌声带动舞步。
en: Indigenous North American dance music featuring groups singing around a large drum, with emphatic beats and high, carrying voices.

name: Praise Break
zh: 黑人教会礼拜中的即兴欢庆段落，以疾走管风琴、密集鼓点和呼喊推动舞动。
en: Celebratory passages in Black church worship, driven by racing organ lines, busy drums and shouted responses.

name: Prank Call
zh: 以恶作剧电话的对话为内容，通过冒充角色、误会和临场反应制造笑点。
en: Comedy recordings of prank telephone conversations, using invented personas, misunderstandings and spontaneous reactions to create humor.

name: Prehistoric Music
zh: 依据考古发现重建史前声音，以骨笛、石质打击乐等仿制乐器探索早期音乐。
en: Reconstructions of prehistoric sound using instruments such as bone flutes and stone percussion modeled on archaeological finds.

name: Prelude
zh: 短小的古典器乐作品，可作引子或独立成篇，常围绕一种织体或乐思展开。
en: Short classical instrumental pieces, introductory or independent, often exploring a single texture, figure or musical idea.

name: Process Music
zh: 让预设规则直接推动音乐变化，以相位移动、音型增减等可听见的过程构曲。
en: Music whose form emerges from audible procedures, such as shifting phases or gradually adding and removing notes.

name: Progressive Big Band
zh: 以大乐队铜管与簧管编制探索新和声、复杂节奏和更自由的爵士编曲。
en: Big-band jazz exploring adventurous harmonies, complex rhythms and freer arrangements through large brass and reed sections.

name: Progressive Bluegrass
zh: 扩展蓝草的班卓琴与弦乐合奏，加入更长即兴、跨风格曲目和现代和声。
en: Bluegrass expanding its banjo-led string sound through extended improvisation, wider repertoire and more modern harmonies.

name: Progressive Breaks
zh: 以碎拍为骨架，逐层加入旋律、合成器音色与过渡，让舞曲缓缓展开。
en: Breakbeat dance music that unfolds gradually, layering melodic figures, synthesizer textures and extended transitions over broken rhythms.

name: Progressive Country
zh: 突破传统乡村编制与题材，吸收摇滚、民谣和个人化词作的乡村音乐。
en: Country music broadening traditional arrangements and themes through rock influences, folk songwriting and more personal lyrics.

name: Progressive Electronic
zh: 以合成器、音序器和长篇器乐探索声音，反复脉冲与缓慢变化的音色相互铺展。
en: Electronic music exploring synthesizers and sequencers through extended instrumental forms, repeating pulses and gradually evolving textures.

name: Progressive Folk
zh: 把民谣的原声乐器与叙事扩展成长篇结构，加入复杂编配和跨传统的声音。
en: Folk music expanding acoustic instruments and storytelling through extended structures, adventurous arrangements and influences from other traditions.

name: Progressive House
zh: 在稳定浩室鼓点上逐层叠加旋律与音色，用长过渡和渐进变化塑造舞池起伏。
en: House music building layers of melody and texture over steady beats, with extended transitions and gradual shifts in intensity.

name: Progressive Metal
zh: 以复杂拍号、长篇结构和高难度演奏扩展金属，常在沉重与细腻段落间转换。
en: Metal with complex meters, extended forms and demanding instrumental playing, often shifting between heavy and delicate passages.

name: Progressive Pop
zh: 保留流行歌曲的旋律吸引力，同时探索复杂结构、意外和声与精细录音编排。
en: Pop retaining memorable melodies while exploring unusual structures, unexpected harmonies and intricate studio arrangements.

name: Progressive Psytrance
zh: 节奏较从容的迷幻出神舞曲，以滚动低音、细小音效和渐进层次持续推进。
en: A more measured form of psytrance, advancing through rolling basslines, small sonic details and gradually developing layers.

name: Progressive Rock
zh: 以长篇结构、变换拍号和复杂器乐编配扩展摇滚，常借鉴古典与爵士手法。
en: Rock with extended structures, changing meters and elaborate instrumental arrangements, often drawing on classical and jazz techniques.

name: Progressive Soul
zh: 把灵魂乐扩展为更长、更复杂的歌曲，融入迷幻音色、实验编配与社会性主题。
en: Soul expanding into longer, more complex songs through psychedelic textures, exploratory arrangements and socially engaged lyrics.

name: Progressive Trance
zh: 以稳步递进的音层、流动低音与长过渡构成出神舞曲，旋律随编排慢慢展开。
en: Trance built around steadily developing layers, flowing basslines and extended transitions, allowing melodies to emerge gradually.

name: Proto-Punk
zh: 在朋克成形前以粗糙吉他、简短重复乐句与直接唱法探索猛烈原始的摇滚。
en: Raw rock preceding punk, with rough guitars, short repeated riffs and direct vocals that anticipate its confrontational energy.

name: Psybient
zh: 把迷幻电子音色放进舒缓节奏与宽阔空间，常以回声低音和细密音效缓慢流动。
en: Chilled psychedelic electronics with spacious textures, echoing bass and intricate effects that drift over relaxed rhythms.

name: Psybreaks
zh: 将迷幻出神的滚动低音与扭曲音效放进碎拍，以切分鼓组推动舞曲。
en: Breakbeat dance music combining rolling psychedelic basslines and warped effects with syncopated, broken drum patterns.

name: Psychedelia
zh: 以失真、回声、循环和陌生音色改变听觉空间的音乐，常有游移与恍惚感。
en: Music reshaping sonic space through distortion, echoes, loops and unfamiliar timbres, often creating a drifting, dreamlike impression.

name: Psychedelic Folk
zh: 以原声民谣为底，加入持续音、异质乐器与飘忽唱腔，营造迷幻听感。
en: Acoustic folk colored by drones, unusual instruments and drifting vocals, giving traditional song forms a psychedelic atmosphere.

name: Psychedelic Pop
zh: 将迷幻录音效果、奇异配器和旋转音色嵌入短小、旋律鲜明的流行歌曲。
en: Melodic pop songs colored by psychedelic studio effects, unusual instrumentation and swirling textures within concise arrangements.

name: Psychedelic Rock
zh: 以失真吉他、持续音和回声铺展摇滚，常通过即兴长段落营造迷幻空间。
en: Rock using distorted guitars, drones and echo, often opening into extended improvisations and immersive psychedelic textures.

name: Psychedelic Soul
zh: 把灵魂乐的热烈歌声与放克节奏结合迷幻吉他、录音效果和开阔编曲。
en: Soul pairing expressive vocals and funk rhythms with psychedelic guitars, studio effects and expansive arrangements.

name: Psychobilly
zh: 把摇滚比利的拨弦低音与朋克的速度、失真和嘶喊结合，常带怪诞恐怖题材。
en: Rockabilly's slap bass meets punk speed, distorted guitars and rough vocals, often with macabre or horror-themed lyrics.

name: Psychsploitation
zh: 迎合迷幻热潮的录音室流行与摇滚，以模糊失真吉他、风琴和夸张音效突出风味。
en: Studio-made pop and rock capitalizing on psychedelia, with fuzz guitars, organs and conspicuous sound effects.

name: Psycore
zh: 极快的黑暗迷幻出神舞曲，以密集低音、尖锐噪声与突变音效形成不安听感。
en: Extremely fast dark psytrance, packed with relentless bass, abrasive noise and abrupt effects that create an unsettling atmosphere.

name: Psystyle
zh: 把迷幻出神的滚动低音接入硬式舞曲，以强硬踢鼓、三连音律动和电子音效推进。
en: Hardstyle incorporating psytrance's rolling basslines, combining hard kicks, triplet grooves and psychedelic electronic effects.

name: Psytrance
zh: 以持续四拍踢鼓、快速滚动低音和变形合成器音色构成催眠般的电子舞曲。
en: Electronic dance music driven by steady kicks, rapid rolling basslines and morphing synthesizer sounds with a hypnotic flow.

name: Pub Rock
zh: 以酒吧小场地演奏为中心的朴实摇滚，强调直接节拍、吉他乐句与节奏蓝调根基。
en: Straightforward rock associated with pub stages, emphasizing direct beats, guitar riffs and strong rhythm-and-blues roots.

name: Pueblo Music
zh: 普韦布洛诸族的歌唱传统，仪式齐唱常伴大鼓与摇响器，旋律结构细密多变。
en: Pueblo singing traditions with intricate melodic forms, often performed communally in ceremonies with drums and rattles.

name: Pungmul
zh: 韩国民间打击合奏，以小锣、大锣、长鼓和桶鼓交织节奏，伴随舞蹈与行进。
en: Korean folk percussion combining small and large gongs, hourglass drums and barrel drums in interlocking rhythms for dance and procession.

name: Punjabi Folk Music
zh: 旁遮普民间歌舞，以多尔鼓的有力节拍、短颈弹拨乐器和高亢应答歌声见长。
en: Punjabi folk songs and dances, often driven by dhol drums, plucked strings and strong call-and-response singing.

name: Punk / Post-Punk / Hardcore
name_zh: 朋克 / 后朋克 / 硬核
zh: 围绕朋克及其分支的音乐，涵盖简短直接的吉他歌曲、硬核冲击与后朋克实验。
en: Music encompassing punk and its branches, from direct guitar songs and hardcore intensity to post-punk experimentation.

name: Punk Blues
zh: 把布鲁斯的重复乐句与粗糙朋克结合，以失真吉他、简陋录音和喊唱形成原始冲劲。
en: Blues riffs stripped into raw punk, with distorted guitars, rough recordings and shouted vocals giving the music a primitive drive.

name: Punk Poetry
zh: 以朋克的直接态度朗诵诗作，强调口语节奏、社会批评与现场表达。
en: Spoken poetry with punk's direct delivery, emphasizing conversational rhythms, social criticism and the immediacy of live performance.

name: Punk Rock
zh: 以简短歌曲、快速鼓点和失真和弦表达直接态度，唱法常带喊叫与粗粝感。
en: Rock built from short songs, fast drums and distorted chords, with direct lyrics and rough or shouted vocals.

name: Punta
zh: 加里富纳舞蹈音乐，以双鼓交错节奏、摇响器和领唱应答伴随快速腰胯舞步。
en: Garifuna dance music with interlocking drums, rattles and call-and-response singing accompanying rapid hip movements.

name: Purple Sound
zh: 旋律鲜明的回响贝斯分支，以闪亮合成器、放克低音和电子游戏般音色形成弹性。
en: Melodic dubstep with bright synthesizers, funk-inspired basslines and videogame-like tones that give the rhythms a springy feel.

name: Purísima
zh: 尼加拉瓜敬奉圣母的节庆歌曲，以反复赞歌、集体歌唱和应答表达信仰。
en: Nicaraguan devotional songs honoring the Virgin Mary through repeated hymns, communal singing and answering phrases during celebrations.

name: Puxa
zh: 圣多美和普林西比的电声舞曲，以交错吉他、活跃低音和非洲舞曲律动推动歌声。
en: Electric dance music from São Tomé and Príncipe, with interlocking guitars, lively basslines and African dance rhythms supporting the vocals.

name: Pásztordal
zh: 匈牙利牧人歌谣，以自由舒展的独唱旋律讲述牧放生活，常带装饰音。
en: Hungarian shepherd songs, with freely unfolding solo melodies and vocal ornaments telling stories of pastoral life.

name: Pìobaireachd
zh: 苏格兰高地风笛的长篇独奏，以缓慢主题及逐渐繁复的装饰变奏铺展。
en: Extended Highland bagpipe music unfolding from a measured theme into increasingly intricate ornamental variations.

name: Qaraami
zh: 索马里抒情歌曲，以乌德琴的装饰旋律与鼓点衬托歌声，重视诗意与情感表达。
en: Somali lyrical songs pairing expressive voices with ornamented oud melodies and drums, placing poetry and emotion at the center.

name: Qasidah modern
zh: 印尼现代伊斯兰歌曲，以宗教唱词、框鼓节奏和键盘等流行编制结合传统与现代。
en: Indonesian Islamic songs combining devotional lyrics and frame-drum rhythms with keyboards and other modern popular instrumentation.

name: Qawwali
zh: 南亚苏菲虔敬歌唱，以领唱应答、拍手、风琴与鼓点反复累积热度。
en: South Asian Sufi devotional singing building intensity through call and response, handclaps, harmonium and repeating drum patterns.

name: Quan họ
zh: 越南北宁一带的对唱传统，以男女歌组互答和细腻装饰的旋律唱出情谊。
en: A northern Vietnamese singing tradition in which male and female groups exchange ornate melodies expressing affection and friendship.

name: Quyi
zh: 中国说唱表演艺术，以叙述、韵文和歌唱讲故事，常伴弹拨乐器或简洁打击乐。
en: Chinese storytelling arts combining speech, verse and song, often accompanied by plucked strings or spare percussion.

name: R&B / Soul / Funk
zh: 以节奏蓝调、灵魂乐与放克为核心的音乐，突出歌声、切分节奏和低音律动。
en: Music encompassing rhythm and blues, soul and funk, with expressive vocals, syncopated rhythms and prominent bass grooves.

name: Rabiz
zh: 亚美尼亚流行音乐，以带装饰音的唱腔、电子键盘与舞蹈节奏演绎抒情歌曲。
en: Armenian popular music pairing ornamented singing with electronic keyboards and dance rhythms in strongly melodic songs.

name: Rabòday
zh: 海地电子舞曲，以反复合成器节奏、沉重低音和克里奥尔语喊唱延续拉拉游行的热度。
en: Haitian electronic dance music with repeating synth rhythms, heavy bass and Creole chants drawing energy from rara processions.

name: Radio Broadcast Recordings
zh: 记录电台播出内容的声音资料，保留主持话语、节目衔接与当时的广播声响。
en: Recordings preserving radio broadcasts, including announcers' voices, program transitions and the characteristic sound of transmission.

name: Radio Drama
zh: 通过对白、音效与音乐呈现剧情的广播戏剧，用声音交代人物行动和场景。
en: Drama told through dialogue, sound effects and music, using sound to establish characters, action and setting.

name: Raga Rock
zh: 把印度拉格的旋律、持续音和西塔琴音色融入摇滚，形成循环延展的迷幻听感。
en: Rock incorporating raga-inspired melodies, drones and sitar sounds, often creating a cyclical, expansive psychedelic atmosphere.

name: Rage
zh: 以明亮锯齿合成器和轰鸣低音构成躁动的陷阱说唱，旋律像电子游戏般反复冲刺。
en: Trap driven by bright, buzzing synthesizer riffs and booming bass, with repetitive melodies resembling energetic videogame soundtracks.

name: Ragga
zh: 以数码鼓机与合成低音伴随牙买加节奏式念唱，编曲紧凑、反复性强。
en: Digital dancehall pairing Jamaican rhythmic vocal delivery with drum machines and synthesized bass in tight, repetitive arrangements.

name: Ragga Jungle
zh: 把牙买加念唱和雷鬼采样放进高速丛林碎拍，以低频与切碎鼓组制造弹跳。
en: Jungle combining rapid chopped breakbeats and deep bass with Jamaican deejay vocals and reggae samples.

name: Raggacore
zh: 把舞厅念唱与雷鬼采样切进极端碎核鼓组，以猛烈速度和突变剪辑推进。
en: Breakcore cutting dancehall vocals and reggae samples into frantic drums, driven by extreme speed and abrupt edits.

name: Raggatek
zh: 将牙买加舞厅人声与高速硬核舞曲结合，以重踢鼓和反复低音支撑喊唱。
en: Fast hardtek combining heavy kicks and repeating bass patterns with Jamaican dancehall vocals and energetic chanting.

name: Ragtime
zh: 以旋律切分和稳健伴奏形成错拍感，钢琴常用左手低音和弦托起跳动右手。
en: Music contrasting syncopated melodies with steady accompaniment, often featuring piano bass-and-chord patterns beneath a skipping right hand.

name: Ragtime Song
zh: 把拉格泰姆的切分节奏写进流行歌曲，以鲜明旋律、人声和钢琴伴奏呈现。
en: Popular songs adapting ragtime's syncopated rhythms into vocal melodies, often supported by a steady piano accompaniment.

name: Rain Sounds
zh: 记录雨滴、阵雨或持续雨幕的自然声响，细密敲击与宽带沙沙声构成听觉空间。
en: Field recordings of rainfall, from individual droplets to steady downpours, with fine pattering sounds and broad washes of noise.

name: Rajasthani Folk Music
zh: 拉贾斯坦民间音乐，以高亢装饰唱腔、弓弦乐器和鼓点传唱沙漠地区的故事。
en: Rajasthani folk music featuring resonant, ornamented singing, bowed strings and drums in songs carrying the region's stories.

name: Ranchera
zh: 墨西哥乡土歌曲，以直接而饱含感情的唱腔演绎爱恋与离别，常由马里亚奇伴奏。
en: Mexican songs delivered with direct, emotive singing about love and loss, often accompanied by mariachi ensembles.

name: Rap Metal
zh: 把说唱节奏与金属的重型吉他结合，以低音区反复乐句和强硬鼓点支撑人声。
en: Rap vocals set against heavy metal guitars, with low-register riffs and forceful drums reinforcing the vocal rhythms.

name: Rap Rock
zh: 把节奏式说唱与摇滚吉他、贝斯和鼓组结合，人声韵律与反复乐句相互推动。
en: Music combining rhythmic rap vocals with rock guitars, bass and drums, letting vocal patterns and repeating riffs drive each other.

name: Rapai dabõih
zh: 亚齐的宗教仪式鼓乐，以成排框鼓的层叠节奏与集体吟唱伴随达博表演。
en: Acehnese ritual music combining rows of frame drums, layered rhythms and communal devotional chanting for daboh performances.

name: Rapso
zh: 特立尼达的节奏诗歌，把口语吟诵与卡利普索、索卡的鼓点和社会评论结合。
en: Trinidadian rhythmic poetry combining spoken delivery and social commentary with the rhythmic foundations of calypso and soca.

name: Raqs baladi
zh: 埃及都市舞蹈音乐，以有力的巴拉迪节奏和即兴旋律伴舞，常见手风琴与手鼓。
en: Egyptian urban dance music combining a grounded baladi rhythm with improvised melodies, often played on accordion and hand drums.

name: Rara
zh: 海地街头游行音乐，以竹管喇叭、铁器与鼓组反复交错，带动集体应答歌唱。
en: Haitian processional music with interlocking bamboo trumpets, metal percussion and drums accompanying communal call-and-response singing.

name: Rare Phonk
zh: 较明亮流畅的冯克说唱制作，以爵士、灵魂乐循环与人声采样叠上陷阱鼓点。
en: A smoother, more melodic phonk style layering jazz and soul loops and sampled vocals over trap drums.

name: Rasin
zh: 海地根源融合音乐，把伏都教鼓点、克里奥尔语歌声与电吉他、摇滚或放克结合。
en: Haitian roots fusion combining Vodou drumming and Creole vocals with electric guitars, rock or funk rhythms.

name: Rasqueado
zh: 巴西马托格罗索一带的舞曲，以连续扫弦和轻快节奏融汇波尔卡等边境音乐。
en: Dance music from Brazil's Mato Grosso region, with rhythmic guitar strumming and lively patterns drawing on polka and neighboring traditions.

name: Rasteirinha
zh: 较慢的巴西放克舞曲，以错落鼓点、宽松低音和反复人声营造贴地摇摆感。
en: A slower Brazilian funk style with syncopated drums, loose basslines and repeated vocal hooks creating a low-slung dance groove.

name: Ratchet
zh: 美国西岸俱乐部说唱，以稀疏合成器、拍手声和重低音撑起简短反复的钩子。
en: West Coast club rap built from sparse synthesizers, handclaps and heavy bass, with short, frequently repeated hooks.

name: Rautalanka
zh: 芬兰器乐摇滚，以清亮带回声的主奏吉他弹出抒情旋律，结合冲浪与本地流行传统。
en: Finnish instrumental rock with clear, echoing lead guitars playing lyrical melodies shaped by surf music and local popular traditions.

name: Rawphoric
zh: 将粗粝硬式舞曲的重踢鼓与明亮旋律结合，让强硬低频和抒情段落相互衬托。
en: Hardstyle balancing raw, distorted kicks with uplifting melodies, contrasting forceful low frequencies and more lyrical passages.

name: Rawstyle
zh: 以强烈失真踢鼓、尖啸合成器和阴暗音色为核心的硬式舞曲，节拍猛烈直接。
en: Hardstyle centered on heavily distorted kicks, screeching synthesizers and dark textures, with a forceful, uncompromising rhythmic attack.

name: Raï
zh: 阿尔及利亚流行音乐，以装饰丰富的阿拉伯语唱腔配上舞蹈节奏、合成器与电声乐器。
en: Algerian popular music pairing ornamented Arabic vocals with dance rhythms, synthesizers and amplified instruments.

name: Red Disco
zh: 苏联末期兴起的电子迪斯科，以简朴合成器、机械鼓点和抒情歌声改写意式舞曲。
en: Late-Soviet electronic disco adapting Italian dance-pop through basic synthesizers, mechanical drum patterns and sentimental vocals.

name: Reductionism
zh: 把即兴压缩到细微声响与长段静默，以稀疏音色、呼吸或摩擦声集中听觉注意。
en: Improvised music pared down to small sounds and extended silences, focusing attention on sparse textures, breath and friction.

name: Regalia
zh: 以钢琴、弦乐和游戏配乐般旋律搭建华丽空间，再叠上陷阱鼓点与低音。
en: Trap pairing piano, strings and videogame-score-like melodies with programmed drums and deep bass for a grand, spacious sound.

name: Reggae
zh: 牙买加音乐，以反拍吉他或键盘、厚重低音和从容鼓点形成摇摆的律动。
en: Jamaican music built around offbeat guitar or keyboard chords, prominent basslines and relaxed, swaying drum patterns.

name: Reggae / Ska / Dancehall
name_zh: 雷鬼 / 斯卡 / 舞厅雷鬼
zh: 涵盖牙买加斯卡、雷鬼与舞厅的音乐谱系，听感从轻快反拍延伸到低音主导的数码节奏。
en: Jamaican styles ranging from ska's brisk offbeats through bass-led reggae to dancehall's digitally programmed rhythms.

name: Reggae panameño
zh: 巴拿马西班牙语雷鬼与舞厅音乐，以牙买加节奏、数码低音和节奏式念唱为基础。
en: Panamanian Spanish-language reggae and dancehall, built around Jamaican rhythms, digital bass and rhythmic vocal delivery.

name: Reggae Rock
zh: 把雷鬼的反拍和低音律动带入摇滚乐队，以电吉他、鼓组与鲜明副歌推进。
en: Rock bands combining reggae's offbeat chords and bass grooves with electric guitars, full drums and prominent choruses.

name: Reggaetón
zh: 以反复的登波鼓点支撑西班牙语唱说，低音厚重、钩子鲜明的拉丁舞曲。
en: Latin dance music with repeating dembow rhythms, heavy bass and strong hooks supporting Spanish-language singing and rapping.

name: Regional Music
zh: 按地域与文化传统理解的音乐，涵盖各地特有的乐器、唱法、舞蹈和仪式曲目。
en: Music understood through regional and cultural traditions, encompassing local instruments, vocal styles, dances and ceremonial repertoires.

name: Rembetika
zh: 希腊都市民间歌曲，以布祖基琴等弹拨乐器和粗粝歌声讲述爱恋、困顿与日常生活。
en: Greek urban folk songs with bouzouki and other plucked strings accompanying earthy vocals about love, hardship and everyday life.

name: Renaissance Music
zh: 文艺复兴时期的欧洲古典音乐，以交织模仿的声部、流畅旋律与清晰和声关系见长。
en: European Renaissance classical music characterized by interweaving imitative parts, flowing melodies and clearly shaped harmonic relationships.

name: Reparto
zh: 古巴街头舞曲，将伦巴节奏化成电子拍手与重鼓点，配以反复、直接的唱说。
en: Cuban street dance music turning rumba rhythms into electronic handclaps and heavy beats beneath repetitive, direct singing and rapping.

name: Repente
zh: 巴西东北部的即兴唱诗竞赛，歌者以吉他伴奏轮流押韵对答，现场编出诗句。
en: Northeastern Brazilian improvised sung poetry, with guitar-accompanied performers trading rhymed verses composed on the spot.

name: Requiem
zh: 为追思亡者写作的弥撒音乐，以合唱、独唱及器乐表现祈求安息与审判的文本。
en: Mass settings for the dead, using choir, soloists and instruments to express texts of judgment, remembrance and eternal rest.

name: Revolutionary Opera
zh: 以革命故事改编的现代京剧，保留板腔与锣鼓，加入交响配器和更鲜明的英雄唱段。
en: Modern revolutionary Peking opera combining traditional vocal forms and percussion with orchestral scoring and strongly projected heroic roles.

name: Revue
zh: 串联歌曲、舞蹈与讽刺短剧的综艺剧场音乐，段落相对独立，重视舞台节奏与娱乐性。
en: Theatrical music for sequences of songs, dances and satirical sketches, with self-contained numbers and a strong sense of stage timing.

name: Rhumba
zh: 由古巴音乐发展出的交谊舞曲，以从容节拍、柔和旋律和拉丁打击乐配合双人舞步。
en: Ballroom dance music adapted from Cuban traditions, with measured rhythms, smooth melodies and Latin percussion supporting partnered steps.

name: Rhythm & Blues
zh: 从布鲁斯发展出的黑人流行音乐，以鲜明反拍、重复低音乐句和有力歌声带动节奏。
en: Black popular music rooted in blues, with strong backbeats, repeating bass patterns and forceful singing driving the rhythm.

name: Ricercar
zh: 以主题在不同声部间模仿展开的古典器乐曲，线条相互追随，形成细密对位。
en: Classical instrumental pieces developing themes through imitation between voices, with closely woven melodic lines and contrapuntal detail.

name: Riddim
zh: 极简反复的回响贝斯，以半速鼓点、摆动低音音色和紧缩乐句形成机械般律动。
en: Minimal, repetitive dubstep with half-time drums, wobbling bass textures and tightly looped phrases creating a mechanical groove.

name: Rigsar
zh: 不丹现代流行歌曲，将本地旋律和弹拨乐器融入电子节奏、键盘与通俗歌曲编配。
en: Bhutanese popular songs combining local melodies and plucked instruments with electronic rhythms, keyboards and contemporary pop arrangements.

name: Ring Shout
zh: 非裔美国人的宗教歌舞，以应答歌唱、拍手、踏步和棍击节奏围圈行进。
en: African American devotional music combining call-and-response singing, handclaps, shuffling steps and stick percussion in a moving circle.

name: Rioplatense Music
zh: 拉普拉塔河流域的音乐传统，涵盖班多钮手风琴探戈、米隆加歌谣与坎东贝鼓乐。
en: Music of the Río de la Plata region, encompassing bandoneon-led tango, milonga songs and candombe drumming.

name: Ripsaw
zh: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛舞曲，以刮擦手锯的沙哑节奏配上手风琴、鼓与弦乐。
en: Dance music from the Turks and Caicos Islands, with scraped handsaw rhythms alongside accordion, drums and string instruments.

name: Ritmada
zh: 圣保罗放克分支，以短促反复的打击循环、非裔巴西乐器采样与清晰唱词带动舞步。
en: São Paulo funk emphasizing short percussion loops, Afro-Brazilian instrumental samples and clearly foregrounded vocal lines.

name: Ritual Ambient
zh: 以持续低音、仪式般敲击和吟唱营造幽暗空间，重复层次缓慢累积的氛围音乐。
en: Dark ambient music building slowly through low drones, ritualistic percussion and chanting, with repetitive layers creating an enclosed atmosphere.

name: Rizitika
zh: 克里特岛西部的叙事民歌，多以无伴奏男声领唱与齐唱展开，旋律庄重舒缓。
en: Western Cretan narrative songs, usually featuring unaccompanied male soloists and group responses in measured, solemn melodies.

name: RKT
zh: 阿根廷街头舞曲，把坎比亚采样与雷鬼顿节奏剪接成低音厚重、喊唱鲜明的循环。
en: Argentine dance music combining cumbia samples and reggaeton rhythms in bass-heavy loops with strongly projected vocal hooks.

name: Road Rap
zh: 英国街头说唱，以阴沉旋律、重低音和冷静叙述描写街区生活与帮派处境。
en: British street rap pairing dark melodies and heavy bass with restrained narratives of neighborhood life and gang environments.

name: Rock
zh: 以电吉他、贝斯和鼓组为核心的音乐，反拍节奏、反复乐句与人声推动歌曲。
en: Music centered on electric guitars, bass and drums, with backbeats, repeating riffs and vocals driving the songs.

name: Rock & Roll
zh: 以强烈反拍、跳动低音和吉他或钢琴乐句带动舞步，融合节奏蓝调与乡村传统。
en: Dance-oriented rock with strong backbeats, bouncing bass and guitar or piano riffs, drawing on rhythm and blues and country.

name: Rock andaluz
zh: 安达卢西亚摇滚，把弗拉门戈唱腔与调式融入电吉他、键盘和较长的器乐段落。
en: Andalusian rock combining flamenco singing and modal melodies with electric guitars, keyboards and extended instrumental passages.

name: Rock andino
zh: 将安第斯排箫、盖纳笛或恰朗戈与摇滚乐队结合，让地方旋律与电声节拍相互交织。
en: Rock combining Andean panpipes, quena or charango with amplified instruments, intertwining regional melodies and band-driven rhythms.

name: Rock Jiwang
zh: 马来语抒情摇滚，以哀婉主唱、延展的电吉他独奏和渐强副歌演绎感情故事。
en: Malay-language sentimental rock with yearning vocals, extended guitar solos and swelling choruses telling stories of love and heartbreak.

name: Rock Kapak
zh: 马来硬摇滚，以失真吉他、炫技独奏与高亢唱腔结合抒情旋律和强劲鼓点。
en: Malay hard rock combining distorted guitars, showy solos and high-reaching vocals with lyrical melodies and forceful drums.

name: Rock Musical
zh: 以摇滚编制与歌曲推动舞台剧情的音乐剧，电吉他、鼓组和角色演唱相互配合。
en: Musical theatre using rock bands and songs to advance the plot, combining electric guitars, drums and singing in character.

name: Rock Opera
zh: 用相互关联的摇滚歌曲讲述完整故事，反复主题与角色化演唱贯穿整部作品。
en: A connected sequence of rock songs telling a continuous story through recurring themes and vocals performed as characters.

name: Rock rural
zh: 巴西乡村气息的民谣摇滚，把原声吉他、和声与本地乡土歌曲旋律结合。
en: Brazilian folk rock combining acoustic guitars and vocal harmonies with rural song traditions and locally rooted melodies.

name: Rockaballad
zh: 早期摇滚中的抒情慢歌，以柔和唱腔、稳健节拍及合唱或弦乐编配突出旋律。
en: Early rock-and-roll ballads with gentle vocals, steady rhythms and lush arrangements that often include backing choirs or strings.

name: Rockabilly
zh: 把乡村唱腔与节奏蓝调结合，以清脆电吉他、拍弦贝斯和短促回声形成跳跃节奏。
en: Rock and roll combining country vocals and rhythm-and-blues drive with twangy guitars, slapped bass and short, echoing production.

name: Rocksteady
zh: 比斯卡更从容的牙买加舞曲，以突出低音、反拍吉他和柔和人声和声形成摇摆。
en: Relaxed Jamaican dance music with prominent basslines, offbeat guitar chords and smooth vocal harmonies, moving more slowly than ska.

name: Rom kbach
zh: 柬埔寨社交舞歌曲，以舒缓而带装饰的旋律、温柔唱腔与稳定节拍伴随细致手势。
en: Cambodian social-dance songs with gentle, ornamented melodies, tender vocals and measured beats accompanying graceful hand movements.

name: Roman School
zh: 以罗马教会为中心的古典传统，强调平衡的人声复调、流畅对位和清晰的宗教文本。
en: A Roman sacred classical tradition emphasizing balanced vocal polyphony, smoothly interwoven lines and clearly articulated liturgical texts.

name: Romance
zh: 伊比利亚及西语世界的口传叙事歌，以反复旋律唱出押韵诗节，讲述历史与人物故事。
en: Oral narrative ballads from Iberian and Hispanic traditions, using repeated melodies and rhymed verses to tell historical and personal stories.

name: Romani Folk Music
zh: 欧洲罗姆人的民间音乐传统，常以装饰繁密的人声、小提琴和节奏鲜明的伴奏见长。
en: European Romani folk traditions, often featuring highly ornamented singing, expressive fiddles and rhythmically vivid accompaniment.

name: Romanian Etno Music
zh: 把罗马尼亚民歌旋律与电子舞曲节奏结合，以传统唱法和明快键盘编排突出本地色彩。
en: Romanian pop-folk combining traditional melodies and singing styles with electronic dance rhythms and bright keyboard arrangements.

name: Romanian Folk Music
zh: 罗马尼亚民间歌舞，以小提琴、扬琴、排箫与装饰唱腔演绎抒情歌和快速舞曲。
en: Romanian folk songs and dances featuring fiddles, cimbalom, panpipes and ornamented vocals, from lyrical airs to brisk dance tunes.

name: Romanian Music
zh: 罗马尼亚的音乐传统与现代创作，涵盖多伊纳歌谣、民间舞曲及电子流行音乐。
en: Music from Romania, encompassing doina songs, regional folk dances and modern electronic popular styles.

name: Romanian Popcorn
zh: 罗马尼亚浩室流行舞曲，以明亮短旋律、合成铜管或手风琴音色和四拍鼓点见长。
en: Romanian dance-pop with house beats, bright melodic hooks and synthesized brass or accordion sounds over steady four-on-the-floor rhythms.

name: Romantic Flow
zh: 侧重爱情主题的雷鬼顿，以柔和旋律唱腔、抒情编配和登波节奏表达亲密情绪。
en: Romantic reggaeton emphasizing melodic singing, gentle arrangements and love lyrics over a steady dembow rhythm.

name: Romanticism
zh: 以宽阔旋律、浓厚和声和强弱起伏表达个人情感，常见宏大交响与抒情小品。
en: Classical music emphasizing expansive melodies, rich harmony and dynamic contrasts, from large symphonic works to intimate lyrical pieces.

name: Romantische Oper
zh: 德语浪漫歌剧，以民间传说、超自然情节和鲜明管弦色彩结合抒情歌唱。
en: German Romantic opera combining lyrical singing and vivid orchestral color with folklore, supernatural events and heightened dramatic emotion.

name: Romanţe
zh: 罗马尼亚抒情歌曲，以悠长旋律和细腻歌声吟唱爱情与怀念，常有沙龙式伴奏。
en: Romanian lyrical songs with flowing melodies and expressive voices singing of love and remembrance over salon-style accompaniment.

name: Rominimal
zh: 罗马尼亚极简科技浩室，以细小打击声、弹性低音与漫长循环制造微妙变化。
en: Romanian minimal tech house built from fine percussion details, elastic basslines and extended loops with subtle shifts.

name: Roots Reggae
zh: 重视精神信仰与社会现实的雷鬼，以深沉低音、稳健鼓点和集体和声承载歌词。
en: Reggae centered on spirituality and social realities, with deep bass, steady drums and group harmonies carrying the lyrics.

name: Roots Rock
zh: 回到布鲁斯、乡村与早期摇滚根基，以吉他乐句、朴实唱腔和直接节拍组织歌曲。
en: Rock drawing on blues, country and early rock and roll, with guitar riffs, plainspoken vocals and straightforward rhythms.

name: Rumba catalana
zh: 加泰罗尼亚罗姆舞曲，以吉他扫弦兼拍击琴身、拍手和反复副歌形成轻快律动。
en: Catalan Romani dance music combining strummed guitar, percussive strikes on the guitar body, handclaps and repeated vocal refrains.

name: Rumba cubana
zh: 古巴非裔歌舞，以康加鼓、木棒节奏和领唱应答交织，鼓声与舞者动作紧密呼应。
en: Afro-Cuban music combining congas, clave patterns and call-and-response singing, with close interaction between drummers and dancers.

name: Rumba flamenca
zh: 弗拉门戈中的轻快伦巴，以连续吉他扫弦、拍手和短促副歌形成鲜明四拍律动。
en: An upbeat flamenco style with continuous guitar strumming, handclaps and short refrains riding a clear four-beat groove.

name: Rune Singing
zh: 波罗的海芬兰诸族的古老唱诗，以短旋律反复承接诗句，常由领唱与应答展开。
en: Traditional Balto-Finnic sung poetry, repeating short melodies across successive verses and often alternating a leader with responding singers.

name: Russian Chanson
zh: 俄罗斯都市叙事歌曲，以粗粝或亲切的唱腔讲述江湖、困顿与爱情，伴奏常有吉他。
en: Russian urban narrative songs about hardship, underworld life and love, delivered in earthy voices, often with guitar accompaniment.

name: Russian Folk Music
zh: 俄罗斯民间歌舞，以悠长独唱、集体多声部和声与巴拉莱卡等乐器呈现乡土传统。
en: Russian folk songs and dances featuring sustained solo singing, multipart group vocals and instruments such as the balalaika.

name: Russian Music
zh: 俄罗斯的音乐传统与创作，涵盖东正教合唱、乡村歌谣、古典作品与现代流行歌曲。
en: Music from Russia, encompassing Orthodox choral traditions, rural songs, classical composition and contemporary popular music.

name: Russian Romance
zh: 俄罗斯抒情独唱歌曲，以诗意歌词、自由伸缩的旋律和钢琴或吉他伴奏表达情感。
en: Russian lyrical solo songs with poetic texts, flexibly paced melodies and expressive piano or guitar accompaniment.

name: Rustic Stomp
zh: 日本发展出的根源朋克，以班卓琴、曼陀林或手风琴结合乡村、斯卡和摇滚比利节奏。
en: Japanese roots punk combining banjo, mandolin or accordion with country, ska and rockabilly rhythms in spirited acoustic arrangements.

name: Ryukyuan Music
zh: 琉球群岛的音乐传统，以三线琴、岛屿音阶和装饰唱腔传唱民歌与古典曲目。
en: Music of the Ryukyu Islands, featuring sanshin lute, regional scales and ornamented singing in folk and classical repertoires.

name: Ryūkōka
zh: 日本早期大众流行歌曲，将日式旋律与西方管弦或舞曲编配结合，唱腔鲜明抒情。
en: Early Japanese popular songs combining local melodic styles with Western orchestral or dance-band arrangements and strongly expressive singing.

name: Rōkyoku
zh: 日本浪曲说唱，以沙哑而富装饰的唱腔交替叙述对白，由三味线配合剧情起伏。
en: Japanese narrative performance alternating spoken dialogue and ornamented, husky singing, with shamisen accompaniment following the drama.

name: Sa'idi
zh: 上埃及民间舞曲，以有力鼓点、尖亮米兹马尔管乐和拉巴卜琴伴随乡土舞蹈。
en: Upper Egyptian folk dance music with forceful drums, piercing mizmar reeds and rababa fiddle accompanying regional dances.

name: Sacred Singing Circle
zh: 围圈共同演唱的灵性歌曲，以易学的重复短句、应答和自然叠加的和声连接参与者。
en: Communal spiritual singing in a circle, using easily learned refrains, call and response and spontaneously layered vocal harmonies.

name: Sacred Steel
zh: 黑人福音音乐中的钢棒吉他传统，以滑音、颤音和近似人声的独奏回应教会歌唱。
en: A Black gospel steel-guitar tradition using slides, vibrato and voice-like lead lines to answer congregational singing.

name: Saeta
zh: 安达卢西亚圣周游行中的无伴奏圣歌，以高亢、装饰繁密的独唱向圣像致敬。
en: Unaccompanied devotional singing during Andalusian Holy Week processions, with intense, ornamented solo voices addressing sacred images.

name: Sahrawi Music
zh: 撒哈拉维人的音乐，以哈桑尼亚语歌声、提迪尼特琴或电吉他和塔巴尔鼓连接诗歌与舞动。
en: Sahrawi music combining Hassaniya-language vocals, tidinit lute or electric guitar and tbal drums in poetic songs and dance rhythms.

name: Saint Petersburg School
zh: 圣彼得堡的俄罗斯浪漫乐派，将民间旋律、民族题材与色彩鲜明的管弦配器结合。
en: Russian Romantic music associated with Saint Petersburg, combining folk-derived melodies and national subjects with vividly colored orchestration.

name: Sakha Traditional Music
zh: 萨哈人的音乐传统，包含自由即兴吟唱、史诗歌唱与口弦琴变化细密的泛音。
en: Sakha musical traditions encompassing freely improvised singing, sung epics and the finely changing overtones of the khomus jaw harp.

name: Salegy
zh: 马达加斯加北部舞曲，以快速六拍律动、交错电吉他和应答歌声持续推进。
en: Northern Malagasy dance music driven by rapid six-beat rhythms, interlocking electric guitars and energetic call-and-response singing.

name: Salsa
zh: 以古巴松乐等传统为基础的拉丁舞曲，铜管、钢琴循环与层叠打击乐围绕克拉韦节奏交织。
en: Latin dance music rooted in Cuban son, intertwining brass, repeated piano figures and layered percussion around clave patterns.

name: Salsa choke
zh: 哥伦比亚舞曲，把萨尔萨采样与电子鼓点、说唱和反复呼喊组合成紧凑舞步节奏。
en: Colombian dance music combining salsa samples, electronic beats, rap and repeated chants into tightly focused dance grooves.

name: Salsa dura
zh: 强调打击乐冲击与铜管力度的萨尔萨，以钢琴循环、即兴独奏和领唱应答推动长段落。
en: Hard-driving salsa with forceful percussion and brass, repeated piano figures, improvised solos and extended call-and-response sections.

name: Salsa romántica
zh: 以爱情歌词、柔和主唱和流畅编配为中心的萨尔萨，保留舞蹈节奏而突出抒情旋律。
en: Salsa centered on romantic lyrics, smooth lead vocals and polished arrangements, keeping the dance rhythm beneath lyrical melodies.

name: Saluang klasik
zh: 西苏门答腊米南加保传统歌乐，以萨鲁昂竹笛的连绵气流伴随装饰丰富的诗歌吟唱。
en: Traditional Minangkabau music from West Sumatra, pairing the continuous breathy tone of the saluang bamboo flute with ornamented poetic singing.

name: Samba
zh: 巴西舞曲与歌唱传统，以层叠打击乐、切分节奏和卡瓦基纽琴扫弦形成轻巧摇摆。
en: Brazilian song and dance music with layered percussion, syncopated rhythms and strummed cavaquinho creating a buoyant swing.

name: Samba de breque
zh: 在桑巴律动中突然停顿，留出说白、笑话或戏剧化对白，再由乐队接回节奏。
en: Samba that interrupts its groove with spoken asides, jokes or theatrical dialogue before the ensemble resumes playing.

name: Samba de gafieira
zh: 为巴西舞厅双人舞演奏的桑巴，以铜管、簧管和切分节奏形成大乐队般的摇摆。
en: Ballroom samba with brass, reeds and syncopated rhythms, giving partnered dancing the swing and punch of a large ensemble.

name: Samba de roda
zh: 巴伊亚的围圈桑巴，以拍手、打击乐与领唱应答伴舞，舞者轮流进入圈心。
en: Bahian circle samba with handclaps, percussion and call-and-response singing, as dancers take turns entering the center.

name: Samba de terreiro
zh: 里约社区聚会中的桑巴歌曲，以打击乐、弦乐和集体副歌唱出日常生活与情感。
en: Samba songs from Rio's community gatherings, with percussion, strings and shared refrains expressing everyday life and emotions.

name: Samba Rap
zh: 将桑巴的切分节奏与说唱结合，以打击乐或桑巴采样托住口语韵律。
en: Rap combining spoken rhythmic delivery with samba's syncopation, supported by live percussion or sampled samba passages.

name: Samba Soul
zh: 把桑巴律动与灵魂乐、放克结合，以弹性贝斯、切分吉他和热烈歌声形成舞曲。
en: Samba grooves blended with soul and funk, featuring elastic basslines, syncopated guitars and expressive, energetic singing.

name: Samba-canção
zh: 较慢而抒情的桑巴，以细腻长旋律与浓厚伴奏演绎爱情、离别和思念。
en: Slow, lyrical samba with extended vocal melodies and lush accompaniment, centered on love, separation and longing.

name: Samba-choro
zh: 把桑巴的切分与肖罗的器乐技巧结合，以灵巧旋律、快速装饰和弦乐对话见长。
en: Samba combining syncopated grooves with choro's instrumental agility, featuring nimble melodies, quick ornaments and lively exchanges between strings.

name: Samba-enredo
zh: 为桑巴学校狂欢节主题创作的歌曲，以庞大鼓队、领唱和集体副歌讲述游行故事。
en: Songs written for samba-school carnival themes, with massed percussion, lead singers and communal choruses narrating the parade's story.

name: Samba-exaltação
zh: 赞颂巴西风土与民族形象的桑巴，以宽阔旋律、宏大管弦配器和昂扬歌声见长。
en: Samba celebrating Brazil through sweeping melodies, grand orchestral arrangements and strongly uplifting vocal performances.

name: Samba-jazz
zh: 把桑巴节奏与爵士即兴、复杂和声结合，钢琴、贝斯与鼓组之间交流紧密。
en: Music combining samba rhythms with jazz improvisation and extended harmonies, emphasizing close interplay between piano, bass and drums.

name: Samba-joia
zh: 偏流行的桑巴歌曲，以爱情主题、鲜明副歌与柔和管弦编配结合波莱罗式抒情。
en: Popular samba combining romantic themes, memorable choruses and smooth orchestral arrangements with the sentimentality of bolero.

name: Samba-reggae
zh: 巴伊亚街头鼓乐，把桑巴与雷鬼律动结合，以层叠大鼓和切分鼓句形成厚重摆动。
en: Bahian street percussion combining samba and reggae grooves, with layered bass drums and syncopated patterns creating a heavy swing.

name: Samba-rock
zh: 将桑巴切分与摇滚、灵魂乐律动结合，以节奏吉他、贝斯和打击乐带动双人舞步。
en: Samba combining its syncopation with rock and soul grooves, driven by rhythmic guitars, bass and percussion for partnered dancing.

name: Sambalanço
zh: 用鲜明切分和管乐编配增强舞感的桑巴，旋律轻巧，带有爵士色彩。
en: Dance-oriented samba with pronounced syncopation, bright horn arrangements, and a light touch of jazz.

name: Sambass
zh: 把桑巴与波萨诺瓦的旋律、打击乐融入快速碎拍的巴西鼓打贝斯。
en: Brazilian drum and bass pairing fast breakbeats with samba percussion and the melodic warmth of bossa nova.

name: Samoan Music
zh: 萨摩亚的歌舞与合唱传统，常以群体和声、拍手和身体打击配合舞步。
en: Samoan song and dance traditions featuring communal harmonies, handclaps, and body percussion that accompany movement.

name: Samoyedic Folk Music
zh: 涅涅茨等萨莫耶德语族的歌唱传统，以个人歌曲、叙事歌和仪式吟唱为主。
en: Singing traditions of Samoyedic peoples, including the Nenets, centered on personal songs, sung narratives, and ritual chants.

name: Sample Drill
zh: 把熟悉歌曲的人声或旋律采样切入滑动低音与错落鼓点的纽约Drill说唱。
en: New York drill weaving recognizable vocal or melodic samples through sliding bass and off-kilter drum patterns.

name: Samri
zh: 阿拉伯半岛的群体歌舞，以诗歌对唱、框鼓和整齐拍手伴随身体摇摆。
en: An Arabian communal song and dance tradition combining sung poetry, frame drums, and rhythmic clapping.

name: Sana'ani Song
zh: 也门萨那的诗歌演唱，装饰性旋律常由短颈鲁特琴与金属盘打击伴奏。
en: Poetic songs from Sana'a, Yemen, with ornamented melodies traditionally accompanied by a short-necked lute and a struck metal tray.

name: Sanjo
zh: 韩国器乐独奏，以长鼓伴奏从慢板逐渐加速，突出即兴般的装饰旋律。
en: Korean instrumental solos that gradually accelerate over janggu accompaniment, unfolding through richly ornamented, improvisatory melodic passages.

name: Santería Music
zh: 古巴桑特里亚仪式音乐，以巴塔鼓交织的节奏和领唱应答呼唤神灵。
en: Afro-Cuban Santería ceremonial music invoking deities through interlocking batá drum rhythms and call-and-response singing.

name: Santé engagé
zh: 毛里求斯的社会抗议歌曲，以克里奥尔语歌唱或说唱表达现实诉求。
en: Mauritian protest songs expressing social concerns through sung or rapped Creole lyrics across a range of musical settings.

name: Sarala gee
zh: 斯里兰卡僧伽罗语轻歌曲，以抒情旋律结合本土民歌与印度古典声腔。
en: Sri Lankan Sinhala light songs blending lyrical melodies with local folk traditions and Indian classical vocal influences.

name: Sardana
zh: 加泰罗尼亚圆圈舞音乐，由双簧管类吹管、铜管和低音提琴奏出清晰舞拍。
en: Catalan circle-dance music with clearly marked rhythms played by a cobla ensemble of reeds, brass, and double bass.

name: Sardinian Folk Music
zh: 撒丁岛的民间音乐，包括喉音浓重的多声部合唱与三管簧笛演奏。
en: Sardinian folk traditions encompassing resonant, throaty multipart singing and the distinctive three-pipe sound of the launeddas.

name: Sarum Chant
zh: 英格兰索尔兹伯里礼仪中的拉丁圣咏，以无伴奏单声旋律承载祷文。
en: Latin plainchant associated with the medieval Salisbury liturgy, carrying sacred texts in unaccompanied, single-line melodies.

name: Sass
zh: 带有戏谑表演感的硬核朋克，常把尖厉唱腔、不协和吉他与舞曲律动结合。
en: Theatrical hardcore punk combining shrill vocals and dissonant guitars with a playful streak and frequently danceable rhythms.

name: Sawt
zh: 海湾城市的阿拉伯艺术歌曲，以乌德琴、手鼓和拍掌伴随细腻装饰的独唱。
en: An urban Gulf Arab song tradition pairing ornamented solo vocals with oud, hand drums, and rhythmic clapping.

name: Saya
zh: 玻利维亚非裔群体的歌舞，以层叠鼓点、刮奏声和领唱应答推动行进。
en: Afro-Bolivian song and dance driven by layered drums, scraping percussion, and exchanges between a lead singer and chorus.

name: Scam Rap
zh: 围绕诈骗经历与网络骗局展开的说唱，常以谈话般的语气铺陈具体细节。
en: Rap centered on scams and online fraud, often delivered in a conversational style full of detailed anecdotes.

name: Schlager
zh: 欧洲流行歌曲，以容易跟唱的副歌、规整节拍和直白的浪漫歌词见长。
en: European popular songs built around singalong choruses, straightforward rhythms, and direct lyrics about love and everyday emotions.

name: Schottische
zh: 欧洲双人舞曲，以稳稳的二拍子伴随侧步、跳步与旋转。
en: European partner-dance music with a steady duple pulse supporting combinations of sideways steps, hops, and turns.

name: Schranz
zh: 以反复碾压的失真底鼓和粗砺打击乐循环推进的硬派科技舞曲。
en: Hard techno driven by relentlessly looped, distorted kick drums and abrasive layers of repetitive percussion.

name: Scots Song
zh: 以苏格兰语演唱的叙事歌与抒情歌，常让清楚的咬字和故事本身居于中心。
en: Scots-language ballads and songs that foreground storytelling, clear diction, and the expressive shape of the sung melody.

name: Scottish Country Dance Music
zh: 服务于苏格兰集体舞的器乐，提琴或手风琴以清晰乐句带动固定舞步。
en: Instrumental music for Scottish country dancing, with fiddle or accordion tunes phrased clearly to guide coordinated steps.

name: Scottish Folk Music
zh: 苏格兰的歌谣与舞曲传统，常听见提琴、风笛以及里尔和斯特拉斯佩节奏。
en: Scottish song and dance traditions featuring fiddles, bagpipes, and the contrasting rhythms of reels and strathspeys.

name: Scouse House
zh: 英国硬浩室的弹跳分支，以敲击般的低音音色和连续四拍底鼓制造冲劲。
en: A bouncy British hard-house style driven by distinctive hollow donk bass sounds and an insistent four-on-the-floor kick.

name: Screamo
zh: 以嘶喊人声、急促节奏和骤然爆发的吉他表达情绪，常与安静段落交替。
en: Emotionally intense punk with screamed vocals, frantic rhythms, and explosive guitars that often alternate with quieter passages.

name: Scrumpy and Western
zh: 英国西南部的诙谐乡土歌曲，以地方口音和民谣编配讲酒馆与乡村生活。
en: Humorous songs from England's West Country, using local accents and folk arrangements to tell stories of rural and pub life.

name: Sea Shanty
zh: 航海劳动中的集体号子，以领唱应答和明确重拍协调拉绳等动作。
en: Maritime work songs whose call-and-response patterns and strong accents coordinate collective tasks such as hauling ropes.

name: Sean-nós
zh: 爱尔兰传统无伴奏独唱，以自由节奏、细密装饰音和个人化咬字展开旋律。
en: Traditional Irish unaccompanied singing with flexible rhythm, intricate melodic ornamentation, and highly individual phrasing of the text.

name: Seggae
zh: 毛里求斯舞曲，将塞加的摇摆节奏与雷鬼反拍吉他和低音结合。
en: Mauritian music combining the swaying rhythms of séga with reggae's offbeat guitar accents and prominent bass.

name: Seinn nan salm
zh: 苏格兰盖尔语诗篇吟唱，由领唱逐句引出，会众以自由伸展的旋律应和。
en: Scottish Gaelic psalm singing in which a precentor leads each line and the congregation answers with freely overlapping melodies.

name: Seishun Punk
zh: 日本青春朋克，以直白歌词、明快吉他和用力合唱的副歌表达年轻人的情绪。
en: Japanese pop punk expressing youthful feelings through direct lyrics, bright guitars, and emphatically sung, communal choruses.

name: Semba
zh: 安哥拉舞曲，以切分吉他和活跃打击乐衬托歌唱，节奏轻巧而跳跃。
en: Angolan dance music pairing syncopated guitar figures and lively percussion with vocals over a buoyant, skipping groove.

name: Semi-Trot
zh: 将韩国Trot的转音唱法与流行编曲、电子舞曲节拍结合的轻快歌曲。
en: Korean pop that blends trot's ornamented vocal inflections with contemporary arrangements and upbeat electronic dance rhythms.

name: Sephardic Music
zh: 塞法迪犹太人的歌曲传统，常以拉迪诺语唱叙事歌、婚礼歌和抒情歌。
en: Sephardic Jewish song traditions, often sung in Ladino, encompassing narrative ballads, wedding songs, and lyrical love songs.

name: Sequencer & Tracker
zh: 以音序器或追踪器排列音符和短采样的电脑音乐，常用循环与分步编程塑形。
en: Computer music composed by sequencing notes and short samples into patterns, with loops and stepwise programming shaping the sound.

name: Serbian Folk Music
zh: 塞尔维亚民间歌舞，包含科洛舞曲、装饰性独唱以及手风琴和管乐合奏。
en: Serbian folk traditions encompassing kolo dance tunes, ornamented solo singing, and lively accordion or wind ensembles.

name: Serenade
zh: 源于晚间致意的歌曲或器乐体裁，通常以歌唱性旋律和轻盈编配营造亲切感。
en: Songs or instrumental works associated with evening serenading, typically favoring lyrical melodies and light, intimate textures.

name: Seresta
zh: 巴西夜间小夜曲传统，以柔和独唱和拨弦伴奏诉说爱情与思念。
en: A Brazilian serenading tradition of intimate romantic songs, usually pairing an expressive solo voice with plucked-string accompaniment.

name: Serialism
zh: 用预先排列的音高或其他参数序列组织作品，让音与音的关系遵循序列变化。
en: Music organized through ordered series of pitches or other parameters, developing their relationships through systematic transformations.

name: Sermons
zh: 以口语讲解信仰与经文的宗教布道录音，声音重点在说话节奏和修辞。
en: Recorded religious preaching that interprets scripture and belief through spoken delivery, rhetorical emphasis, and the cadence of speech.

name: Sertanejo
zh: 巴西乡村歌曲传统，常以双人和声与拨弦乐器唱爱情和乡土生活。
en: Brazilian country music often featuring close vocal duets and plucked strings in songs about love and rural life.

name: Sertanejo de raiz
zh: 巴西传统乡村音乐，以十弦维奥拉和高声部二重唱讲述田园生活与故事。
en: Traditional Brazilian country music with ten-string viola caipira and close, high-register vocal duets about rural life and stories.

name: Sertanejo romântico
