zh: 把巴西乡村二重唱带入流行情歌，以抒情旋律和饱满编曲突出爱情主题。
en: Romantic Brazilian sertanejo pairing country-style vocal duets with lyrical pop melodies and fuller arrangements centered on love.

name: Sertanejo universitário
zh: 面向聚会与舞台合唱的巴西流行乡村，常用明快节拍、吉他和抓耳副歌。
en: Brazilian pop-country built for parties and communal singing, with upbeat rhythms, prominent guitars, and catchy choruses.

name: Seto leelo
zh: 塞托人的多声部歌唱，由领唱引出诗句，合唱以持续低声部和高声部交织。
en: Seto multipart singing in which a soloist introduces verses and a chorus answers with interwoven lower and higher voices.

name: Sevdalinka
zh: 波斯尼亚抒情歌曲，以悠长装饰旋律和富于转折的唱腔诉说爱情与惆怅。
en: Bosnian lyrical songs expressing love and longing through extended, ornamented melodies and expressive turns of the voice.

name: Sevillanas
zh: 安达卢西亚成套民间舞曲，以三拍子歌唱、吉他和拍掌伴随成对舞步。
en: Andalusian folk dance songs arranged in sets, with triple-meter singing, guitar, and handclaps accompanying paired dancers.

name: Sexy Drill
zh: 纽约Drill说唱的轻快分支，把滑动低音与柔和采样、调情歌词和旋律唱腔结合。
en: A playful New York drill offshoot combining sliding bass with softer samples, flirtatious lyrics, and melodic vocal delivery.

name: Seychelles & Mascarene Islands Music
zh: 塞舌尔与马斯克林群岛的音乐，涵盖塞加舞曲及鼓、摇响器伴奏的克里奥尔歌唱。
en: Music of the Seychelles and Mascarene Islands, including séga dance traditions and Creole singing accompanied by drums and shakers.

name: Shaabi
zh: 埃及城市民间流行音乐，以粗粝直白的唱腔和热闹节奏唱街巷生活。
en: Egyptian urban popular music with earthy, direct vocals and lively rhythms carrying songs about everyday street life.

name: Shabad kirtan
zh: 锡克教经文的旋律吟唱，常依拉格展开，由簧风琴、弦乐和塔布拉鼓伴奏。
en: Sikh scripture sung in melodic settings, often based on ragas and accompanied by harmonium, strings, and tabla.

name: Shaker Music
zh: 美国震教徒的宗教歌曲，以朴素易唱的旋律和集体歌唱配合礼拜与舞步。
en: Religious songs of the American Shakers, with plain, singable melodies and communal voices accompanying worship and movement.

name: Shan'ge
zh: 在山野与劳动生活中传唱的中国民歌，常以高亢、舒展的独唱或对唱展开。
en: Chinese folk songs associated with rural outdoor life, often sung in high, freely unfolding solo lines or exchanges.

name: Shangaan Electro
zh: 南非聪加舞曲的电子变体，以极快鼓点、合成马林巴琴和人声推动密集舞步。
en: South African electronic Tsonga dance music with very fast percussion, synthetic marimba sounds, and vocals driving intricate footwork.

name: Shaoxing Opera
zh: 以吴语演唱的越剧，弦乐托起柔婉细腻的唱腔，擅长抒情与人物对唱。
en: Yue opera sung in Wu Chinese, with lyrical, finely inflected voices and expressive duets supported by string accompaniment.

name: Shape Note Singing
zh: 以形状音符辅助学习的美国圣诗合唱，各声部强劲交织，通常没有乐器伴奏。
en: American hymn singing taught through shaped noteheads, with strongly projected, interweaving vocal parts usually performed without instruments.

name: Shashmaqam
zh: 乌兹别克与塔吉克的古典套曲，以六组调式组织诗歌演唱和器乐段落。
en: An Uzbek and Tajik classical tradition organizing sung poetry and instrumental movements into suites based on six maqoms.

name: Shatta
zh: 马提尼克的舞厅雷鬼分支，用沉重低音和简练有力的循环鼓点带动舞蹈。
en: A Martinican dancehall offshoot built around heavy bass and stripped-back, forceful percussion loops designed for dancing.

name: Shehhi Music
zh: 阿曼与阿联酋希胡人的音乐传统，包含群体呼喊、应答歌唱和劳动吟唱。
en: Musical traditions of the Shihuh in Oman and the UAE, including collective calls, responsive singing, and work chants.

name: Shetland & Orkney Folk Music
zh: 设得兰与奥克尼群岛的民间音乐，以提琴舞曲体现苏格兰与北欧传统的交汇。
en: Folk music of Shetland and Orkney, with fiddle-led dance tunes reflecting connections between Scottish and Nordic traditions.

name: Shidaiqu
zh: 早期华语流行歌曲，将中国式旋律和婉转唱腔配上爵士或舞厅乐队编曲。
en: Early Chinese popular songs blending Chinese melodic phrasing and expressive vocals with jazz-influenced or ballroom-style orchestral arrangements.

name: Shilla
zh: 源于贝都因诗歌的海湾吟唱，以节奏鲜明的人声和重复短句突出歌词。
en: Gulf vocal music rooted in Bedouin poetry, emphasizing rhythmic delivery and recurring phrases that bring the words forward.

name: Shilluk Music
zh: 南苏丹希卢克人的歌唱传统，包含以里拉琴伴奏的歌曲和鼓、拍手配合的歌舞。
en: Shilluk musical traditions from South Sudan, including lyre-accompanied songs and communal singing supported by drums and clapping.

name: Shimokita-kei
zh: 与东京下北泽场景相连的另类摇滚，以旋律吉他、鲜明人声和流行式歌曲结构见长。
en: Japanese alternative rock associated with Shimokitazawa, featuring melodic guitar leads, expressive vocals, and pop-influenced songwriting.

name: Shitgaze
zh: 把松散独立摇滚埋进粗糙失真和录音噪声的风格，吉他模糊而刺耳。
en: Lo-fi indie rock submerged in abrasive distortion and recording noise, with loose performances and fuzzy, ragged guitars.

name: Shoegaze
zh: 以层层失真吉他和朦胧人声筑成音墙的另类摇滚，梦幻而饱满。
en: Alternative rock building a dense, dreamy wall of sound from layers of distorted guitar and hazy vocals.

name: Shona Mbira Music
zh: 津巴布韦绍纳人的姆比拉琴音乐，金属簧片循环交织，并带有葫芦共鸣的嗡响。
en: Shona mbira music from Zimbabwe, with interlocking metal-key patterns and a buzzing resonance from the instrument's resonator.

name: Shona Music
zh: 津巴布韦绍纳人的音乐传统，姆比拉琴循环、合唱与鼓乐常服务于社群和仪式。
en: Shona musical traditions from Zimbabwe, where mbira cycles, communal singing, and drumming often accompany social and ceremonial life.

name: Shoor
zh: 什叶派哀悼吟唱，以反复呼名、延迟人声和整齐击胸形成强烈脉动。
en: Shi'a mourning recitation creating a forceful pulse through repeated invocations, delayed vocal echoes, and coordinated chest-beating.

name: Show Tunes
zh: 为音乐剧舞台创作的歌曲，用鲜明旋律和戏剧化演唱推进人物与情节。
en: Songs written for musical theatre, using memorable melodies and dramatic vocal delivery to develop characters and advance the story.

name: Shōmyō
zh: 日本佛教的经文吟唱，以缓慢延展的声线和细微音高变化形成庄严的声场。
en: Japanese Buddhist liturgical chanting with slowly unfolding vocal lines and subtle pitch inflections that shape a resonant ceremonial atmosphere.

name: Sichuan Opera
zh: 四川地方戏曲，结合多种声腔，常以高亢帮腔和锣鼓配合富于变化的演唱。
en: Sichuan opera combining several vocal traditions, often using high choral responses and percussion to support varied theatrical singing.

name: Sierreño
zh: 墨西哥西北部的吉他小组合奏，以拨弦旋律、节奏吉他和低音乐器伴随叙事歌唱。
en: Northwestern Mexican guitar-based ensemble music, pairing melodic picking, rhythmic strumming, and bass accompaniment with narrative vocals.

name: Siffleur
zh: 把口哨作为主奏的舞台音乐，以清亮旋律、滑音和仿鸟鸣展现技巧。
en: Stage music featuring whistling as the lead voice, with clear melodies, pitch slides, and birdlike flourishes.

name: Sigilkore
zh: 把说唱人声和节拍反复变速、切碎并加重失真的网络说唱，音色尖锐而迷离。
en: An internet rap style warping vocals and beats through abrupt speed changes, chopped edits, and heavy digital distortion.

name: Sikuri
zh: 安第斯排箫合奏，演奏者交替补全旋律，并用大鼓与密集吹奏形成群体声响。
en: Andean panpipe ensemble music in which players interlock melodic phrases over drums, creating a dense, collective sound.

name: Sinawi
zh: 韩国巫俗器乐，以多件乐器同时变奏同一旋律框架，形成交错而自由的线条。
en: Korean shamanic instrumental music with several instruments simultaneously varying a shared melodic framework in freely interwoven lines.

name: Sindhi Music
zh: 信德地区的音乐传统，常以苏菲诗歌、装饰性演唱和长颈拨弦乐器伴奏为核心。
en: Music of Sindh, often centered on Sufi poetry, ornamented singing, and accompaniment from long-necked plucked lutes.

name: Sinfonia concertante
zh: 让数位独奏者与管弦乐团交织对答的协奏交响曲，兼顾合奏与个人音色。
en: Orchestral music featuring several soloists in dialogue with the ensemble, balancing symphonic interplay with distinct individual instrumental voices.

name: Singeli
zh: 坦桑尼亚的极速电子舞曲，以密集循环、切碎采样和贴着鼓点冲刺的唱诵推进。
en: High-speed Tanzanian electronic dance music driven by densely looping rhythms, chopped samples, and rapid-fire vocal delivery.

name: Singer-Songwriter
zh: 以创作者亲自演唱的歌曲为中心，重视个人叙事、歌词和旋律表达。
en: Music centered on artists performing their own songs, with an emphasis on personal storytelling, lyrics, and melodic expression.

name: Singspiel
zh: 德语歌唱戏剧，在咏唱、合唱和器乐段落之间穿插口语对白。
en: German-language musical theatre alternating spoken dialogue with sung solos, ensembles, choruses, and instrumental passages.

name: Sinhalese Folk Music
zh: 斯里兰卡僧伽罗人的民歌传统，涵盖劳动歌、仪式吟唱和鼓乐伴随的歌舞。
en: Sinhala folk traditions of Sri Lanka, encompassing work songs, ritual chants, and singing or dancing accompanied by drums.

name: Siren Jam
zh: 源于新西兰扩音器竞赛的电子音乐，以明亮高音旋律和反复剪辑的人声穿透街头声场。
en: Electronic music from New Zealand's siren-speaker scene, emphasizing bright treble melodies and repeated vocal edits that carry outdoors.

name: Sissy Bounce
zh: 新奥尔良酷儿场景的弹跳说唱，以反复口号、领唱应答和急促鼓点带动舞蹈。
en: Bounce from New Orleans' queer scene, driving dance through repeated chants, call-and-response vocals, and brisk, looping drums.

name: Sitarsploitation
zh: 把西塔琴音色加入西方流行或轻音乐的录音，用拨弦嗡鸣营造迷幻的异域想象。
en: Western pop and easy listening featuring sitar, using its buzzing strings to create psychedelic, imagined exotic atmospheres.

name: Sizhu Music
zh: 中国丝竹合奏，以弦乐和笛箫共同装饰旋律，各声部交错呼应。
en: Chinese chamber music combining strings and bamboo winds, with instruments ornamenting shared melodies in closely interwoven parts.

name: Ska
zh: 牙买加舞曲，以反拍吉他、跳跃低音和明亮管乐奏出轻快的摇摆节奏。
en: Jamaican dance music with offbeat guitar accents, walking bass lines, and bright horns creating a brisk, swinging pulse.

name: Ska Punk
zh: 把斯卡反拍吉他与朋克失真、快速鼓点和合唱副歌结合的摇滚。
en: Rock combining ska's offbeat guitar rhythms with punk distortion, fast drums, and exuberant singalong choruses.

name: Skacore
zh: 把斯卡的反拍律动推向硬核朋克，加入粗吼、急促鼓点和沉重吉他。
en: Ska punk pushed toward hardcore, combining offbeat rhythms with harsh shouting, frantic drums, and heavier guitars.

name: Skate Punk
zh: 高速而旋律鲜明的朋克，以紧密鼓点、利落吉他和容易跟唱的副歌推进。
en: Fast, melodic punk rock propelled by tightly played drums, sharp guitars, and choruses built for singing along.

name: Sketch Comedy
zh: 以短篇情景和角色对白构成的喜剧录音，通过表演节奏与反转制造笑点。
en: Comedy recordings built from short scenes and character dialogue, using timing, performance, and unexpected turns to deliver jokes.

name: Skiffle
zh: 用木吉他、搓衣板等简单乐器演奏的民谣摇摆，吸收布鲁斯与爵士节奏。
en: Acoustic folk-based music drawing on blues and jazz, often played with guitars, washboards, and other improvised rhythm instruments.

name: Skiladika
zh: 希腊夜总会的通俗歌舞音乐，以夸张转音、布祖基琴或电子编曲突出情感。
en: Greek nightclub popular music emphasizing emotive, ornamented vocals over bouzouki accompaniment or electronic dance-oriented arrangements.

name: Skinhead Reggae
zh: 早期雷鬼中节奏紧凑的一支，常用脆利反拍、跳跃贝斯和活跃风琴。
en: An early reggae sound with crisp offbeats, buoyant bass lines, and lively organ patterns over a compact, driving rhythm.

name: Skizzo
zh: 比利时新节拍的加速分支，吸收锐舞影响，将更快节奏与流畅的泰克诺声响结合。
en: A rave-influenced branch of Belgian new beat, with faster rhythms and a more fluid techno sound.

name: Skullstep
zh: 极端沉重的鼓打贝斯，以连发般的军鼓、密集碎拍和失真低音制造压迫感。
en: An extreme drum-and-bass style built from machine-gun snares, densely packed breakbeats, and heavily distorted bass textures.

name: Skweee
zh: 北欧电子放克，以简短合成器旋律、扭动低音和精简鼓机节奏形成弹性律动。
en: Nordic electronic funk combining simple synthesizer leads, rubbery bass lines, and sparse drum-machine patterns into a lopsided groove.

name: Slack-Key Guitar
zh: 夏威夷开放调弦吉他，以拇指低音与流动高音交织，保持温暖的弦乐共鸣。
en: Hawaiian open-tuned guitar music weaving thumb-played bass with flowing treble melodies and the warm resonance of ringing strings.

name: Slacker Rock
zh: 以松散演奏、随性的唱腔和略显粗糙的吉他录音呈现日常感的独立摇滚。
en: Indie rock with loose playing, casually delivered vocals, and rough-edged guitar recordings that give the songs an unpolished, everyday feel.

name: Slam Death Metal
zh: 残酷死亡金属中强调慢速重击的一支，以闷重低音吉他段落和深喉嘶吼制造冲击。
en: Brutal death metal centered on slow, crushing guitar grooves and deep guttural vocals, punctuated by faster bursts.

name: Slam Poetry
zh: 面向现场观众的诗歌表演，以说话节奏、重音和舞台表达强化文字力量。
en: Poetry performed for a live audience, using spoken rhythm, vocal emphasis, and stage delivery to intensify the words.

name: Slap House
zh: 用短促弹跳的合成低音、四拍底鼓和醒目人声钩子推动的浩室舞曲。
en: House music driven by short, bouncy synth-bass notes, a four-on-the-floor kick, and prominent vocal hooks.

name: Slavic Folk Music
zh: 斯拉夫各地的民间歌舞，涵盖仪式合唱、叙事歌和提琴或笛管伴奏的舞曲。
en: Folk traditions of Slavic peoples, encompassing ritual singing, narrative songs, and dances accompanied by fiddles or wind instruments.

name: Sleaze Rock
zh: 带有街头粗粝感的华丽金属，以沙哑唱腔、布鲁斯式吉他和放浪的副歌见长。
en: Glam metal with a rough streetwise edge, combining raspy vocals, bluesy guitar riffs, and swaggering choruses.

name: Slimepunk
zh: 围绕黏液网络美学的电子舞曲，常用失真低音、酸性合成器与密集采样。
en: An internet dance-music scene built around slime imagery, often featuring distorted bass, acid synth sounds, and extensive sampling.

name: Slovak Folk Music
zh: 斯洛伐克的民间音乐，包含牧笛旋律、弦乐舞曲与高亢的乡村歌唱。
en: Slovak folk traditions encompassing shepherd-flute melodies, string-led dance tunes, and strongly projected rural singing.

name: Slovenian Folk Music
zh: 斯洛文尼亚民间歌舞，常以多声部演唱和手风琴、弦乐伴奏的舞曲呈现。
en: Slovenian folk song and dance traditions, often featuring multipart vocals and dance tunes played on accordion and strings.

name: Slowcore
zh: 以缓慢节拍、稀疏吉他和克制人声拉开空间的独立摇滚，变化细微。
en: Indie rock built from slow tempos, sparse guitars, and restrained vocals, allowing small musical changes plenty of space.

name: Slowed & Reverb
zh: 将现有歌曲减速并加入混响，让音高降低、尾音延长，形成朦胧拖曳的听感。
en: Existing tracks slowed down and treated with reverb, lowering pitch and stretching decays into a hazy, lingering sound.

name: Sludge Metal
zh: 把毁灭金属的迟缓重量与硬核朋克的粗暴结合，吉他黏滞，唱腔撕裂。
en: Metal fusing doom's slow, heavy riffs with hardcore punk's abrasion, marked by thick guitar distortion and ragged vocals.

name: Slushwave
zh: 把放慢的采样浸入浓厚混响与相位效果的蒸汽波，声音层层漂浮。
en: Vaporwave immersing slowed samples in heavy reverb and sweeping phase effects, producing floating, densely blurred layers of sound.

name: Smooth Jazz
zh: 以圆润音色、流畅主旋律和稳定伴奏为主的爵士，常融入流行与节奏布鲁斯。
en: Accessible jazz with rounded tones, flowing lead melodies, and steady accompaniment, often drawing on pop and R&B.

name: Smooth Soul
zh: 以柔顺人声、细致和声和温润弦乐或节奏伴奏见长的灵魂乐。
en: Soul emphasizing smooth vocals, carefully arranged harmonies, and warm strings or understated rhythmic accompaniment.

name: Snap
zh: 以响指声替代醒目军鼓，配上精简低音循环和反复口号的南方说唱。
en: Southern hip hop using finger snaps in place of prominent snare hits, with sparse bass loops and repeated chants.

name: Soca
zh: 加勒比节庆舞曲，以强劲舞拍、明亮旋律和反复呼喊的副歌带动集体舞蹈。
en: Caribbean carnival dance music driven by energetic beats, bright melodies, and repeated vocal hooks that encourage communal dancing.

name: Soft Rock
zh: 以柔和人声、顺畅旋律和轻盈吉他编配呈现的流行摇滚，强调歌曲的亲和力。
en: Pop-oriented rock with gentle vocals, flowing melodies, and lighter guitar arrangements that keep the songs warm and approachable.

name: Soga Music
zh: 乌干达索加人的音乐，常以里拉琴、木琴和鼓的循环伴随歌唱。
en: Music of Uganda's Soga people, often pairing singing with repeating patterns on lyres, xylophones, and drums.

name: Solonese Gamelan
zh: 梭罗风格的爪哇甘美兰，偏重柔和音色与细密变奏，在锣声周期中缓缓展开。
en: The Solo style of Javanese gamelan, favoring softer timbres and intricate melodic elaboration within recurring gong cycles.

name: Somali Music
zh: 索马里的音乐以诗歌演唱为重，常用五声音阶旋律与乌德琴等乐器伴奏。
en: Somali music places poetic singing at its center, often using pentatonic melodies and accompaniment from instruments such as the oud.

name: Son calentano
zh: 墨西哥热土地区的舞曲，以装饰性小提琴、吉他与小鼓交错奏出活跃节奏。
en: Dance music from Mexico's Tierra Caliente, with ornamented violins, guitars, and tamborita drums creating interlocking rhythmic patterns.

name: Son cubano
zh: 古巴歌曲与舞曲，以特雷斯吉他、低音和打击节奏托起领唱与合唱应答。
en: Cuban song and dance music with tres guitar, bass, and percussion supporting exchanges between a lead singer and chorus.

name: Son de pascua
zh: 尼加拉瓜圣诞庆典的器乐，以轻快旋律和铃铛、铃鼓、水哨等音色增添节日感。
en: Nicaraguan Christmas instrumental music with lively melodies and festive colors from bells, tambourines, and water whistles.

name: Son huasteco
zh: 墨西哥瓦斯特卡歌舞，以高音小提琴、两种节奏吉他和突出的假声歌唱见长。
en: Mexican Huasteca music featuring high violin melodies, two rhythm guitars, and striking falsetto passages in the singing.

name: Son istmeño
zh: 墨西哥特万特佩克地峡的抒情歌舞，常以萨波特克语演唱，旋律舒展而婉转。
en: Lyrical songs and dances from Mexico's Isthmus of Tehuantepec, often sung in Zapotec with broad, expressive melodies.

name: Son jarocho
zh: 韦拉克鲁斯的歌舞音乐，用小吉他扫弦、拨弦旋律与木台踏舞形成交织节拍。
en: Music from Veracruz combining jarana strumming, plucked melodic strings, and percussive footwork on wooden platforms into interlocking rhythms.

name: Son montuno
zh: 把古巴颂乐推向反复应答段落，以钢琴循环、合唱和即兴领唱增强舞感。
en: Cuban son emphasizing repeated montuno sections, with looping piano figures, choral responses, and improvised lead vocals intensifying the groove.

name: Son nica
zh: 尼加拉瓜歌曲与舞曲，以六八拍的轻快摇摆和吉他伴奏描绘本土生活。
en: Nicaraguan songs and dances with a lilting six-eight rhythm and guitar accompaniment, often portraying local life.

name: Sonata
zh: 通常为独奏或小组合奏写成的多乐章作品，以主题发展和速度对比组织音乐。
en: Usually a multi-movement work for solo instrument or small ensemble, shaped by thematic development and contrasting tempos.

name: Songhai Music
zh: 尼日尔河流域桑海人的音乐，诗歌演唱、单弦琴与仪式节奏构成重要传统。
en: Music of Songhai communities along the Niger River, with sung poetry, one-string fiddles, and ceremonial rhythms among its traditions.

name: Songo
zh: 古巴舞曲，将架子鼓与康加鼓、天巴鼓的切分节奏融合，形成灵活紧密的律动。
en: Cuban dance music interweaving drum-kit patterns with syncopated congas and timbales to create a flexible, tightly coordinated groove.

name: Sonorism
zh: 以音色、密度和声音运动组织作品，常用音簇与特殊奏法取代传统旋律主导。
en: Music organized around timbre, density, and sonic movement, often using clusters and extended techniques instead of melody-led development.

name: Sophisti-Pop
zh: 编曲精致的流行音乐，将爵士和声、灵魂乐唱腔与圆润的键盘和管乐结合。
en: Polished pop blending jazz-influenced harmony and soulful vocals with smooth keyboard textures and carefully arranged horns.

name: Sotho-Tswana Folk Music
zh: 南部非洲索托与茨瓦纳的民歌，包含集体合唱、芦管合奏和口弓伴唱。
en: Sotho and Tswana folk traditions from southern Africa, encompassing communal singing, reedpipe ensembles, and songs accompanied by mouth bows.

name: Soukous
zh: 刚果舞曲，以层层交错的电吉他旋律和持续推进的节奏营造轻快舞感。
en: Congolese dance music built around bright, interlocking electric-guitar lines and steadily driving rhythms that keep the groove buoyant.

name: Soul
zh: 把福音式的情感演唱带入世俗歌曲，以强烈人声、节奏律动和应答乐句见长。
en: Music bringing gospel's expressive singing into secular songs, with powerful vocals, rhythmic grooves, and call-and-response phrasing.

name: Soul Blues
zh: 用灵魂乐唱腔与管乐、风琴编配演绎布鲁斯，节奏饱满，情感直接。
en: Blues enriched with soulful vocals, horns, and organ, pairing full-bodied grooves with direct, emotionally expressive singing.

name: Soul Jazz
zh: 以福音、布鲁斯和节奏布鲁斯为根基的爵士，常由风琴带动反复而鲜明的律动。
en: Jazz rooted in gospel, blues, and R&B, often using organ-led ensembles and repeated, strongly defined rhythmic grooves.

name: Sound Art
zh: 把声音本身作为艺术材料，通过装置、空间、录音或现场行动组织听觉经验。
en: Art using sound as its material, shaping listening through installations, spatial arrangements, recordings, or live actions.

name: Sound Collage
zh: 将语音、音乐与环境录音剪接叠放，让不同声音片段的并置产生结构与意义。
en: Music assembling speech, musical excerpts, and environmental recordings through cuts and layers, building meaning from their juxtaposition.

name: Sound Effects
zh: 为场景、动作或物体制作的独立声音，包括拟音、环境效果与合成音效。
en: Sounds created or collected to represent actions, objects, or settings, including foley, environmental effects, and synthesized cues.

name: Sound Map
zh: 以实地录音描绘地点与路线，把环境声按空间关系组织成可聆听的地图。
en: Field recordings arranged to represent places or routes, organizing environmental sounds into an audible map of an area.

name: Sound Poetry
zh: 把字音、呼吸和发声节奏当作诗的材料，意义也来自声音而非仅靠词义。
en: Poetry using phonetic sounds, breath, and vocal rhythm as material, making sound itself part of the meaning.

name: South American Music
zh: 南美各地的音乐总称，涵盖安第斯管乐、巴西节奏与拉普拉塔河流域歌舞等传统。
en: Music from across South America, encompassing Andean wind ensembles, Brazilian rhythmic traditions, and Río de la Plata song and dance.

name: South Asian Classical Music
zh: 以拉格旋律框架和塔拉节奏周期展开的南亚古典传统，重视细致装饰与即兴。
en: South Asian classical traditions developing raga melodies over tala cycles, with detailed ornamentation and substantial room for improvisation.

name: South Asian Folk Music
zh: 南亚各地世代传唱的民间音乐，包含叙事歌、劳动歌和鼓、弦乐伴奏的歌舞。
en: South Asian folk traditions encompassing narrative songs, work songs, and communal music accompanied by drums and string instruments.

name: South Asian Music
zh: 南亚各地的音乐总称，横跨拉格古典传统、地方民歌、宗教吟唱与流行歌曲。
en: Music from South Asia, spanning raga-based classical traditions, regional folk songs, devotional singing, and popular song styles.

name: Southeast Asian Classical Music
zh: 东南亚宫廷与艺术音乐，常以锣、排琴和管乐的层叠旋律构成精细合奏。
en: Southeast Asian court and art-music traditions, often featuring intricate ensembles of gongs, keyed percussion, and winds with layered melodies.

name: Southeast Asian Folk Music
zh: 东南亚各族的民间歌舞与仪式音乐，常听见竹制乐器、锣鼓和应答歌唱。
en: Southeast Asian folk and ritual traditions, often featuring bamboo instruments, gongs, drums, and exchanges between singers.

name: Southeast Asian Music
zh: 东南亚各地的音乐总称，涵盖锣乐合奏、地方歌舞、戏曲与现代流行音乐。
en: Music from Southeast Asia, spanning gong ensembles, regional song and dance, theatrical traditions, and contemporary popular styles.

name: Southeastern Brazilian Music
zh: 巴西东南部的音乐，涵盖里约桑巴、城市歌谣与维奥拉琴伴奏的乡村传统。
en: Music from southeastern Brazil, encompassing Rio's samba, urban song traditions, and rural music accompanied by viola caipira.

name: Southern African Folk Music
zh: 南部非洲的民间音乐传统，包含多声部歌唱、姆比拉琴循环和集体鼓舞。
en: Southern African folk traditions encompassing multipart singing, interlocking mbira patterns, and communal music for drumming and dancing.

name: Southern African Music
zh: 南部非洲各地的音乐，横跨合唱、拇指琴传统、吉他舞曲与电子流行音乐。
en: Music across southern Africa, ranging from choral and lamellophone traditions to guitar-driven dance styles and electronic popular music.

name: Southern Brazilian Music
zh: 巴西南部的音乐，常见手风琴、吉他与高乔歌舞，带有邻近拉普拉塔河地区的影响。
en: Music of southern Brazil, often featuring accordion, guitar, and gaúcho song and dance shaped by neighboring Río de la Plata traditions.

name: Southern Gospel
zh: 美国南方福音歌曲，以四重唱和紧密和声为核心，常配钢琴及乡村式伴奏。
en: Southern American gospel centered on vocal quartets and close harmonies, often accompanied by piano and country-influenced arrangements.

name: Southern Metal
zh: 把美国南方摇滚的布鲁斯味融入重金属，以厚重吉他和强烈律动推进。
en: Metal combining the bluesy character of Southern rock with heavy guitar riffs and strongly accented grooves.

name: Southern Rock
zh: 美国南方摇滚，以布鲁斯吉他、乡村元素和多把吉他的合奏与独奏见长。
en: American Southern rock featuring blues-based guitars, country influences, and prominent interplay between multiple guitarists in riffs and solos.

name: Southern Soul
zh: 美国南方的灵魂乐，以粗粝而有力的演唱、管乐应答和扎实节奏表达情感。
en: Soul from the American South with earthy, forceful singing, responsive horn lines, and grounded rhythmic accompaniment.

name: Soviet Estrada
zh: 苏联舞台流行歌曲，常以戏剧化独唱、鲜明旋律和管弦或大乐队编配呈现。
en: Soviet stage-oriented popular songs, often featuring dramatic solo vocals, memorable melodies, and orchestral or big-band arrangements.

name: Space Age Pop
zh: 带有未来想象的轻音乐，用奇巧打击乐、无词人声和立体声编排制造新奇音色。
en: Futuristic easy listening using unusual percussion, wordless vocals, and playful stereo arrangements to showcase novel instrumental colors.

name: Space Ambient
zh: 以缓慢漂浮的合成器、持续低鸣和宽阔混响营造宇宙空间感的氛围音乐。
en: Ambient music suggesting cosmic space through slowly drifting synthesizers, sustained drones, and expansive reverberation.

name: Space Disco
zh: 带有科幻色彩的迪斯科，以电子音序、合成器旋律和稳定舞拍构成。
en: Disco with a science-fiction atmosphere, built from electronic sequences, prominent synthesizer melodies, and a steady dance pulse.

name: Space Rock
zh: 用延迟吉他、持续低音和合成器扩展长篇段落的迷幻摇滚，重视循环与漂移。
en: Psychedelic rock stretching out through delayed guitars, sustained bass, and synthesizers, with an emphasis on repetition and gradual drift.

name: Space Rock Revival
zh: 复兴太空摇滚的吉他音乐，以重复和弦、长篇即兴和迷离效果构筑扩散的声场。
en: A revival of space rock built around repeating chords, extended jams, and effects-laden guitars that spread into expansive textures.

name: Spacesynth
zh: 以明亮合成器主旋律、滚动音序和持续电子鼓点营造科幻感的意式迪斯科分支。
en: An Italo-disco offshoot with bright synth leads, rolling sequences, and steady electronic drums creating a space-themed sound.

name: Spaghetti Western
zh: 意式西部片配乐，用口哨、电吉他、无词合唱和突出的打击音描绘荒野与对峙。
en: Italian Western film music using whistling, electric guitar, wordless choirs, and striking percussion to evoke landscapes and standoffs.

name: Spanish Classical Music
zh: 西班牙古典音乐传统，常从地方歌舞取材，以吉他、钢琴或管弦乐展开。
en: Spanish classical traditions that often draw on regional songs and dances in works for guitar, piano, or orchestra.

name: Spanish Folk Music
zh: 西班牙各地的民间歌舞，包含吉他伴唱、风笛乐队与不同地区的圈舞节奏。
en: Folk traditions across Spain, including guitar-accompanied singing, bagpipe ensembles, and the distinct rhythms of regional group dances.

name: Spanish Music
zh: 西班牙各地区的音乐总称，涵盖弗拉门戈、地方民歌、古典作品与流行歌曲。
en: Music from Spain's regions, encompassing flamenco, local folk traditions, classical composition, and popular song.

name: Spectralism
zh: 从声音的频谱和泛音关系出发作曲，以音色渐变和缓慢融合的和声组织音乐。
en: Composition shaped by sound spectra and overtone relationships, often unfolding through gradual timbral changes and slowly merging harmonies.

name: Speeches
zh: 以讲话内容为主体的录音，通过语气、停顿和修辞节奏向听众传达观点。
en: Recordings centered on public address, using vocal inflection, pauses, and rhetorical rhythm to communicate ideas to listeners.

name: Speed Garage
zh: 英国车库舞曲中偏浩室的一支，以四拍底鼓、摇摆踩镲和拉长扭动的低音见长。
en: A house-oriented UK garage style with four-on-the-floor kicks, shuffling hi-hats, and stretched, warping bass lines.

name: Speed House
zh: 把贝斯浩室推向更快节奏，以强劲四拍底鼓、尖锐合成器和低音起落制造冲击。
en: Fast-paced house combining hard four-on-the-floor kicks, sharp synthesizers, and emphatic bass drops with the weight of bass house.

name: Speed Metal
zh: 以快速吉他拨奏、高亢人声和紧凑鼓点推动的重金属，强调速度与清晰旋律。
en: Heavy metal driven by rapid guitar picking, high vocals, and tight drums, emphasizing speed while retaining clear melodic lines.

name: Speedcore
zh: 将硬核电子舞曲推向极高速，以连续失真底鼓形成猛烈而密集的脉冲。
en: Extreme hardcore electronic music using very fast, repeatedly distorted kick drums to create a dense, punishing pulse.

name: Spiritual
zh: 美国黑人传统宗教歌曲，以圣经意象、重复短句和领唱应答承载信仰与苦难。
en: African American religious folk songs carrying faith and hardship through biblical imagery, repeated phrases, and call-and-response singing.

name: Spiritual Art Song
zh: 将黑人灵歌编为音乐会独唱曲，保留原有旋律，并用钢琴伴奏细化和声与表情。
en: African American spirituals arranged as concert songs, preserving their melodies while adding expressive piano accompaniment and developed harmonies.

name: Spiritual Jazz
zh: 带有精神探索意味的爵士，常以调式即兴、反复吟唱和持续打击乐营造冥想感。
en: Jazz pursuing spiritual expression through modal improvisation, repeated chants, and sustained percussion patterns that create a meditative atmosphere.

name: Splittercore
zh: 速度极端的硬核电子音乐，将密集底鼓推到几乎连成一片的震颤状态。
en: An extreme speedcore offshoot whose tightly packed kick drums approach a continuous, violently vibrating wall of sound.

name: Spoken Word
zh: 以说话、朗诵或讲述为核心的录音，声音节奏和文字表达比歌唱旋律更突出。
en: Recordings centered on speech, recitation, or storytelling, foregrounding the rhythm of delivery and the meaning of words.

name: Spouge
zh: 巴巴多斯舞曲，结合斯卡反拍与卡利普索的歌唱传统，常配吉他和打击乐。
en: Barbadian dance music combining ska's offbeat rhythms with calypso-style singing, commonly supported by guitars and percussion.

name: Spy Music
zh: 间谍片式爵士配乐，以紧绷低音、铜管重音和锋利吉他营造追踪与悬疑感。
en: Spy-film-inspired jazz using taut bass patterns, punchy brass accents, and sharp guitar figures to suggest pursuit and intrigue.

name: Stand-Up Comedy
zh: 喜剧演员面向观众的口语表演，以段子、观察和精确停顿制造现场笑声。
en: Spoken comedy performed directly to an audience, using jokes, observations, and carefully timed pauses to generate laughter.

name: Standards
zh: 被反复演绎的经典流行曲库，以熟悉的旋律和歌词为核心，常配爵士或乐队编曲。
en: A repertoire of repeatedly interpreted popular songs, centered on familiar melodies and lyrics, often presented with jazz or orchestral arrangements.

name: Starogradska muzika
zh: 巴尔干旧城歌曲传统，以怀旧抒情的演唱和小提琴、单簧管等小组合奏见长。
en: Balkan old-town songs with nostalgic, lyrical singing accompanied by small ensembles often featuring violin and clarinet.

name: Staïfi
zh: 阿尔及利亚塞提夫的节庆舞曲，以活跃地方节奏、装饰性唱腔和醒目键盘伴奏见长。
en: Festive music from Algeria's Sétif region, combining lively local rhythms, ornamented singing, and prominent keyboard accompaniment.

name: Steel Band
zh: 以钢盘鼓组成的加勒比合奏，明亮金属音色分担旋律、和声与低音节奏。
en: Caribbean ensembles of steelpans, distributing melody, harmony, and bass patterns across their bright, pitched metallic tones.

name: Stenchcore
zh: 把结壳朋克与重金属结合，以阴沉吉他、沉重中速段落和粗砺嘶吼推进。
en: Crust punk fused with metal, featuring dark guitar riffs, crushing mid-tempo passages, and harsh, guttural vocal delivery.

name: Stereo
zh: 缅甸的西式流行摇滚，以本地语言演唱，常用电吉他、贝斯和架子鼓编配。
en: Burmese Western-style pop and rock, sung in local languages and commonly arranged for electric guitars, bass, and drums.

name: Stochastic Music
zh: 用概率规则决定音高、节奏或音群分布的音乐，让大量声音依统计关系变化。
en: Music using probability to organize pitches, rhythms, or masses of sound, allowing events to unfold according to statistical relationships.

name: Stomp and Holler
zh: 面向合唱的独立民谣流行，以跺脚、拍手、木吉他和高声副歌建立节奏。
en: Singalong indie folk-pop driven by stomps, handclaps, strummed acoustic guitars, and loudly projected communal choruses.

name: Stomp Dance Song
zh: 北美东南部原住民踏步舞歌，以领唱应答和绑腿摇响器维持围圈舞的节奏。
en: Southeastern Native American stomp-dance songs, with call-and-response voices and leg rattles maintaining the pulse for communal circle dancing.

name: Stoner Metal
zh: 将低调弦重型吉他、模糊失真和反复律动结合的金属，带有迷幻摇滚色彩。
en: Metal built from downtuned riffs, thick fuzz, and repetitive grooves, drawing on the textures and repetition of psychedelic rock.

name: Stoner Rap
zh: 以大麻体验和闲散生活为常见主题的说唱，常搭配松弛节拍与迷幻采样。
en: Rap frequently centered on cannabis and laid-back everyday life, often paired with relaxed beats and hazy, psychedelic samples.

name: Stoner Rock
zh: 以厚重法兹吉他、布鲁斯式重复乐句和长篇即兴展开的迷幻硬摇滚。
en: Psychedelic hard rock built around thick fuzz guitars, repeating blues-based riffs, and extended instrumental jams.

name: Stornello
zh: 意大利短篇民歌，以简短押韵诗句和自由应答为特色，常即兴唱爱情或调侃。
en: Short Italian folk songs built from rhymed verses and responsive exchanges, often improvising on love or playful mockery.

name: Stotra
zh: 印度教赞神诗的吟诵或歌唱，以反复颂词、清晰韵律和虔敬声腔为核心。
en: Hindu praise poetry recited or sung with repeated devotional verses, clear rhythmic phrasing, and an expressive sacred vocal delivery.

name: Street Punk
zh: 粗粝直接的朋克，以强硬吉他、整齐鼓点和集体呼喊式副歌凝聚现场能量。
en: Direct, rough-edged punk with forceful guitars, steady drums, and shouted group choruses that emphasize collective participation.

name: Stride
zh: 爵士钢琴中左手在低音与和弦间大幅跳跃，右手自由奏出切分旋律。
en: Jazz piano with the left hand leaping between bass notes and chords while the right plays freely syncopated melodies.

name: String Quartet
zh: 由两把小提琴、中提琴和大提琴组成的室内乐，以四个声部的对话展开。
en: Chamber music for two violins, viola, and cello, developing musical ideas through close dialogue between four string parts.

name: Stutter House
zh: 把人声或和弦切成快速反复的短片段，让结巴般的钩子嵌入浩室鼓点。
en: House music slicing vocals or chords into rapidly repeated fragments, turning stuttering hooks into part of the groove.

name: Sufi Music
zh: 苏菲信仰中的音乐与吟唱，常通过诗歌、反复颂念和逐渐增强的演唱表达虔敬。
en: Music and chanting associated with Sufi devotion, often using poetry, repeated invocations, and gradually intensifying vocal delivery.

name: Sufi Rock
zh: 将南亚苏菲诗歌与摇滚乐队结合，以电吉他、鼓和反复歌唱扩展宗教抒情。
en: Rock setting South Asian Sufi poetry to electric guitars and drums, expanding devotional expression through repeated, impassioned singing.

name: Sufiana kalam
zh: 克什米尔苏菲古典音乐，以桑图尔琴和弦乐伴随合唱，按调式展开神秘诗歌。
en: Kashmiri Sufi classical music setting mystical poetry to modal choral singing, accompanied by santoor and other string instruments.

name: Sundanese Music
zh: 西爪哇巽他人的音乐，常见卡查皮琴、竹笛和甘美兰交织的细腻旋律。
en: Music of West Java's Sundanese people, often featuring delicate melodic interplay between kacapi zithers, bamboo flutes, and gamelan instruments.

name: Sungura
zh: 津巴布韦舞曲，以多把电吉他的快速交织、活跃贝斯和紧密鼓点驱动歌唱。
en: Zimbabwean dance music driven by fast, interlocking electric guitars, agile bass lines, and tightly coordinated drums beneath the vocals.

name: Sunshine Pop
zh: 以明亮多声部和声、轻快节拍和精致管弦编配营造晴朗听感的流行音乐。
en: Sunny-sounding pop with bright vocal harmonies, buoyant rhythms, and carefully arranged orchestral touches.

name: Suomisaundi
zh: 芬兰迷幻舞曲，以自由多变的编排、古怪采样和放克式乐句打破规整循环。
en: Finnish psychedelic trance with eclectic arrangements, odd samples, and funk-influenced phrases that disrupt predictable dance-music patterns.

name: Surf Music
zh: 围绕冲浪文化的摇滚音乐，包含湿润混响吉他主导的器乐与多声部流行歌唱。
en: Rock associated with surfing culture, encompassing reverb-soaked guitar instrumentals and harmony-rich vocal pop songs.

name: Surf Punk
zh: 将冲浪吉他的明亮混响与朋克的快速鼓点、粗粝失真和呼喊结合。
en: Punk rock combining bright, reverberant surf-guitar sounds with fast drums, rough distortion, and shouted vocals.

name: Surf Rock
zh: 以浓重弹簧混响、快速拨弦和简洁鼓点见长的器乐摇滚，吉他旋律居于中心。
en: Instrumental rock centered on electric-guitar melodies, with heavy spring reverb, rapid picking, and straightforward, driving drums.

name: Sutartinės
zh: 立陶宛多声部民歌，以短句轮唱和相邻音高交叠形成紧密、带摩擦感的和声。
en: Lithuanian multipart songs using short repeated phrases and overlapping close pitches to create tightly woven, sharply rubbing harmonies.

name: Swamp Blues
zh: 路易斯安那电声布鲁斯，以缓慢拖曳的节奏、口琴和带回响的吉他见长。
en: Louisiana electric blues with a slow, loping pulse, harmonica, and reverberant guitar lines that leave plenty of space.

name: Swamp Pop
zh: 路易斯安那流行歌曲，把卡津、克里奥尔传统与节奏布鲁斯的钢琴、管乐和抒情唱腔结合。
en: Louisiana pop blending Cajun and Creole traditions with R&B piano, horns, and expressive ballad singing.

name: Swamp Rock
zh: 带有美国南方湿地气息的根源摇滚，结合布鲁斯吉他、乡村旋律和松弛重拍。
en: Roots rock combining bluesy guitars, country-inflected melodies, and loose, heavy grooves associated with the American South.

name: Swancore
zh: 后硬核的技巧化分支，以灵巧点弦吉他、跳跃节奏和清唱、嘶吼的交替见长。
en: Technical post-hardcore featuring nimble tapped guitar lines, shifting rhythms, and contrasts between clean singing and harsh vocals.

name: Swedish Folk Music
zh: 瑞典民间歌舞，以提琴、键控提琴和带重音变化的三拍子波尔斯卡舞曲见长。
en: Swedish folk traditions featuring fiddles, nyckelharpa, and polska dance tunes whose triple-meter rhythms shift their emphasis.

name: Sweet Jazz
zh: 旋律柔顺、编排讲究的早期舞厅爵士，常加入弦乐，突出合奏而减少即兴。
en: Early dance-band jazz with smooth melodies and polished arrangements, often adding strings and emphasizing ensemble writing over improvisation.

name: Swing
zh: 以摇摆八分音符和稳定四拍律动为核心的爵士，常用大乐队声部相互应答。
en: Jazz built around swinging eighth notes and a steady four-beat pulse, often featuring call-and-response between big-band sections.

name: Swing musette
zh: 把法国手风琴舞曲与爵士摇摆结合，用灵活即兴和跳跃伴奏推动旋律。
en: French accordion-based musette combined with jazz swing, using nimble improvisation and buoyant accompaniment to propel the melodies.

name: Symphonic Black Metal
zh: 在黑金属的尖厉嘶吼和密集鼓点之外加入管弦编配，扩大旋律与戏剧层次。
en: Black metal combining harsh shrieks and rapid drumming with orchestral arrangements that broaden its melodic and dramatic scope.

name: Symphonic Metal
zh: 将厚重金属吉他与管弦乐、合唱或交响键盘结合，强调宏大的旋律编配。
en: Metal pairing heavy guitars with orchestral instruments, choirs, or symphonic keyboards, emphasizing large-scale melodic arrangements.

name: Symphonic Mugham
zh: 将阿塞拜疆穆卡姆的调式旋律与展开方式写入交响乐团，以管弦音色延伸传统。
en: Orchestral music adapting Azerbaijani mugham's modal melodies and unfolding structures to the textures and development of a symphony orchestra.

name: Symphonic Prog
zh: 前卫摇滚中偏重古典编排的一支，以多段结构、键盘和主题发展构筑长篇作品。
en: Progressive rock emphasizing classical-style arrangements, extended sectional forms, prominent keyboards, and the development of recurring musical themes.

name: Symphonic Rock
zh: 把摇滚乐队与管弦乐、弦乐层次或交响式编曲结合，突出戏剧化旋律。
en: Rock combining its band instrumentation with orchestral forces, layered strings, or symphonic arrangements to emphasize dramatic melodies.

name: Symphony
zh: 通常为管弦乐团写成的多乐章作品，以主题发展、声部交织和速度对比展开。
en: Usually a multi-movement orchestral work unfolding through thematic development, interplay between instrumental sections, and contrasting tempos.

name: Synth Funk
zh: 以合成器低音、电子键盘和鼓机重塑放克，保留切分节奏与鲜明重拍。
en: Funk shaped by synthesizer bass, electronic keyboards, and drum machines, retaining syncopated rhythms and strongly accented grooves.

name: Synth Punk
zh: 用合成器和电子节拍承载朋克的紧迫感，常配尖锐唱腔与粗糙失真。
en: Punk driven by synthesizers and electronic rhythms, often combining urgent vocals with abrasive tones and rough distortion.

name: Synthpop
zh: 以合成器旋律、电子鼓点和清晰歌曲结构为核心的流行音乐。
en: Pop centered on synthesizer melodies, electronic drum patterns, and clearly structured songs with memorable vocal hooks.

name: Synthwave
zh: 借鉴八十年代电子配乐，用复古合成器、滚动低音和鼓机营造霓虹般的听感。
en: Electronic music drawing on 1980s soundtracks, with vintage-style synthesizers, rolling bass lines, and drum machines creating a neon-lit atmosphere.

name: Syriac Chant
zh: 叙利亚语教会的礼仪吟唱，以调式旋律、经文咏唱和会众应答传承祷文。
en: Liturgical singing of Syriac churches, carrying sacred texts through modal melodies, chanted passages, and congregational responses.

name: Séga
zh: 印度洋克里奥尔歌舞，以摇摆切分、打击乐和应答式歌唱带动旋转舞步。
en: Indian Ocean Creole dance music with swaying syncopation, percussion, and responsive singing that accompanies turning, flowing movements.

name: Séga tambour
zh: 罗德里格斯岛的塞加歌舞，以手鼓、三角铁和拍掌伴随克里奥尔语即兴演唱。
en: Séga from Rodrigues Island, with hand drums, triangles, and clapping accompanying improvised singing in Creole.

name: Sōkyoku
zh: 日本筝曲，以拨弦和按弦变音塑造细致旋律，可独奏或与歌唱、三味线合奏。
en: Japanese koto music shaping delicate melodies through plucking and pitch bending, performed solo or with vocals and shamisen.

name: Taarab
zh: 东非斯瓦希里海岸的抒情歌乐，将阿拉伯式旋律与弦乐、打击乐及诗歌演唱结合。
en: Lyrical music of the Swahili coast, combining Arabic-influenced melodies with strings, percussion, and expressive singing of poetry.

name: Tahitian Music
zh: 塔希提的歌舞传统，包含密集鼓乐伴舞与声部交错的群体歌唱。
en: Tahitian musical traditions encompassing dances driven by dense drumming and communal singing with interwoven vocal parts.

name: Taiko
zh: 日本太鼓合奏，以大小鼓的重击、呼喝和整齐停顿形成鲜明的动态对比。
en: Japanese drum-ensemble music using powerful strikes, vocal calls, and coordinated pauses to create pronounced contrasts in volume and motion.

name: Taizé Chant
zh: 以简短经文反复歌唱的基督教祷歌，旋律易记，常以多声部缓慢叠合。
en: Christian prayer chants repeating short sacred texts, with memorable melodies often layered into slow-moving vocal harmonies.

name: Tajik Music
zh: 塔吉克音乐传统，包含细密装饰的诗歌演唱，以及长颈拨弦琴和弓弦乐器合奏。
en: Tajik musical traditions featuring ornamented poetic singing and ensembles of long-necked lutes, bowed strings, and other regional instruments.

name: Takamba
zh: 马里北部的舞曲，以电扩音鲁特琴的粗粝弹拨和葫芦打击的摇摆节奏见长。
en: Dance music from northern Mali, pairing gritty amplified lute lines with the distinctive swaying rhythms of struck calabashes.

name: Talempong
zh: 米南加保小锣合奏，数位演奏者交错敲击不同音高，把短句拼成循环旋律。
en: Minangkabau kettle-gong music in which players interlock short pitched patterns to build repeating melodic cycles.

name: Talempong goyang
zh: 将米南加保小锣与键盘、电吉他和架子鼓结合的流行舞曲，金属旋律明亮跳跃。
en: Minangkabau popular dance music combining talempong gongs with keyboards, electric guitars, and drums for a bright, rhythmic sound.

name: Talking Blues
zh: 在反复吉他或布鲁斯式伴奏上半说半唱，以口语节奏讲故事或作讽刺。
en: Conversational, half-spoken singing over repeating guitar or blues-based accompaniment, often used for storytelling and satire.

name: Tallava
zh: 巴尔干罗姆场景的歌舞音乐，以长篇即兴唱腔、键盘旋律和持续舞拍展开。
en: Balkan dance music associated with Romani scenes, featuring extended improvised vocals, prominent keyboards, and continuously unfolding dance rhythms.

name: Tamborera
zh: 巴拿马通俗舞曲，把本土鼓舞节奏与加勒比舞曲编配结合，旋律鲜明而轻快。
en: Panamanian popular dance music blending local tamborito rhythms with Caribbean dance arrangements and bright, buoyant melodies.

name: Tamborito
zh: 巴拿马传统鼓舞，由女领唱与合唱应答，配上多种鼓和整齐拍手。
en: Traditional Panamanian song and dance with a female lead, responding chorus, several drums, and coordinated handclaps.

name: Tamborzão
zh: 里约放克的打击乐节奏，用厚重底鼓、通通鼓和康加鼓采样堆成滚动循环。
en: A Rio funk rhythm built from heavy kicks, toms, and conga-like samples arranged into rolling percussion loops.

name: Tamil Folk Music
zh: 泰米尔民间音乐，包含叙事歌、仪式歌舞及以帕莱鼓和双簧吹管为核心的合奏。
en: Tamil folk traditions encompassing narrative songs, ritual dances, and ensembles centered on parai drums and double-reed wind instruments.

name: Tammurriata
zh: 意大利坎帕尼亚的歌舞，以框鼓、响板和有力唱腔维持反复的舞蹈节奏。
en: Campanian song and dance music from Italy, sustaining repeated dance rhythms through frame drums, castanets, and forceful singing.

name: Tango
zh: 拉普拉塔河地区的城市歌舞，以班多钮手风琴、弦乐和鲜明停顿塑造紧绷步伐。
en: Urban music of the Río de la Plata, with bandoneon, strings, and sharply marked pauses shaping its tense dance pulse.

name: Tango Nuevo
zh: 将探戈带入现代作曲与爵士语汇，以复杂和声、对位和节奏变化扩展传统。
en: Tango expanded through modern classical and jazz influences, using richer harmonies, contrapuntal writing, and more varied rhythmic structures.

name: Tanjidor
zh: 雅加达贝塔维人的街头管乐合奏，以铜管、单簧管和鼓演奏节庆舞曲。
en: Betawi street-ensemble music from Jakarta, using brass, clarinets, and drums to perform festive processional and dance tunes.

name: Taoist Ritual Music
zh: 中国道教科仪中的音乐，以经文吟唱、法器节奏和管乐配合仪式进程。
en: Music for Chinese Taoist rituals, combining scripture chanting, ceremonial percussion, and wind instruments with the progression of liturgical actions.

name: Tape Music
zh: 通过剪接、循环、变速或反向播放磁带来作曲，让录下的声音成为可塑材料。
en: Music composed by cutting, looping, changing speed, or reversing tape, treating recorded sounds as material that can be reshaped.

name: Tappa
zh: 印度斯坦古典声乐，以快速跳跃、连绵转音和紧凑乐句展现灵巧的旋律运动。
en: Hindustani vocal music featuring quick melodic leaps, flowing ornaments, and compact phrases that demand agile, rapidly moving singing.

name: Taquirari
zh: 玻利维亚东部的轻快歌舞，以鲜明二拍子、流畅旋律和活跃伴奏推动舞步。
en: Lively song and dance music from eastern Bolivia, with a clear duple pulse, flowing melodies, and buoyant accompaniment.

name: Tarana
zh: 印度斯坦声乐中以无实义音节代替歌词，借快速重复和装饰展现节奏与旋律技巧。
en: Hindustani vocal music using rhythmic syllables instead of ordinary lyrics, highlighting melodic agility through rapid repetition and ornamentation.

name: Tarantella
zh: 意大利南部的快速民间舞曲，以滚动复合拍、铃鼓和旋律乐器带动旋转舞步。
en: Fast southern Italian folk dances driven by rolling compound rhythms, tambourines, and melodic instruments that propel turning movements.

name: Tarawangsa
zh: 巽他稻作仪式音乐，以二弦擦奏琴与拨弦琴的持续合奏展开悠长旋律。
en: Sundanese rice-ritual music pairing the bowed tarawangsa with a plucked zither in continuously unfolding melodic cycles.

name: Tarraxinha
zh: 安哥拉缓慢的电子双人舞曲，以稀疏重低音和精简打击节奏强调细微身体动作。
en: Slow Angolan electronic partner-dance music with sparse, heavy bass pulses and minimal percussion supporting subtle, close movements.

name: Tarz
zh: 阿富汗流行歌曲，以诗歌主歌和反复副歌交替，并用器乐过门连接旋律。
en: Afghan popular songs alternating poetic verses and recurring refrains, with instrumental interludes linking their contrasting melodies.

name: Tassa
zh: 印度裔加勒比鼓乐，以高亢锅形鼓的密集滚奏、低音鼓和钹形成强烈节奏层次。
en: Indo-Caribbean drumming with rapid rolls on high-pitched tassa drums, supported by bass drums and cymbals in tightly layered rhythms.

name: Tassu
zh: 塞内加尔沃洛夫语的节奏诗诵，以快速口语、鼓乐和应答人声表达赞颂或讽刺。
en: Senegalese Wolof spoken poetry using rapid rhythmic delivery, drums, and vocal responses to convey praise or satire.

name: TBM
zh: 结合科技舞曲与电子身体音乐，用反复音序低音、冷硬鼓机和强烈重拍推动舞池。
en: Techno fused with EBM, driven by repeating sequenced bass lines, hard-edged drum machines, and forcefully accented dance rhythms.

name: Tchink System
zh: 把贝宁传统葫芦打击节奏带入电声乐队的舞曲，加入现代低音与流行歌唱。
en: Beninese dance music adapting traditional gourd-percussion rhythms for electric bands, adding modern bass lines and popular vocal arrangements.

name: Tchinkoumé
zh: 贝宁中部的传统仪式节奏，以浮在水上的葫芦、低音葫芦和铃声相互应答。
en: A central Beninese ceremonial rhythm built from water-supported calabashes, deep-toned gourds, and bells that answer one another.

name: Tearout
zh: 早期英国重型回响贝斯，以强烈摆动低音、半速鼓点和反复落点制造冲击。
en: An aggressive early UK dubstep style using forceful wobbling bass, half-time drums, and repeated drops for dancefloor impact.

name: Tearout [Brostep]
zh: 将美式回响贝斯的低音进一步压碎、失真，常用连发般音色与骤停形成重击。
en: An extreme brostep style crushing bass into harsh distortion, with machine-gun sound design and abrupt pauses accentuating heavy impacts.

name: Tech House
zh: 结合浩室律动与科技舞曲的简约编排，用短促打击乐和低音循环持续推进。
en: House grooves paired with techno's stripped-back arrangements, driven by clipped percussion and steadily repeating bass patterns.

name: Tech Trance
zh: 把科技舞曲的硬朗打击节奏放入出神舞曲，以紧密音序和渐进层次制造推动力。
en: Trance with techno's hard-edged percussion, using tightly sequenced patterns and gradually building layers to sustain momentum.

name: Technical Death Metal
zh: 以复杂吉他段落、快速变拍和精密鼓法扩展死亡金属，常配低沉嘶吼。
en: Death metal emphasizing intricate guitar passages, rapid rhythmic shifts, and precise drumming, commonly paired with guttural vocals.

name: Technical Thrash Metal
zh: 在鞭击金属的高速拨奏中加入复杂结构、变拍和灵巧乐器对答，演奏紧密。
en: Thrash metal combining rapid picking with complex structures, shifting meters, and nimble instrumental interplay performed with precision.

name: Techno
zh: 以稳定四拍底鼓和反复电子音序为基础，通过音色与层次的渐变推动舞蹈。
en: Electronic dance music built on steady four-on-the-floor kicks and repeating sequences, developing through gradual changes in texture and layering.

name: Techno Bass
zh: 融合电气舞曲、迈阿密贝斯和科技舞曲，以鼓机碎拍、深低音和精简合成器见长。
en: A fusion of electro, Miami bass, and techno, featuring drum-machine breakbeats, deep bass, and spare synthesizer arrangements.

name: Techno kayō
zh: 日本歌谣曲与电子流行的结合，以合成器、鼓机和鲜明的歌唱旋律呈现。
en: Japanese kayōkyoku blended with electronic pop, pairing distinctive sung melodies with synthesizers and drum-machine arrangements.

name: Technoid
zh: 把科技舞曲的机械循环融入鼓打贝斯，以冷硬音色、重复动机和密集鼓点推进。
en: Drum and bass incorporating techno's mechanical loops, with hard-edged textures, repeated motifs, and densely programmed percussion.

name: Techstep
zh: 鼓打贝斯中偏冷硬的一支，以紧绷碎拍、失真贝斯和工业音色营造压迫感。
en: A hard-edged drum-and-bass style using tense breakbeats, distorted bass, and industrial textures to create a dark, pressurized sound.

name: Tecnobanda
zh: 用电子键盘、电贝斯和架子鼓扩充墨西哥班达编制，使管乐歌曲更偏向舞曲。
en: Mexican banda expanded with keyboards, electric bass, and drum kit, giving brass-led songs a more dance-oriented arrangement.

name: Tecnobrega
zh: 巴西帕拉州的电子布雷加，以合成器旋律、鼓机节奏和直白情歌构成舞池歌曲。
en: Electronic brega from Brazil's Pará state, combining synthesizer melodies, programmed drums, and direct romantic lyrics in dance-oriented songs.

name: Tecnocumbia
zh: 用电子键盘、鼓机和合成低音重塑库姆比亚，保留摇摆节奏与醒目人声旋律。
en: Cumbia reshaped with electronic keyboards, drum machines, and synthesized bass, retaining its lilting rhythm and prominent sung melodies.

name: Tecnofunk
zh: 巴西帕拉州的混合舞曲，将放克人声套入响亮踩镲和轰鸣低音主导的电子节拍。
en: Electronic dance music from Pará setting funk vocals over beats dominated by loud hi-hats and booming bass.

name: Tecnomerengue
zh: 委内瑞拉流行舞曲，以合成器和电子鼓重塑梅伦格的快速节拍与热闹旋律。
en: Venezuelan dance pop updating merengue's brisk rhythms and exuberant melodies with synthesizers and electronic drums.

name: Tecnorumba
zh: 西班牙流行舞曲，将伦巴式唱腔与电子键盘、鼓机和反复副歌结合。
en: Spanish dance pop combining rumba-influenced singing with electronic keyboards, drum machines, and recurring, easily remembered choruses.

name: Teen Pop
zh: 面向青少年听众的流行歌曲，以直白情感、醒目副歌和易跟唱的旋律为核心。
en: Pop aimed at teenage listeners, centered on direct emotional themes, prominent choruses, and melodies that are easy to sing along with.

name: Tejano Music
zh: 得克萨斯墨西哥裔流行音乐，把手风琴、管乐或电子键盘与西班牙语歌曲和舞拍结合。
en: Mexican American music from Texas, combining Spanish-language songs and dance rhythms with accordion, horns, or electronic keyboards.

name: Telugu Folk Music
zh: 泰卢固民间音乐，以叙事歌唱、集体应答和强烈鼓乐伴随节庆、劳动与仪式。
en: Telugu folk traditions using narrative singing, communal responses, and emphatic drumming for celebrations, work, and ritual occasions.

name: Tembang Sunda Cianjuran
zh: 西爪哇展玉的巽他声乐，以卡查皮琴和竹笛托起舒展、装饰细腻的诗歌旋律。
en: Sundanese vocal music from Cianjur, with kacapi zithers and bamboo flute supporting spacious, finely ornamented settings of poetry.

name: Terror Plugg
zh: Plugg说唱的刺耳分支，用蜂鸣、警报般低音音色和粗糙失真打破柔和氛围。
en: An abrasive plugg offshoot using buzzing, alarm-like bass timbres and rough distortion to disrupt the style's usual softness.

name: Terrorcore
zh: 带有恐怖氛围的硬核电子舞曲，以失真底鼓、阴森采样和尖锐噪声制造压迫感。
en: Hardcore electronic music with a horror atmosphere, combining distorted kicks, ominous samples, and harsh noise textures.

name: Tex-Mex
zh: 得克萨斯与墨西哥传统交汇的根源摇滚，将手风琴、波尔卡节奏与电吉他结合。
en: Roots rock at the Texas–Mexico crossroads, blending accordion and polka-derived rhythms with electric guitars and rock-band arrangements.

name: Texan Music
zh: 得克萨斯的音乐总称，涵盖布鲁斯、乡村、墨西哥裔歌舞与地方摇滚传统。
en: Music from Texas, encompassing blues, country, Mexican American song and dance, and regional rock traditions.

name: Thai Classical Music
zh: 泰国古典合奏，以锣圈、木琴和双簧吹管分层装饰旋律，并由鼓点组织乐句。
en: Thai classical ensemble music layering gong circles, xylophones, and double-reed winds around shared melodies shaped by drum patterns.

name: Thai Folk Music
zh: 泰国各地的民间歌舞，包含应答歌唱、芦笙旋律和配合地方舞步的打击节奏。
en: Thai regional folk traditions encompassing responsive singing, mouth-organ melodies, and percussion patterns accompanying local dances.

name: Thai Music
zh: 泰国的音乐总称，横跨宫廷锣乐、地方歌舞、乡村歌曲与现代流行音乐。
en: Music from Thailand, spanning court gong ensembles, regional song and dance, country-oriented songs, and contemporary pop.

name: Thall
zh: 极低调弦的金属核，以滑动音高、突兀重击和不协和吉他留出阴沉空间。
en: Extremely downtuned metalcore using pitch bends, abrupt heavy accents, and dissonant guitars to create spacious, ominous textures.

name: Theme and Variation
zh: 先呈示一个主题，再改变旋律、节奏、和声或织体，让同一材料不断变形。
en: Music presenting a theme and then reshaping its melody, rhythm, harmony, or texture through a sequence of variations.

name: Third Stream
zh: 融合爵士与古典作曲方法，让即兴演奏、对位和室内乐或管弦编配共存。
en: Music integrating jazz with classical composition, bringing improvisation together with counterpoint and chamber or orchestral arrangements.

name: Third Wave Ska
zh: 将斯卡反拍带入朋克与另类摇滚场景，常以管乐、失真吉他和合唱副歌呈现。
en: Ska's offbeat rhythms carried into punk and alternative-rock scenes, often featuring horns, distorted guitars, and singalong choruses.

name: Thrash Metal
zh: 以高速闷音吉他、强烈切分和急促鼓点见长的金属，唱腔直接而凶猛。
en: Metal driven by rapid palm-muted guitar riffs, sharp syncopation, and forceful drumming, with an aggressive vocal attack.

name: Thrashcore
zh: 将硬核朋克推向极快速度，以短小歌曲、密集爆破鼓点和急促喊唱见长。
en: Hardcore punk pushed to extreme speed, with very short songs, dense blast beats, and hurried shouted vocals.

name: Thumri
zh: 印度斯坦抒情声乐，以灵活装饰和反复变化的歌词唱爱情与虔敬，重视情绪细节。
en: Lyrical Hindustani singing using flexible ornamentation and repeated textual variation to express love, devotion, and emotional nuance.

name: Tibetan Buddhist Chant
zh: 藏传佛教仪式吟唱，以低沉持续的人声、咒语重复和法器声形成层叠共鸣。
en: Tibetan Buddhist ceremonial chanting combining sustained low voices, repeated sacred syllables, and ritual instruments into layered resonances.

name: Tibetan Music
zh: 藏地的音乐传统，包含高亢山歌、舞曲与寺院吟唱，常配鼓、长号或弦乐。
en: Tibetan musical traditions encompassing high folk singing, dance tunes, and monastic chanting accompanied by drums, long trumpets, or strings.

name: Tibetan New Age
zh: 借用藏传吟唱、颂钵与法器音色的新世纪音乐，以缓慢合成器铺陈营造静谧感。
en: New age music drawing on Tibetan chants, singing bowls, and ritual timbres, often framed by slow, calming synthesizer textures.

name: Tigrinya Music
zh: 厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚提格里尼亚语歌曲，常以里拉琴旋律和循环节奏伴唱。
en: Tigrinya-language music from Eritrea and Ethiopia, often combining lyre-based melodies with recurring rhythmic patterns beneath the singing.

name: Timba
zh: 古巴舞曲，把萨尔萨编制与放克、爵士结合，以急转节奏、钢琴循环和强烈低音见长。
en: Cuban dance music blending salsa instrumentation with funk and jazz, featuring abrupt rhythmic shifts, looping piano figures, and forceful bass.

name: Timbila
zh: 莫桑比克乔皮人的木琴合奏，以不同音区的交错乐句配合群体歌唱和舞蹈。
en: Chopi xylophone-ensemble music from Mozambique, interlocking patterns across different registers to accompany communal singing and dancing.

name: Tin Pan Alley
zh: 纽约商业歌曲创作传统，以清晰主副歌、歌唱性旋律和钢琴伴奏传播流行歌曲。
en: A New York commercial songwriting tradition favoring clearly structured popular songs, singable melodies, and piano-based accompaniment.

name: Tishoumaren
zh: 图阿雷格吉他音乐，以反复拨弦乐句、持续律动和群体应答唱迁徙与沙漠生活。
en: Tuareg guitar music with repeating riffs, steady grooves, and communal responses, often singing about displacement and desert life.

name: Tivaner inngernerlu
zh: 格陵兰因纽特鼓舞与鼓歌，以手持框鼓的边缘敲击配合歌唱、叙事和身体动作。
en: Greenlandic Inuit drum singing and dancing, pairing strikes on a handheld frame drum's rim with songs, stories, and movement.

name: Tizita
zh: 埃塞俄比亚表达思念的歌曲传统，以缓慢旋律和富于装饰的唱腔延展回忆。
en: An Ethiopian song tradition expressing longing and remembrance through slow melodies and richly inflected, ornamented singing.

name: Toada de Boi
zh: 巴西亚马孙公牛节的主题歌曲，以密集鼓乐、领唱和大合唱推动节庆表演。
en: Songs for Amazonian Brazilian boi-bumbá celebrations, propelled by dense drumming, lead vocals, and large responding choruses.

name: Toccata
zh: 突出键盘或其他乐器技巧的作品，以快速音群、奔流段落和即兴般的转折展开。
en: Virtuosic music, often for keyboard, unfolding through rapid figuration, flowing passages, and gestures that suggest spontaneous invention.

name: Tolai Rock
zh: 巴布亚新几内亚托莱人的摇滚，把本地旋律与清亮电吉他、舞曲节奏结合。
en: Rock from Papua New Guinea's Tolai communities, blending local melodies with clean electric guitars and dance-oriented rhythms.

name: Tonada chilena
zh: 智利抒情民歌，以吉他伴奏的独唱或二重唱展开爱情、乡村生活等主题。
en: Lyrical Chilean folk songs, commonly sung solo or in duets over guitar accompaniment, exploring love and rural life.

name: Tonada potosina
zh: 玻利维亚波托西地区的轻快民间歌舞，以查兰戈琴、吉他和明亮歌唱带动节奏。
en: Lively folk songs and dances from Bolivia's Potosí region, driven by charango, guitar, and bright vocal delivery.

name: Tondero
zh: 秘鲁北部的歌舞，以切分吉他、木箱鼓和富于装饰的唱腔呈现求偶舞步。
en: Song and dance from northern Peru, with syncopated guitars, cajón percussion, and ornamented singing accompanying courtship movements.

name: Tone Poem
zh: 以故事、诗歌或意象为线索的管弦乐作品，借主题和音色变化描绘场景。
en: Orchestral music shaped around a story, poem, or image, using changing themes and instrumental colors to evoke scenes.

name: Tongan Music
zh: 汤加的群体歌舞传统，常以多声部合唱、拍手和鼓声配合整齐动作。
en: Tongan communal song and dance traditions, often combining multipart choral singing, handclaps, and drums with coordinated movement.

name: Tontipop
zh: 西班牙独立流行中的天真风格，以轻巧旋律、简洁歌词和俏皮键盘或吉他见长。
en: A playful Spanish indie-pop style with simple lyrics, light melodies, and cheerful keyboard or guitar arrangements.

name: Tosk Polyphony
zh: 阿尔巴尼亚托斯克多声部歌唱，让领唱与回应声部在持续低音上相互交织。
en: Tosk multipart singing from Albania, with a lead voice and answering part interweaving over a continuously sustained drone.

name: Totalism
zh: 在重复动机中叠加不同速度与节奏层的现代作曲，脉动明确但内部交错复杂。
en: Contemporary composition layering different tempos and rhythmic cycles over repeated motifs, creating a strong pulse with complex internal patterns.

name: Tough Guy Hardcore
zh: 偏重肉体冲击的硬核朋克，以中慢速重击、金属化吉他和集体吼唱见长。
en: Hardcore emphasizing physical impact through heavy mid-tempo breakdowns, metallic guitar riffs, and forceful shouted group vocals.

name: Township Bubblegum
zh: 南非城镇电子流行，以明亮键盘、鼓机与多语种副歌形成轻快的舞蹈节奏。
en: South African township dance pop with bright keyboards, drum machines, and multilingual vocal hooks over buoyant rhythms.

name: Township Jive
zh: 南非城镇舞曲，以跳跃吉他、活跃低音和应答人声形成循环推进的节奏。
en: South African township dance music built from buoyant guitars, agile bass lines, and responsive vocals over repeating grooves.

name: Toypop
zh: 以玩具乐器和小型音乐装置作主要材料，借童趣旋律与实验拼接重新组织流行声音。
en: Music using toy instruments and small music devices as primary material, combining childlike melodies with experimental, deconstructive arrangements.

name: Toytown Pop
zh: 带童话与童年想象的英国流行歌曲，常以音乐厅式演唱和俏皮编配呈现。
en: British pop inspired by childhood and storybook imagery, often featuring music-hall-style singing and playfully theatrical arrangements.

name: Toytown Techno
zh: 把童谣、动画对白等采样切入锐舞节拍的电子音乐，旋律熟悉而夸张。
en: Rave music built around nursery-rhyme melodies or cartoon samples, setting exaggeratedly familiar sounds against energetic electronic beats.

name: Tracker Music
zh: 用追踪器把短采样排成纵向音轨与模式循环，常带有电脑演示场景的精巧编排。
en: Music composed in trackers by arranging short samples into scrolling note patterns, often featuring intricate programming associated with the demoscene.

name: Tradi-moderne congolais
zh: 刚果传统节奏的电声改造，以放大的拇指琴、打击乐和粗粝失真形成密集律动。
en: Congolese traditional rhythms reworked through amplified thumb pianos, percussion, and rough distortion into dense, interlocking electric grooves.

name: Tradi-moderne ivoirien
zh: 科特迪瓦传统音乐与现代乐队的结合，将本地鼓乐和歌唱带入电吉他、贝斯编配。
en: Ivorian music combining local drumming and vocal traditions with modern band arrangements featuring electric guitars and bass.

name: Traditional Black Gospel
zh: 传统黑人福音音乐，以强烈独唱、合唱应答和钢琴或风琴伴奏表达信仰。
en: Traditional African American gospel emphasizing powerful lead singing, responding choirs, and piano or organ accompaniment in devotional songs.

name: Traditional Bluegrass
zh: 以班卓琴、曼陀林和提琴轮流独奏，配紧密高声部和声的原声乡村音乐。
en: Acoustic country music with rotating banjo, mandolin, and fiddle solos, supported by close harmonies in high vocal registers.

name: Traditional Cajun Music
zh: 路易斯安那法语民间歌舞，以手风琴、提琴和清晰二步或圆舞曲节奏伴随演唱。
en: Louisiana French folk music pairing accordion and fiddle with singing over clearly marked two-step or waltz rhythms.

name: Traditional Country
zh: 传统乡村歌曲，以原声弦乐、提琴或钢吉他伴随直白叙事和清晰人声旋律。
en: Traditional country songs pairing direct storytelling and clear vocal melodies with acoustic strings, fiddle, or steel guitar.

name: Traditional Doom Metal
zh: 以缓慢布鲁斯式重型吉他和清晰歌唱延续早期毁灭金属，突出低沉重量与重复段落。
en: Doom metal rooted in slow, blues-based heavy riffs and clean singing, emphasizing weighty guitar tones and repeated passages.

name: Traditional Folk Music
zh: 由社群世代传承的歌曲与器乐，常与劳动、舞蹈、仪式和口述故事相连。
en: Songs and instrumental traditions passed through communities, often connected to work, dancing, rituals, and oral storytelling.

name: Traditional Maloya
zh: 留尼汪传统马洛亚，以大鼓、沙响器和领唱应答构成紧密、反复推进的节奏。
en: Traditional maloya from Réunion, built around large drums, rattles, and call-and-response singing over tightly repeating rhythmic patterns.

name: Traditional Pop
zh: 以清晰歌唱旋律和细致乐队编配为中心的经典流行歌曲，常用弦乐与管乐伴奏。
en: Classic popular songs centered on clear vocal melodies and carefully arranged accompaniment, often featuring strings and horns.

name: Traditional Raï
zh: 阿尔及利亚传统拉伊，以芦笛和鼓伴随直白、装饰丰富的民间歌唱。
en: Traditional Algerian raï pairing reed flutes and drums with direct, heavily ornamented folk singing.

name: Traditional Séga
zh: 传统塞加歌舞，以拉瓦纳框鼓、沙响器和三角铁伴随克里奥尔语应答演唱。
en: Traditional séga pairing Creole call-and-response singing with ravanne frame drums, shakers, and triangles for dancing.

name: Tragédie en musique
zh: 法国巴洛克歌剧体裁，把宣叙调、咏唱、合唱和芭蕾连成庄严的舞台叙事。
en: French Baroque opera combining recitative, lyrical singing, choruses, and ballet into an extended ceremonial stage drama.

name: Trallalero
zh: 热那亚的无伴奏多声部合唱，让高音、低音与模仿吉他的声部交错应答。
en: Genoese unaccompanied multipart singing, with high voices, bass parts, and guitar-imitating vocal lines interlocking and responding to one another.

name: Trampská hudba
zh: 捷克与斯洛伐克户外露营歌曲，以吉他伴唱和集体和声吸收美国乡村、西部音乐。
en: Czech and Slovak camping songs with guitar accompaniment and communal harmonies, drawing on American country and Western musical imagery.

name: Trance
zh: 以连续四拍底鼓、循环音序和渐进铺陈为基础，借旋律高潮与段落起落形成沉浸感。
en: Electronic dance music using steady kicks, repeating sequences, and gradual builds to create immersion through melodic peaks and contrasting sections.

name: Trance 2.0
zh: 出神舞曲与音乐节浩室的交汇，以较慢律动、大段合成器铺陈和重落点展开。
en: Trance-influenced festival house with slower grooves, broad synthesizer breakdowns, and emphatic drops shaping its arrangements.

name: Trance Metal
zh: 将金属吉他与出神舞曲的合成器旋律、电子节拍结合，常在重击与明亮副歌间切换。
en: Metal combining heavy guitars with trance synthesizer melodies and electronic rhythms, often alternating crushing sections with bright melodic choruses.

name: Trancestep
zh: 把出神舞曲的循环合成器旋律放进鼓打贝斯，以快速碎拍托起长线铺陈。
en: Drum and bass combining fast breakbeats with trance-like repeating synthesizer melodies and extended, gradually developing arrangements.

name: Trap
zh: 以低沉808贝斯、快速踩镲滚奏和半速感军鼓支撑说唱，节奏紧绷而留白。
en: Hip hop built on deep 808 bass, rapid hi-hat rolls, and half-time snare patterns that leave space around the vocals.

name: Trap [EDM]
zh: 把说唱陷阱节拍扩展为电子舞曲，以低沉贝斯、踩镲滚奏和强烈落点制造起伏。
en: Electronic dance music adapting trap rhythms through deep bass, rapid hi-hat rolls, and dramatic drops rather than continuous rap verses.

name: Trap Dancehall
zh: 在牙买加舞厅雷鬼唱诵中加入陷阱说唱的低音与踩镲，节奏更疏落阴沉。
en: Dancehall combining Jamaican vocal delivery with trap-style bass and hi-hats, often creating a sparser, darker rhythmic setting.

name: Trap latino
zh: 以西班牙语为主的陷阱说唱，保留低沉808贝斯、踩镲滚奏与旋律化唱腔。
en: Predominantly Spanish-language trap pairing deep 808 bass and rolling hi-hats with rap verses and melodic vocal delivery.

name: Trap Metal
zh: 把陷阱说唱推向金属般的粗暴质感，以尖叫、失真低音和猛烈节拍制造冲击。
en: Trap combining screamed or shouted rap with heavily distorted bass and forceful rhythms for a metal-like sense of aggression.

name: Trap shaabi
zh: 把埃及沙阿比的街头唱腔与陷阱节拍结合，以电子低音和快速踩镲衬托阿拉伯语人声。
en: Egyptian shaabi-style street vocals combined with trap production, placing Arabic singing or rap over electronic bass and rapid hi-hats.

name: Trap Soul
zh: 以柔和旋律唱腔配上陷阱说唱的低音与稀疏鼓点，在亲密演唱中保留节奏重量。
en: Contemporary R&B pairing intimate melodic singing with trap bass and sparse drums, balancing softness in the voice with rhythmic weight.

name: Trapfunk
zh: 将巴西放克舞拍与陷阱说唱的贝斯、踩镲结合，以节奏化人声唱街区生活。
en: Brazilian funk fused with trap bass and hi-hats, using rhythmic vocals and danceable beats to portray neighborhood life.

name: Tread
zh: 高速陷阱说唱，以急促鼓点、密集808低音和阴暗循环把节奏推得更紧。
en: Fast trap driven by urgent drums, dense 808 bass patterns, and dark loops that keep the music relentlessly moving.

name: Tribal Ambient
zh: 在氛围音色与持续低鸣中加入手鼓、节奏循环或仪式性人声，形成缓慢流动的声场。
en: Ambient music blending sustained textures with hand drums, rhythmic loops, or ceremonial-style vocals to create slowly moving soundscapes.

name: Tribal Guarachero
zh: 墨西哥电子舞曲，把三连音式打击循环与拉丁采样、笛声和合成低音结合。
en: Mexican electronic dance music combining triplet-based percussion loops with Latin samples, flute sounds, and synthesized bass.

name: Tribal House
zh: 以层层手鼓、康加鼓等打击循环主导的浩室，四拍底鼓托起交错节奏。
en: House led by layered hand-drum and conga-like loops, with a four-on-the-floor kick supporting interlocking percussion patterns.

name: Trinidadian Cariso
zh: 特立尼达早期克里奥尔民歌，以即兴讽刺、夸耀和领唱应答连接卡利普索传统。
en: Early Trinidadian Creole folk singing connected to calypso, featuring improvised satire, boasting, and exchanges between leader and chorus.

name: Trip Hop
zh: 用慢速嘻哈鼓点、低音与朦胧采样构筑的电子音乐，常搭配贴近耳边的人声。
en: Downtempo electronic music combining slow hip-hop beats, bass, and hazy samples, often with close, intimate vocals.

name: Tropical House
zh: 以柔和浩室节拍、轻盈人声和钢盘鼓或木琴般合成音色营造海岛感。
en: Gentle house with light vocals and steelpan- or marimba-like synthesizer tones that create an easygoing island atmosphere.

name: Tropical Rock
zh: 以海岛生活为主题的柔和摇滚，结合木吉他、加勒比节奏与轻松合唱。
en: Soft rock themed around island life, mixing acoustic guitars, Caribbean-influenced rhythms, and relaxed singalong vocals.

name: Tropicanibalismo
zh: 波哥大的实验热带音乐，把库姆比亚等传统节奏扭成迷幻、不协和的电子与乐队合奏。
en: Experimental tropical music from Bogotá, twisting cumbia and related rhythms through psychedelic, dissonant electronics and band arrangements.

name: Tropicália
zh: 巴西的实验流行运动，将本土歌曲、迷幻摇滚与拼贴式编曲并置，声音常有突转。
en: A Brazilian pop movement juxtaposing local song traditions, psychedelic rock, and collage-like arrangements with abrupt shifts in sound.

name: Tropipop
zh: 哥伦比亚流行音乐，以轻快吉他、抓耳副歌和瓦耶纳托等本土节奏结合。
en: Colombian pop combining light guitar arrangements and catchy choruses with local rhythmic influences such as vallenato.

name: Trot
zh: 韩国流行歌曲传统，以规整二拍子、明显颤音和弯转装饰的唱腔见长。
en: A Korean popular-song tradition characterized by a regular duple pulse, pronounced vibrato, and bending, ornamented vocal phrases.

name: Troubador Song
zh: 中世纪奥克语游吟诗歌，以单线旋律演唱爱情与礼仪主题，重视诗句表达。
en: Medieval Occitan lyric poetry sung to a single melodic line, often exploring love and courtly themes with close attention to the text.

name: Trova
zh: 古巴自弹自唱歌曲传统，以吉他伴随细腻旋律，重视诗意歌词和个人表达。
en: A Cuban singer-songwriter tradition pairing lyrical melodies with guitar accompaniment, emphasizing poetic words and individual expression.

name: Trova yucateca
zh: 墨西哥尤卡坦的抒情歌曲，以吉他和紧密二重、三重和声唱爱情与小夜曲。
en: Romantic songs from Mexico's Yucatán, with guitars and close duet or trio harmonies suited to lyrical serenading.

name: Truck Driving Country
zh: 围绕卡车司机与公路生活的乡村歌曲，用鲜明节奏和叙事唱腔描写旅途。
en: Country songs about truck drivers and life on the road, using steady rhythms and narrative vocals to describe their journeys.

name: Trás-os-Montes Folk Music
zh: 葡萄牙东北部的民间音乐，以风笛、鼓和笛声伴随乡村歌舞与节庆仪式。
en: Folk music from northeastern Portugal, with bagpipes, drums, and flutes accompanying rural songs, dances, and seasonal celebrations.

name: Tsapiky
zh: 马达加斯加西南部的快速舞曲，以循环电吉他、活跃低音和持续歌唱推动长时间舞蹈。
en: Fast dance music from southwestern Madagascar, with repeating electric guitars, agile bass, and sustained singing supporting extended dancing.

name: Tsonga Disco
zh: 南非聪加语舞曲，以合成器、电子鼓和重复副歌把本地歌唱带入迪斯科律动。
en: South African Tsonga-language dance music using synthesizers, electronic drums, and repeated choruses over a disco-influenced groove.

name: Tsugaru Shamisen
zh: 日本津轻三味线演奏，以强烈拨击、快速旋律变奏和敲击般的弦声见长。
en: Japanese Tsugaru shamisen playing marked by forceful plectrum attacks, rapid melodic variation, and sharply percussive string sounds.

name: Tuareg Music
zh: 撒哈拉图阿雷格人的音乐，涵盖单弦琴、鼓歌与反复电吉他乐句支撑的群体演唱。
en: Music of Saharan Tuareg communities, encompassing one-string fiddle traditions, drum songs, and communal singing over repeating electric-guitar riffs.

name: Tumba
zh: 库拉索的节庆舞曲，以鲜明切分、歌唱副歌和乐队节奏伴随嘉年华行进。
en: Festive dance music from Curaçao, with pronounced syncopation, sung refrains, and band-driven rhythms accompanying Carnival processions.

name: Tumba francesa
zh: 古巴东部的海地裔歌舞，以领唱、木制敲击器和多面大鼓伴随群体舞蹈。
en: Afro-Haitian song and dance from eastern Cuba, with lead singing, struck wooden percussion, and several large drums accompanying communal dances.

name: Tumbélé
zh: 法属加勒比舞曲，把刚果伦巴的吉他律动与岛屿节奏、管乐和歌唱结合。
en: French Caribbean dance music combining Congolese rumba-style guitar grooves with island rhythms, horns, and vocals.

name: Tunantada
zh: 秘鲁豪哈的节庆舞乐，以萨克斯、单簧管、小提琴和竖琴托起舒展旋律。
en: Festive dance music from Jauja, Peru, with saxophones, clarinets, violin, and harp carrying broadly unfolding melodies.

name: Turbo-Folk
zh: 巴尔干民歌唱腔与电子流行舞曲的结合，以夸张转音、合成器和强烈鼓点见长。
en: Balkan pop-folk combining highly ornamented traditional-style singing with synthesizers, electronic production, and strongly accented dance beats.

name: Turkic-Mongolic Music
zh: 突厥与蒙古语族相关音乐的总称，涵盖长调、史诗吟唱、拨弦琴与喉音传统。
en: An umbrella for Turkic and Mongolic musical traditions, encompassing extended songs, epic recitation, plucked lutes, and throat-singing practices.

name: Turkish Black Sea Region Folk Music
zh: 土耳其黑海地区的民间歌舞，以短弓提琴和风笛奏出快速、紧密的舞蹈节奏。
en: Folk dance music of Turkey's Black Sea region, with short bowed fiddles and bagpipes driving quick, tightly patterned rhythms.

name: Turkish Classical Music
zh: 以马卡姆调式与乌苏尔节奏组织的土耳其艺术音乐，重视装饰旋律和器乐应答。
en: Turkish art music structured by makam modes and usul rhythmic cycles, emphasizing ornamented melodies and close vocal-instrumental interplay.

name: Turkish Folk Music
zh: 土耳其民间歌舞，以巴拉马琴、鼓和吹管伴随装饰性旋律与地方叙事歌曲。
en: Turkish folk traditions pairing ornamented melodies and regional narrative songs with bağlama, drums, and wind instruments.

name: Turkish Mevlevi Music
zh: 土耳其梅夫莱维苏菲仪式音乐，以奈伊笛、鼓和吟唱配合缓慢展开的旋转礼仪。
en: Music for Turkish Mevlevi Sufi ceremonies, with ney flute, drums, and singing accompanying the gradually unfolding whirling ritual.

name: Turkish Music
zh: 土耳其的音乐总称，涵盖马卡姆古典传统、巴拉马民歌、苏菲吟唱与流行舞曲。
en: Music from Turkey, encompassing makam-based classical traditions, bağlama folk songs, Sufi chanting, and popular dance music.

name: Turkish Pop
zh: 土耳其语流行歌曲，将装饰性唱腔和本地旋律语汇与现代乐队、电子编曲结合。
en: Turkish-language pop combining ornamented vocals and local melodic idioms with contemporary band arrangements and electronic production.

name: Turkmen Music
zh: 土库曼音乐传统，以巴克希歌手的叙事演唱和都塔尔琴的清脆弹拨见长。
en: Turkmen musical traditions centered on bakhshi narrative singing and the bright, plucked accompaniment of the dutar lute.

name: Turntable Music
zh: 把唱盘作为实验乐器，通过摩擦、循环、变速和唱片噪声组织声音。
en: Experimental music treating turntables as instruments, shaping sound through friction, loops, speed changes, and the noise of records.

name: Turntablism
zh: 用唱盘搓碟、剪切和节拍拼接进行演奏，把唱片片段重组为新的节奏与乐句。
en: Performance using scratching, cuts, and beat juggling to reorganize recorded fragments into new rhythms and musical phrases.

name: Tuvan Throat Singing
zh: 图瓦喉音歌唱，在持续基音上突出泛音，使一位歌者同时呈现低鸣与高音旋律。
en: Tuvan throat singing emphasizing overtones above a sustained fundamental, allowing one voice to produce both a drone and a higher melody.

name: Twa Music
zh: 中非与东非特瓦社群的歌唱，包含多声部交错、重复短句和拍手支撑的节奏。
en: Singing traditions of Twa communities in central and eastern Africa, including interwoven vocal parts, repeated phrases, and handclapped rhythms.

name: Twee Pop
zh: 天真亲切的独立流行，以轻巧吉他、朴素人声和简洁旋律唱私人心事。
en: Intimate indie pop with light guitars, unassuming vocals, and simple melodies conveying personal feelings in a deliberately innocent manner.

name: Twelve Muqam
zh: 维吾尔十二木卡姆的大型套曲，结合器乐、叙事歌唱和舞曲，旋律装饰细密。
en: Large Uyghur suites combining instrumental sections, narrative singing, and dance pieces, with richly ornamented melodic lines.

name: Twerk
zh: 面向扭臀舞的电子陷阱舞曲，以弹跳低音、重复人声短句和切分鼓点推动身体动作。
en: Trap-based dance music built for twerking, with bouncy bass, repeated vocal snippets, and syncopated drums emphasizing bodily movement.

name: Twist
zh: 早期摇滚与节奏布鲁斯的舞曲，以鲜明重拍、简短副歌和反复节奏伴随扭转舞步。
en: Rock-and-roll and R&B dance music with a strong backbeat, short choruses, and repeating grooves accompanying twisting movements.

name: Twoubadou
zh: 海地吉他歌曲传统，以抒情或戏谑唱腔、拨弦合奏和轻巧打击节奏见长。
en: A Haitian guitar-song tradition combining lyrical or humorous singing with plucked-string ensembles and light percussion grooves.

name: Tân cổ giao duyên
zh: 越南南部歌曲形式，在现代流行旋律与悠长装饰的望古唱段之间交替。
en: A southern Vietnamese song form alternating contemporary popular melodies with the extended, ornamented vocal passages of vọng cổ.

name: Uaajeerneq
zh: 格陵兰面具舞的歌唱传统，以夸张表演、独唱和鼓声配合诙谐或惊吓性的动作。
en: Singing associated with Greenlandic mask dance, combining theatrical solo vocals and drumming with humorous or startling gestures.

name: Udigrudi
zh: 巴西伯南布哥的迷幻民谣，将地方歌谣、原声乐器与实验摇滚的迷离编配结合。
en: Psychedelic folk from Pernambuco, Brazil, blending regional songs and acoustic instruments with hazy, experimental rock arrangements.

name: Udmurt Folk Music
zh: 乌德穆尔特民歌传统，包含仪式合唱、即兴诗句与声部各自变化的歌唱。
en: Udmurt folk singing encompassing ritual songs, improvised verses, and vocal parts that vary independently within a shared performance.

name: Ufie Music
zh: 伊博人的礼仪器乐，以成对木制裂鼓敲出相互应答的音高与节奏。
en: Igbo ceremonial instrumental music centered on paired wooden slit drums exchanging pitched signals and rhythmic patterns.

name: UK Bass
zh: 以低频为中心的英国电子音乐，融合车库、回响贝斯等节奏，鼓点常有弹性切分。
en: Bass-focused British electronic music drawing across garage, dubstep, and related styles, often featuring flexible, syncopated drum patterns.

name: UK Drill
zh: 英国Drill说唱，以滑动808低音、错位军鼓和冷峻旋律衬托紧密人声节奏。
en: British drill pairing sliding 808 bass, displaced snare hits, and cold melodic loops with tightly patterned rap delivery.

name: UK Funky
zh: 英国舞曲，将浩室节拍与非洲、加勒比打击节奏交织，低音轻巧，鼓点多变。
en: British dance music interweaving house rhythms with African and Caribbean percussion influences, emphasizing agile bass and syncopated drums.

name: UK Garage
zh: 英国车库舞曲，以摇摆切分的鼓点、弹性低音和剪碎人声形成轻快律动。
en: A British dance style with shuffling, syncopated drums, buoyant bass lines, and chopped vocals creating a lively groove.

name: UK Hard House
zh: 强劲的英国浩室，以快速四拍底鼓、反弹低音和尖锐合成器音色推进舞池。
en: Hard-driving British house with fast four-on-the-floor kicks, bouncing bass lines, and sharp synthesizer sounds built for sustained dancefloor energy.

name: UK Hardcore
zh: 高速英国硬核舞曲，以失真底鼓、明亮合成旋律和流行式人声副歌见长。
en: Fast British hardcore dance music combining distorted kicks, bright synthesizer melodies, and pop-style vocal choruses.

name: UK Jackin'
zh: 英国浩室分支，以错落弹跳的低音、摆动鼓点和熟悉的人声采样制造舞感。
en: A British house style with staggered, bouncy bass lines, shuffling drums, and familiar vocal samples driving the groove.

name: UK Street Soul
zh: 英国地下灵魂乐，以柔和演唱、鼓机切分和雷鬼式低音营造贴近生活的律动。
en: British underground soul pairing gentle singing with shuffled drum-machine rhythms and reggae-influenced bass for an intimate, unpolished groove.

name: Ukrainian Folk Music
zh: 乌克兰民间歌唱与舞曲，包含多声部合唱、班杜拉琴叙事和提琴伴奏。
en: Ukrainian folk traditions encompassing multipart singing, bandura-accompanied storytelling, and dance music featuring fiddles and other regional instruments.

name: Unakesa
zh: 巴西富尔尼奥人的歌舞，以雅特语歌唱和手持、脚踝沙响器表达自然与社群记忆。
en: Fulni-ô song and dance from Brazil, with Yaathe-language singing and hand or ankle rattles expressing nature and communal memory.

name: Unyago
zh: 东非女性仪式歌舞，以多面鼓、应答歌唱和身体动作传授婚姻与生活经验。
en: East African women's ceremonial music using several drums, responsive singing, and dance to share knowledge about marriage and everyday life.

name: Uplifting Trance
zh: 以明亮合成器主旋律、长段铺陈和情绪释放式高潮见长的出神舞曲。
en: Trance emphasizing bright synthesizer leads, extended builds, and climactic melodic releases designed to create an uplifting emotional sweep.

name: Upopo
zh: 阿伊努人的群体歌唱，以短小乐句反复和声部错开进入形成循环纹理。
en: Ainu communal singing built from short repeated phrases, with voices often entering at different points to create overlapping cycles.

name: Uptempo Hardcore
zh: 以极快四拍底鼓、夸张失真和尖厉音色制造连续冲击的硬核电子舞曲。
en: Hardcore dance music delivering rapid, continuous impact through extremely fast four-on-the-floor kicks, exaggerated distortion, and piercing textures.

name: Urban Contemporary Gospel
zh: 黑人福音音乐与当代节奏布鲁斯、嘻哈制作结合，以现代节拍承载合唱与信仰歌词。
en: Black gospel blended with contemporary R&B and hip-hop production, setting choirs and devotional lyrics against modern beats.

name: Urban Cowboy
zh: 适合舞厅的乡村流行，以圆润制作、顺畅旋律和轻快舞拍结合乡村唱腔。
en: Dancefloor-friendly country pop combining country vocals with polished production, smooth melodies, and accessible, upbeat dance rhythms.

name: Urtiin duu
zh: 蒙古长调以极长音节、宽广音域和细密装饰展开，歌词少而旋律舒展。
en: Mongolian long songs stretching syllables across wide vocal ranges and intricate ornaments, with expansive melodies carrying relatively few words.

name: Urumi melam
zh: 泰米尔乌鲁米鼓合奏，以可弯转的鼓声、密集节奏和吹管伴随节庆与仪式。
en: Tamil urumi-drum ensembles combining bending drum tones, dense rhythms, and wind instruments for celebrations and ritual performances.

name: US Power Metal
zh: 美国力量金属，以厚重吉他、快速节奏和高亢清唱见长，常带鞭击金属的锋利感。
en: American power metal emphasizing heavy riffs, brisk rhythms, and soaring clean vocals, often with a sharp thrash-metal edge.

name: Utopian Virtual
zh: 借用旧式MIDI音色与企业背景音乐，描绘明亮、人工化而带怀旧感的虚拟世界。
en: Electronic music using older MIDI sounds and corporate background-music cues to evoke bright, artificial, nostalgically imagined virtual worlds.

name: Uyghur Music
zh: 维吾尔音乐传统，以装饰性歌唱、拨弦乐器和达甫鼓展现木卡姆与民间歌舞。
en: Uyghur musical traditions combining ornamented singing, plucked strings, and dap frame drums in muqam suites and folk song and dance.

name: Uzbek Music
zh: 乌兹别克音乐传统，以长颈拨弦琴、弓弦乐器和手鼓伴随抒情唱腔与舞曲。
en: Uzbek musical traditions featuring long-necked lutes, bowed strings, and frame drums alongside expressive singing and dance melodies.

name: Uzun Hava
zh: 土耳其自由节奏的长篇民歌，以持续长音、滑音和装饰性转折突出个人声腔。
en: Turkish folk singing in free rhythm, emphasizing sustained notes, slides, and ornamented turns that showcase the individual voice.

name: Vaigat
zh: 格陵兰乡村歌曲，以格陵兰语歌词改编美国乡村与西部音乐，常配吉他。
en: Greenlandic-language songs adapting American country and Western music, commonly using guitar accompaniment and country-style melodies.

name: Valaam Chant
zh: 俄罗斯瓦拉姆修道院的礼仪歌唱，以缓慢调式旋律和低沉男声形成沉静共鸣。
en: Liturgical singing associated with Russia's Valaam monastery, featuring slow modal melodies and resonant lower male voices.

name: Valencian Folk Music
zh: 瓦伦西亚民间歌舞，常以多尔赛纳双簧管、鼓和弦乐伴随节庆与装饰性演唱。
en: Valencian folk traditions with dolçaina double-reed pipes, drums, and strings accompanying celebrations and ornamented singing.

name: Vallenato
zh: 哥伦比亚歌曲与舞曲，以手风琴、卡哈鼓和刮奏器伴随叙事性歌唱。
en: Colombian song and dance music featuring accordion, caja drum, and guacharaca scraper beneath narrative vocal lines.

name: Vals criollo
zh: 秘鲁克里奥尔圆舞曲，以切分吉他、木箱鼓和抒情唱腔重新摆动三拍子。
en: Peruvian Creole waltzes reshaping triple meter through syncopated guitars, cajón percussion, and expressive lyrical singing.

name: Vals venezolano
zh: 委内瑞拉圆舞曲，把三拍子旋律与错落重音结合，常由库阿特罗琴、吉他或钢琴演奏。
en: Venezuelan waltzes combining triple-meter melodies with shifting accents, often played on cuatro, guitar, or piano.

name: Valsa brasileira
zh: 巴西圆舞曲，以三拍子骨架结合歌唱性旋律与切分节奏，常由钢琴或小型乐队演奏。
en: Brazilian waltzes blending triple meter, lyrical melodies, and syncopation, commonly performed on piano or by small ensembles.

name: Vanera
zh: 巴西南部高乔舞曲，以手风琴和吉他奏出鲜明二拍子，节奏轻快而弹跳。
en: Gaúcho dance music from southern Brazil, with accordion and guitar driving a clear, buoyant duple rhythm.

name: Vapor
zh: 围绕复古数字音色、采样再加工和虚拟消费场景展开的电子音乐家族。
en: A family of electronic styles exploring retro digital timbres, reworked samples, and imagined environments shaped by consumer culture.

name: Vapornoise
zh: 将蒸汽波采样推入刺耳噪声、破碎失真与过载处理，让熟悉旋律变得模糊难辨。
en: Vapor-derived music overwhelming sampled material with harsh noise, broken distortion, and overload until familiar melodies become difficult to recognize.

name: Vaportrap
zh: 把蒸汽波的复古合成器与怀旧采样配上陷阱节拍，低音沉重，踩镲密集。
en: Electronic music combining vaporwave-style retro synthesizers and nostalgic samples with trap drums, heavy bass, and busy hi-hats.

name: Vaporwave
zh: 通过放慢、循环和扭曲流行或商业背景音乐采样，制造怀旧而失真的消费时代回声。
en: Electronic music slowing, looping, and warping pop or commercial background-music samples into distorted echoes of consumer-era nostalgia.

name: Vaudeville
zh: 美国杂耍剧场的歌曲与娱乐录音，常结合诙谐演唱、短剧和多样化舞台节目。
en: Songs and entertainment from American variety theatre, often combining comic singing, sketches, and a changing assortment of stage acts.

name: Vaudeville Blues
zh: 为杂耍舞台演唱的布鲁斯，以清晰戏剧表达和钢琴或小乐队伴奏突出人声。
en: Blues performed for vaudeville stages, emphasizing clear theatrical vocal delivery over piano or small-band accompaniment.

name: Vedic Chant
zh: 以严格传承的音高、重音和复诵方式吟诵梵文吠陀经句，重视发音与节律。
en: Sanskrit Vedic texts chanted through precisely transmitted pitches, accents, and repetition patterns, emphasizing pronunciation and rhythmic accuracy.

name: Verismo
zh: 描写普通人现实冲突的意大利歌剧风格，以强烈宣叙性唱腔和管弦推动戏剧。
en: Italian opera focusing on everyday people's conflicts, with forceful, declamatory singing and orchestral writing that intensifies the drama.

name: Vietnamese Court Music
zh: 越南宫廷礼仪音乐，以锣鼓、双簧吹管和弦乐合奏配合典礼与仪式。
en: Vietnamese court music combining gongs, drums, double-reed winds, and strings for ceremonial and ritual occasions.

name: Vietnamese Folk Music
zh: 越南各地的民间音乐，包含男女对歌、叙事唱腔，以及弦乐、笛管伴奏的歌舞。
en: Vietnamese folk traditions encompassing alternating male-female singing, narrative vocal styles, and songs or dances accompanied by strings and winds.

name: Vietnamese Music
zh: 越南的音乐总称，涵盖宫廷合奏、地方对歌、戏曲与现代流行歌曲。
en: Music from Vietnam, spanning court ensembles, regional responsive singing, theatrical traditions, and contemporary popular songs.

name: Vietnamese Opera
zh: 越南传统戏曲，以高度风格化的唱念和锣鼓、弦乐配合夸张人物表演。
en: Traditional Vietnamese opera pairing highly stylized singing and declamation with percussion and strings to support vividly theatrical characters.

name: Viking Metal
zh: 围绕北欧神话与航海史诗的金属，常以厚重吉他、合唱和民谣式旋律展开。
en: Metal drawing on Norse mythology and seafaring epics, often combining heavy guitars with choral singing and folk-influenced melodies.

name: Vikingarock
zh: 瑞典摇滚分支，以朋克式直线节拍、合唱副歌和北欧历史题材见长。
en: A Swedish rock style characterized by straightforward punk-influenced rhythms, communal choruses, and themes drawn from Nordic history.

name: Villancico
zh: 伊比利亚歌曲体裁，以主歌、副歌交替发展，既有早期世俗作品，也常用于圣诞歌唱。
en: An Iberian song form alternating verses and refrains, encompassing early secular pieces as well as familiar Christmas singing traditions.

name: Vinahouse
zh: 越南俱乐部舞曲，用强劲四拍底鼓、尖亮合成器和人声重混制造持续舞感。
en: Vietnamese club music driven by strong four-on-the-floor kicks, bright synthesizers, and remixed vocals that sustain an energetic dance pulse.

name: Vira
zh: 葡萄牙民间圆圈舞曲，以摇摆六八拍和手风琴、弦乐伴奏带动成对旋转。
en: Portuguese folk dance music with a lilting six-eight pulse, accordion, and strings accompanying couples turning within a circle.

name: Virgin Islander Cariso
zh: 圣克罗伊岛的传统新闻与叙事歌，以女性领唱、群体应答和拖长音节传递故事。
en: Traditional news and narrative songs from St Croix, featuring female leaders, group responses, and sustained syllables that carry the stories.

name: Visa
zh: 北欧以歌词为重的抒情歌曲，通常按诗节演唱，旋律清楚，伴奏简洁。
en: Nordic lyrical songs that foreground their words, usually unfolding in verses with clear melodies and relatively simple accompaniment.

name: Vocal Jazz
zh: 以人声为主奏的爵士，通过摇摆乐句、和声变化与即兴诠释歌曲。
en: Jazz centered on the voice, interpreting songs through swinging phrasing, harmonic variation, and improvised melodic choices.

name: Vocal Surf
zh: 以冲浪与青春生活为题的流行摇滚，用明亮多声部和声和轻快吉他节奏见长。
en: Pop rock associated with surfing and teenage life, featuring bright multipart vocal harmonies and buoyant guitar-led rhythms.

name: Vocal Trance
zh: 把完整人声歌曲与出神舞曲的合成器铺陈、渐强段落和旋律高潮结合。
